开始证明前：对象、维数和任意性Before proving: objects, dimensions and arbitrary choices

本讲义使用有限维实向量空间。x∈Rⁿ 表示 n 个实数组成的列向量；A∈Rᵐˣⁿ 有 m 行、n 列，所以 Ax∈Rᵐ。上标 T 把列变成行：xᵀy 是一个数，xyᵀ 是 n×n 矩阵。先看运算是否有定义，再做计算。We work in finite-dimensional real vector spaces. A column x∈Rⁿ has n real entries. A∈Rᵐˣⁿ has m rows and n columns, so Ax∈Rᵐ. Transpose T turns a column into a row: xᵀy is a scalar, whereas xyᵀ is an n×n matrix. Check dimensions before calculating.

“对所有”要求一般论证。证明集合凸，要任取两个成员 u、v 和任意 θ∈[0,1]，检验混合点；只试两个数不能证明一般结论。反例则只需一个合法对象使结论失败。“当且仅当”要写两个方向。A claim “for every” needs a general argument. To prove convexity, choose arbitrary members u,v and any θ∈[0,1], then test their mixture. Checking two numerical values is insufficient. One admissible counterexample can refute a universal claim. An “if and only if” needs both directions.

是最小上界，可以没有点达到；最大值还要求有点取到它。下确界与最小值同理。例如 x>0 时，1/x 的下确界为 0，却没有最小值。后面凡是通过除法构造向量，都先排除分母为零。A is the least upper bound and need not be attained; a maximum additionally needs an attaining point. The same distinction applies to infimum and minimum. For x>0, 1/x has infimum 0 and no minimum. Before normalizing a vector by division, exclude a zero denominator.

首次自学先看建模与的具体例子，再从连续路线进入六组基础；读“了解”层及对应“掌握”证明和关卡。作业回查用下方 17 项表。继续学习再回到本页其余单元；SVD、奇异 Schur 补、矩阵幂和特殊函数不列入本次作业门槛。For first study, start with the modeling and least-squares examples, then follow the continuous six-stage route. Read Understand plus the relevant Mastery proofs and gates. Use the 17-item table for lookup. Return to the remaining units afterward; SVD, singular s, matrix powers and special functions are outside the HW1 requirements.

1 · 证明、向量与长度1 · Proofs, vectors and lengths

06 · 向量与矩阵的内积06 · Inner products and directional response

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.4-5 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.1 · HW1 1(a),2

学完应能：算内积和迹；检查维数，解释线性泛函 zᵀx。Learning goal: explain s and directional response and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

内积是对应分量乘积之和；非零向量内积为零即正交。The inner product sums matching entry products. Nonzero vectors are orthogonal when it vanishes.

了解Understand

n 维列向量的标准内积 xᵀy=Σᵢxᵢyᵢ 是一个数。若 y 为单位向量，它表示 x 沿 y 的有符号投影。例如 (3,4) 与 (1,0) 内积为 3；与 (4,−3) 内积为零，两非零向量正交。For n-dimensional columns, xᵀy=Σᵢxᵢyᵢ is a scalar. With unit y, it is the signed projection of x onto y. Thus (3,4) pairs with (1,0) to give 3 and with (4,−3) to give 0, indicating orthogonality.

非零向量内积的正、零、负对应锐角、直角、钝角；零向量无夹角。优化中的 cᵀx 用费用系数评分，∇f(x)ᵀh 用计算沿 h 的一阶变化，都是内积。For nonzero vectors, positive, zero and negative products correspond to acute, right and obtuse angles; zero has no angle. Linear cost cᵀx and first-order change ∇f(x)ᵀh both use inner products.

Cauchy–Schwarz 使用欧氏范数：|xᵀy|≤√Σxᵢ²√Σyᵢ²。x=(3,4)、y=(1,0) 时 3≤5；若 y=(6,8)，两向量同向，50=5×10 取等。零向量内积为零，同样满足不等式。Cauchy–Schwarz uses Euclidean norms. For (3,4) and (1,0), 3≤5. For (3,4) and (6,8), 50=5×10 attains equality. A zero vector gives zero pairing and also satisfies the bound.

掌握Mastery

y≠0 时，取 t=xᵀy/‖y‖²，由 0≤‖x−ty‖²=‖x‖²−(xᵀy)²/‖y‖²，得 |xᵀy|≤‖x‖‖y‖。y=0 时显然成立；非零向量取等恰在共线时。For y≠0, set t=xᵀy/‖y‖². Expanding 0≤‖x−ty‖² gives Cauchy–Schwarz: |xᵀy|≤‖x‖‖y‖. Zero y is immediate; nonzero vectors attain equality exactly when collinear.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

求 (1,2,−1) 和 (2,−1,0) 的内积，解释结果。Find the inner product of (1,2,−1) and (2,−1,0), and interpret it.

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

y≠0 时，取 t=xᵀy/‖y‖²，由 0≤‖x−ty‖²=‖x‖²−(xᵀy)²/‖y‖²，得 |xᵀy|≤‖x‖‖y‖。y=0 时显然成立；非零向量取等恰在共线时。For y≠0, set t=xᵀy/‖y‖². Expanding 0≤‖x−ty‖² gives Cauchy–Schwarz: |xᵀy|≤‖x‖‖y‖. Zero y is immediate; nonzero vectors attain equality exactly when collinear.

展开核对Check the answer

内积是 2−2+0=0，两个非零向量正交。The value is 2−2+0=0, so the nonzero vectors are orthogonal.

深入In depth

矩阵的迹内积 tr(XᵀY)=ΣᵢⱼXᵢⱼYᵢⱼ 把各元素当作坐标，也用于定义 PSD 锥的对偶。The inner product tr(XᵀY)=ΣᵢⱼXᵢⱼYᵢⱼ treats matrix entries as coordinates and defines PSD-cone duality.

07 · 范数、单位球与二次范数07 · Norms, unit balls and weighted length

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.6-9 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.2–A.1.3 · HW1 1(a),3(b),5

学完应能：检查范数公理；画三种；用正定矩阵定义椭圆度量。Learning goal: explain norms, s and weighted length and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

范数满足正定性、绝对齐次性和三角不等式；单位球表示预算。Norms satisfy definiteness, absolute homogeneity and the triangle inequality. Unit balls represent budgets.

了解Understand

范数是满足三条规则的长度：仅零向量长度为零；‖αx‖=|α|‖x‖；‖x+y‖≤‖x‖+‖y‖。对 (3,−4)，ℓ₁、ℓ₂、ℓ∞ 长度分别为 7、5、4，表示总绝对误差、欧氏距离、最坏分量。A norm is a length satisfying definiteness, ‖αx‖=|α|‖x‖, and ‖x+y‖≤‖x‖+‖y‖. At (3,−4), ℓ₁,ℓ₂,ℓ∞ give 7,5,4: total absolute error, Euclidean distance and worst component.

单位球 {x:‖x‖≤1} 表示长度预算，二维中依次为菱形、圆盘、正方形。若第一方向误差更昂贵，可用 ‖x‖P=√(4x₁²+x₂²)，球变为第一轴半径 1/2 的椭圆。一般要求 P 对称正定，否则非零向量也可能长度为零。The unit ball {x:‖x‖≤1} describes a budget: a diamond, disk or square in two dimensions. Weighting the first coordinate more heavily gives √(4x₁²+x₂²), whose ellipse has first radius 1/2. In general P must be symmetric positive definite to prevent nonzero zero-length vectors.

对所有 x 必须有 ‖x‖≥0，并且 ‖x‖=0 当且仅当 x=0。三角不等式也给反向估计 |‖x‖−‖y‖|≤‖x−y‖，说明点靠近时长度也靠近；后面闭性证明会使用这一思想。Norms must be nonnegative, with zero exactly at the zero vector. The triangle inequality also gives |‖x‖−‖y‖|≤‖x−y‖: nearby points have nearby lengths, the idea used later in closedness proofs.

掌握Mastery

先验证具体长度 √(4x₁²+x₂²)。令线性变换 T(x)=(2x₁,x₂)，这个长度就是 ‖T(x)‖₂；T(x)=0 只在 x=0 成立，因此正定。T(αx)=αT(x) 给齐次性，T(x+y)=T(x)+T(y) 配合欧氏三角不等式给第三条规则。一般矩阵的证明等第16节准备好平方根后再做。First verify √(4x₁²+x₂²). For the linear map T(x)=(2x₁,x₂), this is ‖T(x)‖₂. Since T(x)=0 only at x=0, definiteness holds. The identities T(αx)=αT(x) and T(x+y)=T(x)+T(y) transfer homogeneity and the Euclidean triangle inequality. The general matrix proof follows after square roots in unit 16.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

‖x‖₀ 常表示非零分量数。它满足范数的绝对齐次性吗？The notation ‖x‖₀ often counts nonzero entries. Does it satisfy absolute homogeneity?

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

先验证具体长度 √(4x₁²+x₂²)。令线性变换 T(x)=(2x₁,x₂)，这个长度就是 ‖T(x)‖₂；T(x)=0 只在 x=0 成立，因此正定。T(αx)=αT(x) 给齐次性，T(x+y)=T(x)+T(y) 配合欧氏三角不等式给第三条规则。一般矩阵的证明等第16节准备好平方根后再做。First verify √(4x₁²+x₂²). For the linear map T(x)=(2x₁,x₂), this is ‖T(x)‖₂. Since T(x)=0 only at x=0, definiteness holds. The identities T(αx)=αT(x) and T(x+y)=T(x)+T(y) transfer homogeneity and the Euclidean triangle inequality. The general matrix proof follows after square roots in unit 16.

展开核对Check the answer

不满足：x=(1,0) 的计数为 1，2x 的计数仍为 1，并不等于 2。No. Both (1,0) and (2,0) have count one, rather than a factor of two.

深入In depth

范数平方按 |α|² 缩放，通常不再是范数；半正定二次型的平方根则可能只是半范数。A squared norm scales by |α|², so generally fails the norm axiom. A PSD quadratic form's square root may only be a seminorm.

11 · 内部、边界、闭集与上确界11 · Interior, boundary, closedness and extrema

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.18-20 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.2 · HW1 5(a)

学完应能：用球和收敛序列读定义；区分 supremum 与 maximum。Learning goal: explain interior, boundary, closedness and extrema and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

内点有邻域留在集合中；保留序列极限；闭有界集在有限维紧致。Interior points have contained neighborhoods. Closed sets retain sequence limits; closed bounded sets are compact in finite dimensions.

了解Understand

这里连续指输入趋近某点时输出也趋近该点的函数值。例如线性评分 x↦zᵀx 对每个固定 z 连续。开球与序列给出了把“趋近”写精确的方法。Continuity means that approaching an input point makes outputs approach its function value. Linear scoring x↦zᵀx is continuous for each fixed z. Balls and sequences make the idea of approaching precise.

内点周围有一个小球完全落在集合中；闭集包含所有收敛序列的极限。例如 (0,1] 的内点是 (0,1)，却因缺少极限点 0 而不闭。其边界为 {0,1}，闭包为 [0,1]。An has a ball contained in the set; a closed set contains all limits of convergent sequences from it. Thus (0,1] has interior (0,1) but is not closed because it omits 0. Its boundary is {0,1}, and closure [0,1].

平面中线段没有普通内点；限制在其所在直线上，去掉端点就得到。有限维中闭且有界等价于紧致，连续函数在非空紧集上取得最大和最小值，这正是许多“最大值存在”的依据。A plane segment has empty ordinary interior. Within its affine line, its omits the endpoints. In finite dimensions, closed and bounded means compact; a continuous function attains its extrema on a nonempty compact set.

收敛序列 xⱼ→x 指 ‖xⱼ−x‖₂→0，即任给 ε>0，足够大的 j 都有距离<ε。开球 B(c,r)={x:‖x−c‖₂0。闭集要求每个来自集合的收敛序列都保留其极限。例如 1/j 在 (0,1] 内却趋于被排除的 0，故该集合不闭。Convergence xⱼ→x means ‖xⱼ−x‖₂→0: for any ε>0, all sufficiently large j have distance below ε. The open ball B(c,r) uses strict inequality and r>0. A retains every convergent sequence limit from within it. Since 1/j in (0,1] tends to excluded 0, that set is not closed.

掌握Mastery

有限维范数单位球闭且有界，故紧致。线性响应 x↦zᵀx 连续，所以对偶范数定义中的上确界可以取得。A finite-dimensional norm unit ball is closed and bounded, hence compact. Continuity of x↦zᵀx ensures attainment in the dual norm definition.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

C={x∈R²:x₂=0} 的内部、相对内部分别是什么？Find the interior and relative interior of C={x∈R²:x₂=0}.

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

有限维范数单位球闭且有界，故紧致。线性响应 x↦zᵀx 连续，所以对偶范数定义中的上确界可以取得。A finite-dimensional norm unit ball is closed and bounded, hence compact. Continuity of x↦zᵀx ensures attainment in the dual norm definition.

展开核对Check the answer

平面中的内部为空；以这条直线为仿射环境时，相对内部等于 C。The interior in the plane is empty, while the relative interior is C.

深入In depth

最优点存在常由紧致性或强制增长保证；凸性本身不足以保证。Compactness or coercive growth often ensures attainment; convexity alone does not.

核对原课件 · 18-20Check original slides · 18-20

08 · 有限维范数的等价性08 · Equivalence of norms

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.10 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：区分等价与数值相等；解释长度比较与收敛一致性。Learning goal: explain equivalence of norms and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

有限维范数有统一正常数界，因此给出相同的收敛与开放性。Finite-dimensional norms admit uniform positive comparison bounds, giving the same convergence and openness.

了解Understand

范数等价指有固定正常数 c,C，使 c‖x‖a≤‖x‖b≤C‖x‖a 对所有 x 成立。例如二维有 ‖x‖∞≤‖x‖₂≤√2‖x‖∞，两长度数值仍可不同。Norm equivalence means fixed c,C>0 bound one norm by the other for every x. For example, ‖x‖∞≤‖x‖₂≤√2‖x‖∞ in two dimensions, although their values can differ.

这两个界保证：任一范数下距离趋零，另一范数下也趋零。因此有限维中所有范数给出相同收敛与开放性；误差容限的数值仍受常数影响。These bounds transfer distances tending to zero in either direction. All finite-dimensional norms therefore give the same convergence and open sets, while numerical tolerances depend on the constants.

例如 x=(1,1)，ℓ∞ 长度为 1，ℓ₂ 长度为 √2。等价指可以用固定常数相互控制，绝不要求两个数值相等。一般紧致性证明属于进阶；本节三个常用范数的比较可直接由前面的不等式算出。For x=(1,1), the ℓ∞ length is 1 and ℓ₂ length √2. Equivalence means uniform comparison bounds, not equal numerical values. The general compactness proof is advanced; these common norms can be compared directly.

掌握Mastery

最大分量平方≤平方和≤n 倍最大分量平方，开根号得 ℓ∞ 与 ℓ₂ 的界。对 |xᵢ| 与全 1 向量用 Cauchy–Schwarz，得 ‖x‖₁≤√n‖x‖₂。Bound the sum of squares between the largest square and n times that square. Taking roots compares ℓ∞ and ℓ₂; Cauchy–Schwarz with the all-ones vector gives ‖x‖₁≤√n‖x‖₂.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

给出使 ‖x‖₂=√n‖x‖∞ 取等的非零向量。Give a nonzero vector attaining ‖x‖₂=√n‖x‖∞.

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

最大分量平方≤平方和≤n 倍最大分量平方，开根号得 ℓ∞ 与 ℓ₂ 的界。对 |xᵢ| 与全 1 向量用 Cauchy–Schwarz，得 ‖x‖₁≤√n‖x‖₂。Bound the sum of squares between the largest square and n times that square. Taking roots compares ℓ∞ and ℓ₂; Cauchy–Schwarz with the all-ones vector gives ‖x‖₁≤√n‖x‖₂.

展开核对Check the answer

取所有分量绝对值相等，例如 x=(1,…,1)。Take all entries with equal magnitude, for example (1,…,1).

深入In depth

一般证明在紧致单位球面取另一范数的正最小值与有限最大值，再缩放。无限维缺少这项紧致性。The general proof takes positive minimum and finite maximum on a compact unit sphere, then scales. Infinite dimensions lack this compactness.

15 · 值域与零空间15 · Range, nullspace and rank

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.46-47 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.5.1 · HW1 2(c)补充

学完应能：从 Ax 的像和 Ax=0 的解读两个子空间；连接最小二乘。Learning goal: explain , nullspace and rank and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

是可达输出，零空间是消失的输入；秩加零度等于输入维数。Range contains reachable outputs; contains erased inputs. Rank plus nullity equals input dimension.

了解Understand

值域 R(A)={Ax} 是可到达输出； N(A)={x:Ax=0} 是被消去的输入。A=[[1,1],[0,0]] 的输出为 (x₁+x₂,0)，故值域是横轴，零空间为 x₁+x₂=0。The range R(A)={Ax} contains reachable outputs; nullspace N(A)={x:Ax=0} contains erased inputs. For A=[[1,1],[0,0]], outputs are (x₁+x₂,0), giving the horizontal range and nullspace x₁+x₂=0.

Ax=b 可解恰在 b∈R(A)。若 x₀ 为一解，全部解为 x₀+N(A)。满列秩排除非零零空间，保证可解时唯一；满行秩保证所有 b 可达到。Ax=b is solvable exactly when b∈R(A). If x₀ solves it, all solutions are x₀+N(A). Full column rank gives uniqueness when solvable; full row rank makes all b reachable.

本例两列相同，只能产生一个独立输出方向，所以秩为 1；输入有两个自由坐标，零空间有一个自由参数。这里“正交补”指与该空间中每个向量都内积为零的向量集合。The example has identical columns and one independent output direction, so rank 1. Two input coordinates leave one free nullspace parameter. The orthogonal complement consists of vectors orthogonal to every vector in the specified space.

掌握Mastery

Ax=0 等价于 x 与每一行正交，故 N(A)=R(Aᵀ)⊥；同理 R(A)=N(Aᵀ)⊥。由秩—零度定理，rank A+dim N(A)=n。Ax=0 means orthogonality to every row, so N(A)=R(Aᵀ)⊥; similarly R(A)=N(Aᵀ)⊥. Rank–nullity gives rank A+dim N(A)=n.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

上述 A 对 b=(2,0) 的全部解是什么？b=(2,1) 呢？Find every solution for b=(2,0), and determine whether b=(2,1) is attainable.

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

Ax=0 等价于 x 与每一行正交，故 N(A)=R(Aᵀ)⊥；同理 R(A)=N(Aᵀ)⊥。由秩—零度定理，rank A+dim N(A)=n。Ax=0 means orthogonality to every row, so N(A)=R(Aᵀ)⊥; similarly R(A)=N(Aᵀ)⊥. Rank–nullity gives rank A+dim N(A)=n.

展开核对Check the answer

第一种为 (t,2−t)；第二种没有解，因为输出第二分量恒为零。The first gives (t,2−t). The second has no solution since the second output is always zero.

深入In depth

很小的非零奇异值会让逆问题敏感；数值秩必须结合容差。Tiny nonzero singular values make inversion sensitive, so numerical rank depends on tolerance.

16 · 特征分解与正定、半正定16 · Eigenvalues and positive definiteness

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.48-52,55 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.5.2 · HW1 1(a),2(c),4(b)

学完应能：使用二次型判定；说明及可逆性；避免混淆逐元素非负。Learning goal: explain eigenvalues and positive definiteness and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

实对称矩阵可正交对角化；半正定等价于特征值全非负。Real symmetric matrices diagonalize orthogonally; PSD means nonnegative eigenvalues.

了解Understand

Pv=λv 表示方向 v 经变换后只缩放。实对称 P 可选正交单位特征向量组成 Q，写成 P=QΛQᵀ。令 y=Qᵀx，二次型变为 Σᵢλᵢyᵢ²，因此 P⪰0 恰在 λᵢ 全非负，P≻0 恰在全正。Pv=λv means a direction is scaled by the map. A real symmetric P has orthogonal eigendecomposition P=QΛQᵀ. In coordinates y=Qᵀx, xᵀPx=Σᵢλᵢyᵢ². Thus PSD means all eigenvalues are nonnegative; positive definite means all are positive.

[[2,1],[1,2]] 的特征方向为 (1,1)、(1,−1)，特征值为 3、1。大特征值方向费用较高，单位椭球轴较短。P⪰Q 表示 P−Q 半正定；它比较二次型，通常无法逐元素判断。For [[2,1],[1,2]], directions (1,1),(1,−1) have eigenvalues 3,1. Larger eigenvalues mean higher quadratic cost and shorter ellipsoid axes. P⪰Q means P−Q is PSD, a quadratic-form comparison rather than an entrywise test.

同一个矩阵，两种不同的几何对象One matrix, two geometric objects

线性像 Au 问“输入经过变换后落在哪里”。例如 A=diag(3,2) 将单位圆盘拉成半轴 3、2 的椭圆。二次型预算 xᵀPx≤1 则问“哪些输入的费用不超过 1”。P=diag(4,1) 给 4x₁²+x₂²≤1，第一轴只能到 ±1/2，第二轴到 ±1。权重增大使预算内允许的位移缩短。The linear image Au asks where transformed inputs land: A=diag(3,2) maps a unit disk to an ellipse with radii 3 and 2. The budget xᵀPx≤1 asks which inputs cost at most 1. For P=diag(4,1), 4x₁²+x₂²≤1 allows first coordinate ±1/2 and second ±1. Larger cost weights shorten allowable displacements.

正定 P 的预算球等于 {P⁻½u:‖u‖₂≤1}，所以沿单位特征方向的半轴是 1/√λᵢ；线性像 P 的半轴则是 λᵢ。两种图的变量和约束要一起读。For positive definite P the budget ball is {P⁻½u:‖u‖₂≤1}, so its radius along each unit eigenvector is 1/√λᵢ. The linear image by P instead has radii λᵢ. Read the variables together with the defining constraint.

掌握Mastery

非负特征值使带权平方和非负；反向取 x 为各单位特征向量，就读出每个 λᵢ≥0。又得 λmin‖x‖²≤xᵀPx≤λmax‖x‖²。平方根为 Qdiag(√λᵢ)Qᵀ。Nonnegative eigenvalues make the weighted squares nonnegative. Conversely, testing unit eigenvectors gives λᵢ≥0. Bounding the weights gives λmin‖x‖²≤xᵀPx≤λmax‖x‖². The square root is Qdiag(√λᵢ)Qᵀ.

P≻0 的平方根 P½ 可逆，且 ‖x‖P=‖P½x‖₂。可逆性排除非零的零长度，线性变换配合欧氏范数的齐次性和三角不等式证明另外两条。这就把第7节的对角例子推广到一般正定矩阵。For P≻0, its square root P½ is invertible and ‖x‖P=‖P½x‖₂. Invertibility excludes nonzero zero-length vectors; linearity and the Euclidean axioms transfer homogeneity and the triangle inequality. This extends unit 7’s diagonal example to general positive definite matrices.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

diag(0,2) 是否正定？它的平方根是什么？Is diag(0,2) positive definite, and what is its PSD square root?

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

非负特征值使带权平方和非负；反向取 x 为各单位特征向量，就读出每个 λᵢ≥0。又得 λmin‖x‖²≤xᵀPx≤λmax‖x‖²。平方根为 Qdiag(√λᵢ)Qᵀ。Nonnegative eigenvalues make the weighted squares nonnegative. Conversely, testing unit eigenvectors gives λᵢ≥0. Bounding the weights gives λmin‖x‖²≤xᵀPx≤λmax‖x‖². The square root is Qdiag(√λᵢ)Qᵀ.

展开核对Check the answer

它半正定但非正定，平方根是 diag(0,√2)。It is PSD but not positive definite; its PSD square root is diag(0,√2).

深入In depth

行列式为正不足以判正定：diag(−1,−1) 的行列式也为正。Positive determinant is insufficient: diag(−1,−1) also has positive determinant.

09 · 诱导矩阵范数09 · Induced matrix norms

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.11-12 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.5 · HW1 1(b),1(c)

学完应能：推导最大行和、最大列和与；证明次乘性。Learning goal: explain induced matrix norms and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

是最大长度放大率；输入、输出范数需先指定。An is maximal length amplification under specified input and output norms.

了解Understand

对 m×n 矩阵 A，先指定输入、输出范数，再问单位输入的最大输出长度。这个诱导范数描述最大放大率。例如 diag(3,2) 把欧氏圆变成轴半径 3、2 的椭圆，诱导 ℓ₂ 范数为 3。For an m×n matrix A, fix input and output norms and maximize output length over unit inputs. This induced norm is the largest amplification. Thus diag(3,2) maps the Euclidean circle to an ellipse with radii 3,2 and has induced ℓ₂ norm 3.

输入输出均用 ℓ∞ 时，|xⱼ|≤1，故每行 |(Ax)ᵢ|≤Σⱼ|aᵢⱼ|，最大绝对行和给上界。选最大行的符号作为 xⱼ，可达到此界。A=[[1,−2],[3,1]] 的范数为 4，输入 (1,1) 取等。With ℓ∞ on both spaces, |xⱼ|≤1 bounds each output by its absolute row sum. Choose signs matching a maximizing row to attain the bound. For [[1,−2],[3,1]], the norm is 4, attained by (1,1).

诱导 ℓ₁ 由 ‖Ax‖₁≤Σⱼ(Σᵢ|aᵢⱼ|)|xⱼ| 得最大绝对列和上界，取对应坐标单位向量达到。谱范数是最大奇异值；为全元素平方和的根，diag(3,2) 的二者为 3、√13。The induced ℓ₁ norm has the largest absolute column sum as an upper bound, since ‖Ax‖₁≤Σⱼ(Σᵢ|aᵢⱼ|)|xⱼ|, attained by a coordinate vector. Spectral norm is the largest singular value; is the root sum of squared entries. They give 3 and √13 for diag(3,2).

从长度比到单位输入From a ratio to a unit input

矩阵 A∈Rᵐˣⁿ 作用于非零输入 x。长度比 ‖Ax‖/‖x‖ 衡量它的放大率。令 u=x/‖x‖，则 ‖u‖=1，且齐次性使这个比值等于 ‖Au‖。因此比例式和单位球面上的最大输出是同一个问题；输出可为零。For A∈Rᵐˣⁿ and nonzero input x, the ratio ‖Ax‖/‖x‖ measures amplification. Set u=x/‖x‖. Homogeneity gives ‖u‖=1 and makes the ratio equal ‖Au‖. Thus the ratio and maximum output over unit inputs describe the same problem, even when the output is zero.

先算 A=[[1,−2],[3,1]]：行的绝对值和为 3、4。任何单位输入的输出每一分量都不超过对应行和，因此输出最大分量不超过 4。要证明 4 确实可达，选第二行的符号 x=(1,1)，得到 Ax=(−1,4)，且输入最大绝对分量为 1。For A=[[1,−2],[3,1]], the absolute row sums are 3 and 4. Each output entry of a unit input is bounded by its row sum, so the largest output magnitude is at most 4. To attain 4, choose the signs of the second row: x=(1,1) gives Ax=(−1,4), with input norm 1.

掌握Mastery

一般矩形矩阵：上界、取等、再证次乘性Rectangular matrices: bound, attainment, submultiplicativity

记 R=maxᵢΣⱼ|Aᵢⱼ|。对任意 ‖x‖∞=1，各 |xⱼ|≤1；逐行使用实数三角不等式：Let R=maxᵢΣⱼ|Aᵢⱼ|. For arbitrary ‖x‖∞=1, each |xⱼ|≤1. Apply the scalar triangle inequality in each row:

这给 ‖A‖∞≤R。选达到 R 的行 i₀；若 Aᵢ₀ⱼ≥0 则取 xⱼ=1，否则取 −1。零元素也取 1，因此 ‖x‖∞=1，且 (Ax)ᵢ₀=Σⱼ|Aᵢ₀ⱼ|=R。这给反向不等式。A=0 时同一构造仍合法，输出和范数都为 0。This proves ‖A‖∞≤R. Choose a maximizing row i₀; let xⱼ=1 when Aᵢ₀ⱼ≥0 and −1 otherwise. Zero entries also receive 1. Then ‖x‖∞=1 and (Ax)ᵢ₀=R, proving the reverse bound. The construction remains valid for A=0, with zero output and norm.

再证次乘性。设 B:Rⁿ→Rᵏ、A:Rᵏ→Rᵐ，三个空间各指定一个范数，中间 Rᵏ 用同一个范数。定义先给出放大界：v≠0 时将 v 归一化，得 ‖Mv‖≤‖M‖‖v‖；v=0 时两边都为零。于是即使 Bx=0，也可连续使用该界：For submultiplicativity let B:Rⁿ→Rᵏ and A:Rᵏ→Rᵐ, with one norm on each space and the same norm on the shared middle space. Normalizing nonzero v gives ‖Mv‖≤‖M‖‖v‖; for v=0 both sides are zero. Consequently the bound applies even if Bx=0:

整个论证都没有除以 ‖Bx‖。若中间两个范数不同，第一步不能直接接上第二步。The proof never divides by ‖Bx‖. If the middle norms differ, the two bounds cannot be joined directly.

A=[[2,−1],[−4,3]] 的诱导 ℓ∞ 范数是多少？构造单位输入取到它。Find the induced ℓ∞ norm of A=[[2,−1],[−4,3]] and an attaining unit input.

记 R=maxᵢΣⱼ|Aᵢⱼ|。对任意 ‖x‖∞=1，各 |xⱼ|≤1；逐行使用实数三角不等式：Let R=maxᵢΣⱼ|Aᵢⱼ|. For arbitrary ‖x‖∞=1, each |xⱼ|≤1. Apply the scalar triangle inequality in each row:

展开核对Check the answer

行绝对和为 3、7。取 x=(−1,1)，输出为 (−3,7)，所以范数为 7。Absolute row sums are three and seven. Input (−1,1) gives output (−3,7), attaining seven.

深入In depth

对误差 h，有 ‖Ah‖≤‖A‖‖h‖，因此诱导范数直接给线性传播的误差界。The bound ‖Ah‖≤‖A‖‖h‖ controls linear error propagation.

10 · 对偶范数：上界与取等10 · Dual norms: measure a linear response

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.13-16 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.6；A.1.3 · HW1 1(a)

学完应能：求常见对偶；用换元与取等向量求的对偶。Learning goal: explain s: measure a linear response and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

为什么需要一个“对偶”长度Why introduce a dual measure of length 当前层新增Added at this level

误差长度预算如何限制线性响应？给出精确系数：‖h‖≤ε 时，|zᵀh|≤ε‖z‖*。下面从单位球与内积解释这个系数。How does an error budget limit linear response? The dual norm supplies the coefficient: ‖h‖≤ε implies |zᵀh|≤ε‖z‖*. Unit balls and inner products explain why.

01 · 长度、内积与单位球01 · Length, inner product and unit ball

Lecture 2 · pp.4–8 / textbook A.1.1–A.1.3

学完应能：读懂 x 和 z 的角色，计算三种长度，并判断一个向量是否满足单位球约束。After studying: identify the roles of x and z, compute three lengths and check membership of a unit ball.

速通Quick

x,z∈Rⁿ 为列向量，z 固定、x 可选。 ‖x‖ 衡量长度，内积 zᵀx 给线性评分，单位球限制 ‖x‖≤1。The columns x,z∈Rⁿ play different roles: z is fixed and x chosen. Norm ‖x‖ measures length, zᵀx gives a linear score, and the unit ball restricts ‖x‖≤1.

了解Understand

二维向量 x=(x₁,x₂)ᵀ 表示点或箭头，T 是转置。固定 z=(3,−2)ᵀ 时，评分为 zᵀx=3x₁−2x₂。A two-dimensional column x=(x₁,x₂)ᵀ represents a point or arrow; T denotes transpose. Fixing z=(3,−2)ᵀ gives score zᵀx=3x₁−2x₂.

x=(1,−1) 给分数 5。继续增大 x₁ 或减小 x₂ 可使分数无界，因此需要长度预算。The choice (1,−1) scores 5. Increasing x₁ or decreasing x₂ makes the score unbounded, motivating a length budget.

为什么“长度”可以有不同规则Why length can follow different rules

常用三种长度如下：ℓ₁ 加绝对值，ℓ₂ 用欧氏距离，ℓ∞ 看最大绝对分量。Three common lengths are below: ℓ₁ sums absolute entries, ℓ₂ is Euclidean distance, and ℓ∞ takes the largest absolute entry.

对 (3,−2)，三者为 5、√13、3。它们仅在零向量处为零，满足绝对齐次性和三角不等式，因而都是范数。For (3,−2), they give 5,√13,3. All vanish only at zero, scale by |t| under multiplication by t, and satisfy the triangle inequality.

单位球包含边界，也包含内部The unit ball includes its boundary and interior

单位球是预算≤1 的选择。ℓ₁ 要求两个坐标共享总预算，ℓ∞ 允许每个坐标各用 1；对应菱形、正方形，ℓ₂ 则为圆盘。Unit balls contain choices with budget≤1. ℓ₁ shares a total budget across coordinates; ℓ∞ permits 1 per coordinate. They form a diamond and square, while ℓ₂ gives a disk.

三种球均含 (1,0)、(0,1)，但 (1,1) 只在正方形内。可行选择不同，使同一评分产生不同最大值。All contain (1,0),(0,1), but only the square contains (1,1). Different feasible choices produce different maximum scores.

02 · 为什么要定义对偶范数02 · Why define a dual norm?

Lecture 2 · p.13 / textbook A.1.6 · printed pp.636–637 / PDF pp.650–651

学完应能：说明固定什么、选择什么、约束什么，并用支撑直线解释最后的最大值。After studying: state what is fixed, chosen and constrained, and interpret the maximum using a supporting line.

速通Quick

‖z‖* 是固定 z 在原单位球上的最大线性响应。星号依赖原范数，换球也会换结果。The ‖z‖* is the largest linear response to fixed z over the primal unit ball. It depends on the chosen primal norm.

了解Understand

固定评分系数 z，只能选择长度≤1 的 x，最大能得几分？例如 ℓ∞ 球上 z=(3,−2)，(1,−1) 给 5；还须证明没有更好的选择。With fixed score coefficients z, choose x of length≤1. How large can the score be? On the ℓ∞ ball, z=(3,−2) gives 5 at (1,−1); we must still rule out a better choice.

是最小上界，未必取到。0<x<1 上最大化 x，上确界为 1，却没有最大值。A is the least upper bound and need not be attained. Maximizing x over 0<x<1 has supremum 1 but no maximum.

有限维极值定理保证：连续函数在非空闭有界集上取得极值。闭表示保留收敛点列的极限，有界表示长度不无限增长。In finite dimensions, a continuous function attains extrema on a nonempty closed bounded set. Closed sets retain sequence limits; bounded sets have uniformly bounded lengths.

范数单位球符合这些条件，zᵀx 又连续，故这里 sup 实际为 max。计算时将找出取等向量。Norm unit balls satisfy these conditions and zᵀx is continuous. Thus the supremum here is attained, and calculations will exhibit a .

固定的 z 与得到的数，各是什么What z and the resulting number represent

z 是系数向量，‖z‖* 是最大分数。系数翻倍，分数翻倍；z=0 时结果为零。The vector z supplies coefficients; ‖z‖* is a scalar score. Doubling z doubles the , and z=0 gives zero.

把内积相等的点画成直线Draw the points with the same inner product

二维等值线 zᵀx=c 沿 z 方向随 c 增大而移动。例如 z=(1,0) 时为竖线 x₁=c，单位圆盘上最后接触位置是 c=1。In two dimensions, level lines zᵀx=c move along z as c increases. For z=(1,0), x₁=c last touches the unit disk at c=1.

一般地，最后接触单位球的等值线是支撑线，法向为 z，位置为 c=‖z‖*。所以对偶范数就是单位球的。Generally the last touching level line is a support with normal z and value c=‖z‖*. The dual norm is the unit ball's .

滑块控制 r=c/‖z‖*，范围 -1.2 至 1.2。绿色线为 zᵀx=c；r=0 过原点，r=1 到达红色支撑线，r=−1 是另一侧支撑线，|r|>1 时越过单位球。45° 时依次选择 ℓ₁、ℓ₂、ℓ∞：对偶值分别为 1/√2、1、√2。ℓ₁ 在两分量绝对值并列最大时有整条最优边；ℓ∞ 在 z 某分量为零时有整条最优边，红点仅选择其中一个。The slider controls r=c/‖z‖*, from -1.2 to 1.2. Green shows zᵀx=c: r=0 passes through the origin, r=1 reaches the red support, r=−1 supports the opposite side, and |r|>1 passes beyond the ball. At 45°, ℓ₁,ℓ₂,ℓ∞ give dual values 1/√2,1,√2. The ℓ₁ ball has an optimal edge when maximal magnitudes tie; ℓ∞ has one when a z component is zero. The red point selects one maximizer.

跟着图做一次Try this with the diagram

选 ℓ₂、方向 0°，将直线位置从 0 调至 1、1.1，观察它经过中心、接触边界、离开圆盘。再选方向 45°，切换三种球，比较最大值。Choose ℓ₂ at 0° and move the line from 0 to 1 to 1.1: center, boundary contact, then no contact. At 45°, switch balls and compare maxima.

交互图固定 ‖z‖₂=1，滑块改变方向。蓝箭头为 z，红点为最优 x；直线位置调到 1 时抵达红色支撑线，超过 1 则无可行接触。其 z 与手算 (3,−2) 长度不同。The diagram fixes ‖z‖₂=1 and varies its direction. Blue is z and red the optimal x. Line position 1 reaches the red support; above 1 there is no feasible contact. Its z differs in length from the hand example (3,−2).

为什么没有在目标外面加绝对值Why the objective needs no absolute value

单位球关于原点对称，x 与 −x 同时可行，故最大化 zᵀx 与 |zᵀx| 结果相同。不对称集合无此保证。The unit ball contains x and −x together, so maximizing zᵀx or |zᵀx| gives the same result. Asymmetric sets need not share this property.

掌握Mastery

取 x=0 得 ‖z‖*≥0；z≠0 时取 x=z/‖z‖，得正内积 zᵀz/‖z‖，故仅 z=0 的对偶范数为零。Taking x=0 gives nonnegativity. For z≠0, x=z/‖z‖ gives positive response zᵀz/‖z‖, proving definiteness.

t≥0 可提出上确界；t<0 再用球的对称性，得到 ‖tz‖*=|t|‖z‖*。Nonnegative t factors out of the supremum; symmetry handles negative t, yielding ‖tz‖*=|t|‖z‖*.

每个可行 x 都有 (z+w)ᵀx≤‖z‖*+‖w‖*，取上确界即三角不等式。有限性由极值定理保证，因此定义确实给出范数。Each feasible x satisfies (z+w)ᵀx≤‖z‖*+‖w‖*. Taking the supremum proves the triangle inequality. Attainment ensures finiteness, completing the norm axioms.

03 · 把三个常用对偶算出来03 · Calculate the three standard duals

Lecture 2 · pp.14–16 / textbook A.1.6

学完应能：用同一个 z 比较三种约束，说明为什么结果不同，并给出达到最大值的向量。After studying: compare three constraints for the same z, explain their different values and give attaining vectors.

速通Quick

原范数Primal norm对应对偶范数Associated dual normz=(3,−2) 的对偶值Dual value at z=(3,−2)
ℓ₁ℓ∞3
ℓ₂ℓ₂√13
ℓ∞ℓ₁5

第一列指定 x 的预算，第二列计算 z 的对偶值；ℓ₂ 的对偶仍为 ℓ₂，称自对偶。The first column specifies the budget for x; the second computes z's dual length. ℓ₂ is self-dual.

了解Understand

原范数 ℓ∞：每个坐标都可使用自己的预算Primal norm ℓ∞: a separate budget for each coordinate

ℓ∞ 约束让两坐标各自≤1。对 3x₁−2x₂，取 x=(1,−1) 得 5；任意可行 x 的两项至多为 3、2，故最大值确为 5。Under ℓ∞, each coordinate has magnitude≤1. The choice (1,−1) scores 5, and the two terms can never exceed 3 and 2, so 5 is the maximum.

原范数 ℓ₁：两个坐标共享总预算Primal norm ℓ₁: the coordinates share a total budget

ℓ₁ 预算要求 |x₁|+|x₂|≤1，原选择已不可行。第一坐标单位预算收益 3，大于第二的 2，故全投第一坐标，取 (1,0)。Under ℓ₁, |x₁|+|x₂|≤1, so the old choice is infeasible. A unit of first-coordinate budget yields 3 versus 2 in the second; choose (1,0).

严格上界为 3x₁−2x₂≤3|x₁|+2|x₂|≤3(|x₁|+|x₂|)≤3，且上述选择取等。The bound 3x₁−2x₂≤3|x₁|+2|x₂|≤3(|x₁|+|x₂|)≤3 is attained by that choice.

原范数 ℓ₂：沿着 z 的方向走到圆周Primal norm ℓ₂: follow z to the circle

ℓ₂ 球上，Cauchy–Schwarz 给 zᵀx≤‖z‖₂‖x‖₂≤√13。选与 z 同向的单位向量 x=z/√13 可取等。On the ℓ₂ ball, Cauchy–Schwarz gives zᵀx≤‖z‖₂‖x‖₂≤√13, attained by unit vector x=z/√13.

下式分别检查所选点可行、目标达到上界。The two substitutions below verify feasibility and attainment.

证明最大值须给出适用于全部可行点的上界，再找可行点达到；x* 是向量，‖z‖* 是数。Prove a bound for all feasible points, then exhibit attainment. The optimizer x* is a vector; ‖z‖* is a scalar.

掌握Mastery

ℓ₂ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ₂

z≠0 取 x=z/‖z‖₂ 达到上界；z=0 取 x=0。故 ℓ₂ 自对偶。For z≠0, x=z/‖z‖₂ attains the bound; use zero for z=0. Thus ℓ₂ is self-dual.

ℓ∞ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ∞

取 xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) 使各项达到 |zᵢ|，得到 ℓ₁ 总和。对正、负、零分别返回 1、−1、0。Choosing xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) makes each product |zᵢ|, attaining the ℓ₁ sum. The returns 1,−1,0 for positive, negative and zero inputs.

ℓ₁ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ₁

选最大 |zₖ| 的坐标，取 x=sgn(zₖ)eₖ；标准基 eₖ 仅第 k 项为 1。这达到 ‖z‖∞，并列时可任选。z=0 另取零。Choose a coordinate maximizing |zₖ| and set x=sgn(zₖ)eₖ, where eₖ has only its kth entry equal to 1. This attains ‖z‖∞; ties allow any maximizing coordinate. Use zero for z=0.

04 · 为什么能约束任意长度的内积04 · Why the bound works for any length

Lecture 2 · p.13 / textbook A.1.6

学完应能：把一个任意非零向量缩到单位球，再解释怎样乘回原长度。After studying: rescale a nonzero vector into the unit ball and explain how to recover its original length.

速通Quick

原范数与对应对偶范数给任意 x,z 的内积界，无须 x 已归一化。A primal norm and its dual bound the inner product for arbitrary x,z, without requiring unit x.

了解Understand

x≠0 时令 r=‖x‖、u=x/r，则 ‖u‖=1，由定义及对称性得 |zᵀu|≤‖z‖*。For x≠0, let r=‖x‖ and u=x/r. Then ‖u‖=1 and the definition plus symmetry gives |zᵀu|≤‖z‖*.

把 x=ru 代回并乘 r，得到下式。x=0 时两边均零，无须除法。Substitute x=ru and multiply by r to obtain the bound below. At x=0 both sides vanish, with no division needed.

例如原范数 ℓ∞、z=(3,−2)、x=(2,−2)，上界为 2×5=10，实际内积也为 10；取等仅对某些方向成立。With primal ℓ∞, z=(3,−2),x=(2,−2), the bound is 2×5=10, equal to the actual product. Other directions need not attain it.

掌握Mastery

v 是单位球中的临时变量。先处理 x≠0 的归一化，再单列零向量，便覆盖全部情况。The symbol v is a temporary unit-ball variable. Normalize nonzero x, then handle zero separately to cover all cases.

05 · 二次范数：从椭圆换到圆05 · Quadratic norms: change an ellipse into a circle

Lecture 2 · p.8, pp.13–16 / textbook A.1.3, A.1.6, A.5.2 / HW1 · 1(a)

学完应能：解释矩阵 P 如何规定长度，理解逆矩阵出现的原因，并验证取等向量。After studying: explain how P defines length, why its inverse appears and how an attaining vector is verified.

速通Quick

实对称正定 P 定义；标准内积下，其对偶把权重换成 P⁻¹。A real symmetric positive definite P defines a ; its dual under the standard inner product replaces P by P⁻¹.

z≠0 时下式达到上界；z=0 取 x=0，值为零。The following vector attains the bound for z≠0. For z=0, choose x=0 and obtain value zero.

了解Understand

P 给不同方向规定不同的长度代价P assigns different length costs to different directions

P=diag(4,1) 表示对角为 4、1，其余为零。长度为 √(4x₁²+x₂²)，第一方向代价较高。The notation diag(4,1) places 4,1 on the diagonal and zeros elsewhere. Length √(4x₁²+x₂²) charges the first direction more heavily.

单位球沿两轴半径为 1/2、1，形成椭圆。同样预算下，较高权重允许较短位移。Its unit ball is an ellipse with axis radii 1/2,1. Higher weight permits less displacement under the same budget.

换坐标后，可以使用已经会算的圆球Change coordinates to use the Euclidean ball we already know

令 u₁=2x₁、u₂=x₂，把椭圆变为圆盘。目标同时变为 (z₁/2)u₁+z₂u₂，第一项系数减半。Set u₁=2x₁,u₂=x₂ to obtain the unit disk. The objective becomes (z₁/2)u₁+z₂u₂, halving the first coefficient.

欧氏对偶公式给 √(z₁²/4+z₂²)。逆权重来自反解坐标 x₁=u₁/2，而非另加的规则。Euclidean duality gives √(z₁²/4+z₂²). Inverse weighting comes from recovering x₁=u₁/2.

把最优点也换回原坐标Transform the maximizing point back as well

取 z=(2,1)，圆上最优 u=(1,1)/√2，换回 x=(1/(2√2),1/√2)。原约束左边为 4/8+1/2=1，目标为 √2。For z=(2,1), the disk optimizer is u=(1,1)/√2, giving x=(1/(2√2),1/√2). The constraint's left side is 4/8+1/2=1 and the score √2.

此时 x 与 z 不同向；直接用 z/‖z‖₂ 会使原约束为 17/5>1，因而不可行。Here x is not parallel to z. Directly using z/‖z‖₂ gives constraint value 17/5>1 and is infeasible.

跟着图做一次Try this with the diagram

先取 p₁=p₂=1、方向 45°，再将 p₁ 增至 4。观察椭圆变窄、x* 与 z 分离；核对 x*ᵀPx*=1、zᵀx*=对偶值。Start with p₁=p₂=1 at 45°, then increase p₁ to 4. Watch the ellipse narrow and x* turn away from z. Check x*ᵀPx*=1 and response=dual value.

交互图的 z 固定欧氏长度 1，蓝色为 z、红色为最优 x，虚线是支撑线；与手算 z=(2,1) 的长度不同。权重滑块保持 P 正定。The diagram fixes ‖z‖₂=1: blue is z, red the optimizer, and the dashed line its support. This differs in length from z=(2,1). Positive weight sliders keep P positive definite.

掌握Mastery

第 1 步：说明换元为什么存在Step 1: explain why the transformation exists

作业 P∈Sⁿ、P≻0 表示 n×n 实对称。正特征值保证可逆，并有对称可逆平方根 P½。In the homework, P∈Sⁿ,P≻0 means a real symmetric positive definite n×n matrix. Positive s give an inverse and a symmetric invertible square root P½.

特征向量满足 Pv=λv，即变换只沿该方向缩放。实对称矩阵可选正交单位特征向量作为坐标。An eigenvector satisfies Pv=λv, so the map scales that direction. A real symmetric matrix has orthonormal eigenvector coordinates.

写 P=QΛQᵀ，则 P½=QΛ½Qᵀ，对开平方。例如 diag(4,1) 的平方根为 diag(2,1)。For P=QΛQᵀ, set P½=QΛ½Qᵀ by square-rooting eigenvalues. Thus diag(4,1) has square root diag(2,1).

第 2 步：同时改写约束和目标Step 2: transform both constraint and objective

令 u=P½x，反解 x=P⁻½u。这是双向可逆换元，恰好把可行集换成圆球。Set u=P½x and x=P⁻½u. This invertible substitution maps the feasible exactly onto the Euclidean ball.

新的目标系数为 w=P⁻½z，约束为 ‖u‖₂≤1。The new coefficient is w=P⁻½z and the constraint ‖u‖₂≤1.

第 3 步：为所有可行点找上界Step 3: bound every feasible value

Cauchy–Schwarz 和单位约束给上界 d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z)。接着须找取等点。Cauchy–Schwarz and the unit constraint give bound d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z). We still need an attaining point.

第 4 步：构造达到上界的向量Step 4: construct an attaining vector

z≠0 时 d>0，圆球中取 u*=w/d，换回得到下式。For z≠0, d>0. Choose u*=w/d on the disk and transform back as below.

代回原约束和原目标，分别验证可行与取等。Substitute into the original constraint and objective to verify feasibility and attainment.

第 5 步：补上 z=0，并写出结论Step 5: handle z=0 and conclude

z=0 时所有响应为零，取 x=0；此时 d=0，含除以 d 的构造不适用。For z=0 every response is zero; choose x=0. Since d=0, the formula dividing by d does not apply.

作业证明保留正定条件、可逆换元、上界、取等验证和 z=0 的单独处理。Retain positive definiteness, invertible substitution, an upper bound, attainment checks and the zero case.

深入In depth

P=diag(1,0) 仅半正定：非零 (0,1) 的长度也为零，故不定义范数。可行集 |x₁|≤1 为无界条带。The PSD matrix diag(1,0) gives zero length to nonzero (0,1), so it does not define a norm. The feasible strip |x₁|≤1 is unbounded.

z=(0,1) 时目标沿 x₂ 无界，z=(1,0) 时最大值仍为 1。因此须检查目标是否沿零代价方向增长，不能直接套正定公式。For z=(0,1) the score is unbounded along x₂; for z=(1,0) its maximum is 1. Check response along zero-cost directions before applying a positive definite formula.

06 · 检查你能否独立完成06 · Check independent understanding

Self-authored exercises supporting HW1 · 1(a)

学完应能：自己识别原约束，构造取等点，并说明证明每一步的依据。After studying: identify the primal constraint, construct an attaining point and explain each proof step.

了解Understand

为什么同一 z=(3,−2) 在 ℓ∞、ℓ₁ 预算下最大值为 5、3？找到一个可行候选后，还缺哪一步才能证明最优？Why does z=(3,−2) give maxima 5 and 3 under ℓ∞ and ℓ₁ budgets? After finding a feasible candidate, what remains to prove optimality?

展开概念核对Open the conceptual check

ℓ∞ 的各坐标独立用预算，ℓ₁ 则共享预算，故原来的 (1,−1) 不再可行。可行候选只给最大值下界，还需证明没有更大值。ℓ∞ budgets are independent; ℓ₁ shares a budget, excluding (1,−1). A feasible candidate only bounds the maximum from below; an upper bound is still needed.

掌握Mastery

题 A：原范数 ℓ₁、z=(−2,5)。求对偶值，给出上界及取等向量。A: For primal ℓ₁ and z=(−2,5), find the dual value, prove an upper bound and exhibit an optimizer.

提示：先比较系数的绝对值Hint: compare coefficient magnitudes

先界为 5(|x₁|+|x₂|)，再把预算给系数绝对值更大的第二坐标。Bound by 5(|x₁|+|x₂|), then give the budget to the larger second coefficient.

展开题 A 的完整核对Open the complete check for A

取 x*=(0,1)，ℓ₁ 长度为 1、响应为 5，达到上界。Choose x*=(0,1), with ℓ₁ length 1 and response 5, attaining the bound.

题 B：P=diag(9,4)、z=(3,4)。求对偶值与取等向量，代回原约束和目标核对。B: For P=diag(9,4),z=(3,4), find the dual value and optimizer, then check the original constraint and objective.

提示 1：对角矩阵如何求逆Hint 1: invert the diagonal matrix

P⁻¹=diag(1/9,1/4)，故 d²=3²/9+4²/4。P⁻¹=diag(1/9,1/4), so d²=3²/9+4²/4.

提示 2：先修正方向，再归一化Hint 2: adjust the direction, then normalize

先求 P⁻¹z=(1/3,1)，再除以 d；核对原椭圆约束。Compute P⁻¹z=(1/3,1), divide by d, and check the original ellipsoid constraint.

展开题 B 的完整核对Open the complete check for B

该向量满足原约束并取得上界 √5，故最优。The vector satisfies the original constraint and attains bound √5, proving optimality.

题 C：P≻0、z=0。求上确界，说明为何不能用除以 d 的公式。C: For P≻0,z=0, find the supremum and explain why the formula dividing by d fails.

展开题 C 的核对Open the check for C

目标处处零，取 x=0。因 d=0，含分母的公式无定义。The objective is identically zero; choose x=0. The formula dividing by d is undefined because d=0.

合上答案重写题 B，注明换元与不等式的依据。Close the answer and rewrite B, explaining the substitution and inequalities.

07 · 进一步理解对偶的联系07 · Further connections of duality

Lecture 2 · pp.15–16; Lecture 3 · pp.60–65; Lecture 5 · p.11 / textbook A.1.6, 2.6.1, 3.3.1

学完应能：理解一般 ℓp 的取等构造，并区分范数、锥和函数的三种对偶对象。After studying: understand attainment for ℓp norms and distinguish dual objects for norms, cones and functions.

本节在“深入”层展开。This section opens at In depth depth.

深入In depth

对 1<p<∞，取 q=p/(p−1)，满足 1/p+1/q=1。给单位 ℓp 球上的目标上界 ‖z‖q。For 1<p<∞, set q=p/(p−1), so 1/p+1/q=1. Hölder bounds the response on the unit ℓp ball by ‖z‖q.

z≠0 时，选同符号、大小与 |zᵢ|ᑫ⁻¹ 成比例的分量，再归一化：For z≠0, match signs, allocate magnitudes proportional to |zᵢ|ᑫ⁻¹, and normalize:

由 (q−1)p=q，下式直接验证单位长度和上界取等。Since (q−1)p=q, the following identities verify unit length and attainment.

因此 ℓp 对偶为 ℓq。z=0 取零；p=1、∞ 使用前面的坐标构造，不能代入有限幂公式。Thus ℓp has dual ℓq. Use zero when z=0; endpoints p=1,∞ use the earlier coordinate constructions, not the finite-power formula.

深入In depth

矩阵内积为 tr(ZᵀX)，即对应元素乘积之和； tr 是对角元素之和。固定 Z，同样可问单位矩阵预算下的最大响应。Matrix inner product tr(ZᵀX) sums matching entry products; sums diagonal entries. Fix Z and maximize response under a matrix norm budget.

取最大奇异值，加全部奇异值，Frobenius 范数为元素平方和的根。diag(3,2) 的三者为 3、5、√13。Spectral norm is the largest singular value, their sum, and Frobenius norm the root sum of squared entries. For diag(3,2), these give 3,5,√13.

谱范数的对偶是。例如 Z=diag(3,2)，谱单位球内取 X=I，迹响应为 5。The 's dual is the . For Z=diag(3,2), X=I is spectral-unit feasible and gives trace response 5.

奇异值是正交输入方向的放大倍数，分解同时给出对应正交输出方向。Singular values are amplification factors along orthogonal input directions, with corresponding orthogonal output directions.

薄 SVD 为 Z=Σᵢσᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ，仅保留正奇异值。谱单位预算保证 ‖Xvᵢ‖₂≤1，故 |uᵢᵀXvᵢ|≤1，得下式上界。A thin SVD writes Z=Σᵢσᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ using positive singular values. Spectral-unit feasibility gives ‖Xvᵢ‖₂≤1 and hence |uᵢᵀXvᵢ|≤1, proving the bound below.

取 X=UVᵀ，把每个 vᵢ 映为 uᵢ，谱范数为 1 且各项取等。Z=0 取零。Frobenius 则由元素的欧氏对偶性得自对偶。Choose X=UVᵀ, mapping each vᵢ to uᵢ with 1 and equality in every term. Use zero for Z=0. Frobenius is self-dual by Euclidean duality on entries.

深入In depth

‖z‖*≤1 表示原球中每个 x 都有 zᵀx≤1，因此对偶单位球就是 B°：The condition ‖z‖*≤1 means zᵀx≤1 for every primal-ball point x. Thus the dual ball is the polar B°:

有限维闭凸集 B 含原点时，分离定理给 B°°=B。范数单位球符合条件，故双对偶恢复原球与原范数。For finite-dimensional closed convex B containing zero, separation gives B°°=B. Norm unit balls satisfy these conditions, so biduality restores the ball and norm.

例如菱形与正方形互为。一般结论将在凸集课用分离定理解释。The diamond and square are mutual polars. The general result uses the separation theorem from the convex-set lecture.

深入In depth

范数锥 K={(x,t):‖x‖≤t} 把 t 看作预算。其要求 zᵀx+st≥0 对所有 (x,t)∈K 成立。The norm cone K={(x,t):‖x‖≤t} uses t as budget. Its requires zᵀx+st≥0 for every (x,t)∈K.

若 ‖z‖*≤s，内积界给 zᵀx+st≥−‖z‖*t+st≥0，故属于对偶。If ‖z‖*≤s, the inner-product bound gives zᵀx+st≥−‖z‖*t+st≥0, proving dual membership.

若 s<‖z‖*，选单位球内 u 使 zᵀu>s，则 (−u,1)∈K 给负内积。因此 K*={(z,s):‖z‖*≤s}。If s<‖z‖*, choose unit-ball u with zᵀu>s. Then (−u,1)∈K gives negative pairing. Hence K*={(z,s):‖z‖*≤s}.

ℓ₂ 自对偶，所以自对偶，连接作业 5(b)。K* 是集合，‖z‖* 是数，需分清对象。Since ℓ₂ is self-dual, its SOC is self-dual, connecting to HW1 5(b). Distinguish the set K* from the scalar ‖z‖*.

深入In depth

共轭 f*(z)=supₓ(zᵀx−f(x)) 在内积收益中扣除函数代价。对 f(x)=‖x‖，结果取决于收益能否超过长度。The conjugate f*(z)=supₓ(zᵀx−f(x)) subtracts function cost from linear reward. For f(x)=‖x‖, the result depends on whether reward can exceed length cost.

‖z‖*≤1 时，目标≤(‖z‖*−1)‖x‖≤0，取 x=0 达零。否则选单位 u 使 zᵀu>1，令 x=tu，正收益随 t→∞ 无界。For ‖z‖*≤1, the objective≤(‖z‖*−1)‖x‖≤0, attained at zero. Otherwise choose unit u with zᵀu>1; scaling x=tu makes positive reward unbounded.

因此范数的共轭是对偶单位球的示性函数：球内零、球外 +∞。它与对偶范数、对偶锥各有不同定义。Thus the norm's conjugate is the dual-ball indicator: zero inside and +∞ outside. It differs in definition from a dual norm or dual cone.

了解Understand

二次范数：先把椭球变成圆球Quadratic norms: turn the ellipsoid into a ball

先补齐工具。P∈Sⁿ 表示实对称 n×n 矩阵。P≻0 表示每个非零 x 都有 xᵀPx>0。谱分解 P=Q diag(λᵢ)Qᵀ 中 QᵀQ=I、λᵢ>0；I 是单位矩阵。将 λᵢ 换成 √λᵢ 得 P½，换成 1/√λᵢ 得 P⁻½。它们可逆且对称，P½P½=P。We need a real symmetric matrix P∈Sⁿ with P≻0, meaning xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero x. Its spectral decomposition is P=Q diag(λᵢ)Qᵀ, with QᵀQ=I and λᵢ>0. Here I is the identity. Replacing λᵢ by √λᵢ defines P½; replacing it by 1/√λᵢ defines P⁻½. Both are symmetric and invertible, and P½P½=P.

以 P=diag(9,1)、固定评分 z=(3,2) 为例。预算为 9x₁²+x₂²≤1，目标为 3x₁+2x₂。令 u=(3x₁,x₂)，预算变成 u₁²+u₂²≤1，目标同时变成 u₁+2u₂。Cauchy–Schwarz 给上界 √5，取 u=(1,2)/√5 达到它。换回 x=(1/(3√5),2/√5)，预算恰为 1，评分恰为 √5。Take P=diag(9,1) and fixed score z=(3,2). The budget is 9x₁²+x₂²≤1 and reward 3x₁+2x₂. With u=(3x₁,x₂), the budget becomes u₁²+u₂²≤1 and reward u₁+2u₂. Cauchy–Schwarz bounds it by √5, attained by u=(1,2)/√5. Returning to x=(1/(3√5),2/√5) gives budget 1 and reward √5.

交互图为方便比较方向，固定 ‖z‖₂=1；上述手算的 z 并未归一化。把 z 乘正数，会把对偶值乘同一正数，不改变最优方向。z=0 时所有可行点的评分都为 0，没有唯一支撑方向。The interaction fixes ‖z‖₂=1 to compare directions; the hand calculation does not normalize z. Positive scaling of z scales the dual value without changing the maximizing direction. For z=0 every feasible point scores 0, so no unique support direction exists.

掌握Mastery

一般矩阵的上界与取等Bound and attainment for a general matrix

固定 z∈Rⁿ，换元 u=P½x 是双射。约束和目标都必须改写：For fixed z∈Rⁿ, u=P½x is a bijection. Transform both constraint and objective:

当 z≠0，d>0。要让 Cauchy–Schwarz 取等，就使 u 与 P⁻½z 同向且单位长：u*=P⁻½z/d。因此 x*=P⁻¹z/d。再直接检查，避免只猜对方向却长度不对：If z≠0 then d>0. Equality in Cauchy–Schwarz asks for a unit u in direction P⁻½z: u*=P⁻½z/d. Hence x*=P⁻¹z/d. Verify both its budget and reward:

所以对偶范数为 √(zᵀP⁻¹z)。z=0 时直接取 x=0，值为 0，不能使用含 d 的除法。P 仅半正定时 P⁻¹ 可能不存在，此公式不能照用。Thus the dual norm is √(zᵀP⁻¹z). For z=0 choose x=0 for value 0; do not divide by d. A merely PSD P may lack an inverse, so this formula cannot simply be reused.

独立练习Independent practice

① P=[[2,1],[1,2]]、z=(1,−1)，求二次范数的对偶值与取等点。② 对 A=[[1,−3,2],[−2,0,1]]，求诱导 ℓ∞ 范数并构造单位输入。③ 给相容矩形矩阵写次乘性证明，说明 Bx=0 怎么处理。(1) For P=[[2,1],[1,2]] and z=(1,−1), find the quadratic dual value and an attaining point. (2) For A=[[1,−3,2],[−2,0,1]], find its induced ℓ∞ norm and an attaining unit input. (3) Prove submultiplicativity for compatible rectangular maps, including Bx=0.

思路提示Hint

先看 z 是否为 P 的特征向量；行和公式仍要写上界与取等两段。次乘性从对所有 v 的放大界启动。Check whether z is an eigenvector of P. The row-sum formula needs both a bound and attainment. Start submultiplicativity with the amplification bound for every v.

关键步骤Key steps

Pz=z，所以 P⁻¹z=z。矩阵两行绝对和为 6、3，应对准第一行的符号。相容空间为 R³→Rᵏ→Rᵐ 时，给中间空间固定同一范数。Here Pz=z, hence P⁻¹z=z. The row sums are 6 and 3; match the first row’s signs. For R³→Rᵏ→Rᵐ, use one fixed norm on the middle space.

完整核对Full check

P 的特征值为 3、1，故正定。d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z)=√2，取 x*=z/√2，预算为 1、评分为 √2。对任意单位 ℓ∞ 输入，逐行三角不等式给输出≤6；取 x=(1,−1,1)，Ax=(6,−1)，所以范数为 6。The eigenvalues of P are 3 and 1, so it is positive definite. The dual value is √2; x*=z/√2 has budget 1 and reward √2. Rowwise triangle inequalities bound every unit ℓ∞ input’s output by 6. Input (1,−1,1) gives (6,−1), attaining 6.

次乘性先证 v=0 时 ‖Mv‖≤‖M‖‖v‖ 为 0≤0；v≠0 时由归一化得到。再依次用于 A、B，得到 ‖ABx‖≤‖A‖‖B‖‖x‖，对单位 x 取上确界。常见错误：将符号全取正；或在 Bx=0 时除以其长度。For submultiplicativity prove ‖Mv‖≤‖M‖‖v‖ separately for v=0 and by normalization for v≠0. Apply it to A then B and take a supremum over unit x. Common errors are using all-positive signs or dividing by ‖Bx‖ when it vanishes.

若卡住，回读 本节方法，再合上答案重写。If stuck, revisit the method, then close the answer and rewrite it.

12 · 定义域与连续性12 · Domains and continuity

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.22-23 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.3 · HW1 2,4,5(a)

学完应能：识别向量值映射与函数定义域；处理复合函数的定义域。Learning goal: explain domains and continuity and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

函数连同定义域一起讨论；连续性在域内点检验。A function includes its domain; continuity is tested at in-domain points.

了解Understand

定义域列出函数允许的输入：−log x 要求 x>0；1/x 可在 R\{0} 定义，但讨论凸性通常限制到正半轴。公式和定义域共同确定函数。The domain specifies allowed inputs: x>0 for −log x, while 1/x can be defined on R\{0}. Convexity discussions usually restrict the latter to the positive half-line. A function includes its domain.

连续性要求输入趋于域内的 x 时，函数值趋于 f(x)。1/x 在每个非零点连续，靠近域外缺口 0 时无界并不矛盾；无需它在域外有有限值。Continuity requires values to approach f(x) as inputs approach an in-domain x. The reciprocal is continuous at every nonzero point despite becoming unbounded near the excluded point 0; no finite value outside its domain is required.

“定义域凸”也要单独检查：(0,∞) 是区间，凸；R 去掉 0 却包含 −1、1 而缺少中点，非凸。即使一个公式在两个分支各自凸，也不能将两分支合成一个凸函数域。Check convexity of the domain separately: (0,∞) is convex, while R without 0 contains −1 and 1 but omits their midpoint. Convexity on separate branches does not give a convex domain for their union.

掌握Mastery

在域内点 x₀≠0 附近，把 x 限在 |x−x₀|<|x₀|/2，分母便远离零。由 |1/x−1/x₀|=|x−x₀|/|xx₀|，可见输入差趋零时函数值差也趋零。Near x₀≠0, restrict |x−x₀|<|x₀|/2 to keep denominators away from zero. Then |1/x−1/x₀|=|x−x₀|/|xx₀| tends to zero with the input difference.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

在 x>0 上连续的 1/x，一定取得最小值吗？Does the continuous reciprocal on x>0 attain its minimum?

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

在域内点 x₀≠0 附近，把 x 限在 |x−x₀|<|x₀|/2，分母便远离零。由 |1/x−1/x₀|=|x−x₀|/|xx₀|，可见输入差趋零时函数值差也趋零。Near x₀≠0, restrict |x−x₀|<|x₀|/2 to keep denominators away from zero. Then |1/x−1/x₀|=|x−x₀|/|xx₀| tends to zero with the input difference.

展开核对Check the answer

它的下确界为 0，x→∞ 时逼近，但任意有限正 x 都有 1/x>0，因此不取得。Its infimum is zero approached as x→∞, but every finite positive x gives 1/x>0, so it is not attained.

深入In depth

连续性本身不保证取得最优值；还需集合或增长条件。Continuity alone does not ensure an attained optimum; set or growth conditions are needed.

13 · 导数、梯度与向量链式法则13 · Derivatives, gradients and the chain rule

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.25-37 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.4.1–A.4.2 · HW1 2(a)

学完应能：从线性近似理解导数；推导复合仿射函数和 Log-Sum-Exp 梯度。Learning goal: explain derivatives, s and the chain rule and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

梯度给标量函数的一阶变化； 处理向量输出。Gradients give scalar first-order change; Jacobians handle vector outputs.

了解Understand

先算二维函数，再推广到向量Calculate in two dimensions first

对 f(x₁,x₂)=x₁²+3x₂²，偏导数只改变一个坐标，另一个保持固定。分别得到 ∂f/∂x₁=2x₁、∂f/∂x₂=6x₂。将它们竖排就是列梯度。再对每个偏导逐坐标求导，就得到 ：For f(x₁,x₂)=x₁²+3x₂², a partial derivative varies one coordinate while fixing the other. The partials are 2x₁ and 6x₂. Stack them as a column gradient, then differentiate each entry with respect to each coordinate to form the Hessian:

例如在 x=(1,1)，小步 h=(0.01,−0.02) 的一阶预测为 2×0.01+6×(−0.02)=−0.10，真实变化再加 0.0013。梯度提供线性变化，Hessian 则描述偏离直线的二阶变化。对向量输出 g=(x₁²,x₁+x₂)，Jacobian 的第 i 行是第 i 个输出的梯度转置，故 Dg=[[2x₁,0],[1,1]]。At x=(1,1), step h=(0.01,−0.02) has first-order prediction −0.10 and actual change −0.10+0.0013. The gradient measures linear change and the Hessian the second-order departure. For vector output g=(x₁²,x₁+x₂), row i of the Jacobian is the transpose of output i’s gradient: Dg=[[2x₁,0],[1,1]].

指数和的对数：每一层各用一个求导规则Log-sum-exp: differentiate one layer at a time

令 aᵢ,x∈Rⁿ 为列向量，bᵢ 为固定实数，i=1,…,m 且 m≥1。先算仿射分数 sᵢ，再求指数总和 S，最后取对数 L。sᵢ、S、pᵢ 都是标量，ā 是 n 维列向量。Let aᵢ,x∈Rⁿ be columns, bᵢ fixed real numbers, i=1,…,m with m≥1. First form affine scores sᵢ, then their exponential sum S, then L=log S. The quantities sᵢ,S,pᵢ are scalars; ā is an n-dimensional column.

仿射函数的梯度是 aᵢ；指数的链式法则给 ∇eˢⁱ=eˢⁱaᵢ；和式逐项求导，外层 log 的导数是 1/S。因此：The affine score has gradient aᵢ. The exponential chain rule gives ∇eˢⁱ=eˢⁱaᵢ. Differentiate the sum term by term and multiply by the logarithm derivative 1/S:

这说明梯度是各 aᵢ 的加权平均，分数更大的项权重更大。例如 L=log(eˣ¹+eˣ²) 在原点两个权重都为 1/2，梯度为 (1/2,1/2)。The gradient is a weighted average of the aᵢ, favoring larger scores. At the origin for L=log(eˣ¹+eˣ²), both weights are 1/2 and the gradient is (1/2,1/2).

掌握Mastery

对 log 的导数乘内层指数和的导数，即得上述 pᵢ 权重。仿射内层把小位移 h 变成 Ah，外层一阶变化为 ∇fᵀAh=(Aᵀ∇f)ᵀh，故复合梯度为 Aᵀ∇f。Differentiate the logarithm and exponential sum to obtain weights pᵢ. An affine inner map sends displacement h to Ah. Outer first-order change is ∇fᵀAh=(Aᵀ∇f)ᵀh, giving composite gradient Aᵀ∇f.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=log(exp(x)+exp(−x)) 在 x=0 的导数是多少？What is the derivative of log(exp(x)+exp(−x)) at zero?

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

对 log 的导数乘内层指数和的导数，即得上述 pᵢ 权重。仿射内层把小位移 h 变成 Ah，外层一阶变化为 ∇fᵀAh=(Aᵀ∇f)ᵀh，故复合梯度为 Aᵀ∇f。Differentiate the logarithm and exponential sum to obtain weights pᵢ. An affine inner map sends displacement h to Ah. Outer first-order change is ∇fᵀAh=(Aᵀ∇f)ᵀh, giving composite gradient Aᵀ∇f.

展开核对Check the answer

两个权重各 1/2，系数为 1、−1，导数为 0。Weights are one half each and coefficients are 1 and −1, giving derivative zero.

深入In depth

各偏导存在不保证可微；一阶近似要求余项在所有方向同时小于一阶量。Existence of partial derivatives does not ensure differentiability; the first-order approximation must control all directions.

14 · Hessian 与二阶链式法则14 · Hessians and the covariance of log-sum-exp

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.38-44 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.4.3–A.4.4 · HW1 2(b),2(c),4(a),4(b)

学完应能：展开 Hessian；把 Log-Sum-Exp 写为加权并识别零方向。Learning goal: explain hessians and the covariance of and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

Hessian 给方向曲率； 的 Hessian 是半正定协方差形式。Hessians give directional curvature. Log-sum-exp has a PSD -form Hessian.

了解Understand

方向曲率与外积Directional curvature and outer products

沿直线 x+tv 观察 f。对前节的二次函数，两次关于 t 求导得到 2v₁²+6v₂²=vᵀHv。它对每个 v 非负，便称 H 半正定。H 作用于方向，不只逐元素比较大小。列向量 a=(a₁,a₂) 的外积 aaᵀ=[[a₁²,a₁a₂],[a₁a₂,a₂²]]，而 aᵀa=a₁²+a₂² 是一个数。Observe f along x+tv. Differentiating twice in t for the preceding quadratic gives 2v₁²+6v₂²=vᵀHv. Nonnegativity for every v defines PSD. This tests directions, not individual entries. For column a=(a₁,a₂), the outer product aaᵀ=[[a₁²,a₁a₂],[a₁a₂,a₂²]], whereas aᵀa=a₁²+a₂² is a scalar.

对 L=log(eˣ¹+eˣ²)，原点 Hessian 为下式。v=(1,1) 给零曲率：同时提高两个分数，L 只线性增加；v=(1,−1) 给曲率 1，说明拉开两个分数会产生弯曲。For L=log(eˣ¹+eˣ²), the origin Hessian is below. Direction (1,1) has zero curvature: increasing both scores makes L increase linearly. Direction (1,−1) has curvature 1, showing bending when scores separate.

掌握Mastery

商法则、中心化与全部零方向Quotient rule, centering and all null directions

沿用上一节 sᵢ、S、pᵢ 和 ā。pᵢ 的分子、分母都随 x 变化，必须同时求导。商法则和 ∇S=Sā 给：Use the preceding sᵢ,S,pᵢ,ā. Both numerator and denominator of pᵢ vary with x. The quotient rule and ∇S=Sā give:

梯度 Σpᵢaᵢ 中 aᵢ 固定，只有 pᵢ 变化。按列梯度约定，对第 j 个梯度分量求第 k 个偏导，得到 Σᵢ(aᵢ)ⱼ(∇pᵢ)ₖ；所以矩阵是 Σᵢaᵢ(∇pᵢ)ᵀ：In gradient Σpᵢaᵢ, each aᵢ is fixed. Differentiating gradient component j with respect to coordinate k gives Σᵢ(aᵢ)ⱼ(∇pᵢ)ₖ. Thus the matrix uses outer products aᵢ(∇pᵢ)ᵀ:

现在验证中心化形式。展开后，两项交叉和各为 −āāᵀ，最后一项因 Σpᵢ=1 为 +āāᵀ，恰好合并成上式：To check the centered form, expand it. Each cross sum is −āāᵀ and the final sum is +āāᵀ because Σpᵢ=1, leaving the preceding expression:

任取 v∈Rⁿ，把 H 夹在 vᵀ、v 之间，每个外积变成平方：For arbitrary v∈Rⁿ, sandwich H between vᵀ and v. Each outer product becomes a square:

有限 x 下每个 pᵢ>0，所以和为零当且仅当每项平方为零。这等价于所有 aᵢᵀv 相同：若都等于 c，其加权平均 āᵀv 也为 c；反向由每个值都等于平均立即成立。于是全部零方向是：At finite x every pᵢ>0, so the sum vanishes exactly when every square vanishes. Equivalently all aᵢᵀv coincide: a common value c equals their weighted average āᵀv, and the reverse implication follows directly. Hence all null directions are:

最后一式与 x 无关，并包含 v=0。m=1 时没有差向量限制，所有方向都为零。H 正定当且仅当差向量 aᵢ−a₁ 张成 Rⁿ；只检查 aᵢ 是否张成空间会误判。平方和也可解释为加权方差，但非负性已由平方直接证明。The last set is independent of x and includes v=0. For m=1 all directions are null. H is positive definite exactly when the differences aᵢ−a₁ span Rⁿ; spanning by aᵢ alone is insufficient. The sum can also be interpreted as a weighted variance, but squares already prove nonnegativity.

19 · 仿射集与仿射包19 · Affine sets and affine combinations

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.4-8 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.1.1–2.1.3 · HW1 3(a)

学完应能：区别线性组合与仿射组合；证明线性方程解集仿射。Learning goal: explain s and affine combinations and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

保留整条直线；非空仿射集是子空间的平移。Affine sets retain whole lines. Nonempty ones are translated subspaces.

了解Understand

仿射集包含任意两点所确定的整条直线：θx+(1−θ)y 对所有实数 θ 都在其中。例如 x₂=1 是横轴的平移，不含原点仍仿射。非空仿射集可写 x₀+V，V 为方向子空间；aff S 是包含 S 的最小仿射集。An affine set contains θx+(1−θ)y for every real θ. The line x₂=1 is a translated horizontal subspace, affine without containing zero. Any nonempty affine set is x₀+V for a direction subspace V; aff S is the smallest affine set containing S.

等式 Ax=b 的解集就是仿射集。只允许 θ∈[0,1] 时，得到较弱的凸性要求：线段留在集合中即可。The solution set of Ax=b is affine. Restricting θ to [0,1] gives the weaker convexity requirement: retain the segment between points.

线性组合的系数无条件；仿射组合只要求和为 1；凸组合还要求非负；锥组合只要求非负、无须和为 1。给同样两点选不同系数，得到的直线、线段或射线才会不同。Linear combinations have unrestricted coefficients; affine combinations sum to 1; convex combinations also require nonnegativity; conic combinations require only nonnegativity. These coefficient restrictions distinguish lines, segments and cones.

掌握Mastery

若 Ax=Ay=b，则 A(θx+(1−θ)y)=θb+(1−θ)b=b，对全部实 θ 成立。无解时为空集，凸性按定义仍成立。If Ax=Ay=b, then A(θx+(1−θ)y)=b for every real θ. An empty solution set is also convex by the definition.

若 Ax=Ay=b，则 A(θx+(1−θ)y)=θb+(1−θ)b=b，对全部实 θ 成立。无解时为空集，凸性按定义仍成立。If Ax=Ay=b, then A(θx+(1−θ)y)=b for every real θ. An empty solution set is also convex by the definition.

它是 x₁+x₂=1，原点不满足等式，因此不在其中。It is x₁+x₂=1, which excludes zero.

线段的仿射包是一条直线；相对内部在该直线上计算，去掉两个端点。A segment's affine hull is a line; relative interior is computed there and omits the endpoints.

20 · 凸集、凸包、锥与锥包20 · Convex sets, hulls and cones

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.9-12 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.1.4–2.1.5 · HW1 3,5(a)

学完应能：按系数条件区分四种组合；直接从定义证明凸性。Learning goal: explain s, hulls and cones and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸组合用非负且和为 1 的权重；凸锥允许任意非负组合。Convex combinations have nonnegative weights summing to 1; convex cones allow all nonnegative combinations.

了解Understand

凸组合要求权重 θᵢ≥0、Σθᵢ=1；conv S 收集 S 中点的有限凸组合。三点 (0,0)、(2,0)、(0,2) 的是填满的三角形，例如权重 (1/2,1/4,1/4) 给内部点 (1/2,1/2)。A convex combination has θᵢ≥0 and Σθᵢ=1. The collects finite such combinations. For (0,0),(2,0),(0,2) it is the filled triangle: weights (1/2,1/4,1/4) give interior point (1/2,1/2).

锥允许非负缩放，凸锥还对加法封闭，因此非负组合都留在其中，无须权重和为 1。它允许规模改变。无限混合另需收敛条件：闭凸集中的有限凸组合若收敛，极限仍在集合内。A cone allows nonnegative scaling; a convex cone also allows addition, hence any nonnegative combination without requiring weights to sum to 1. Infinite mixtures need convergence: a closed convex set retains limits of finite convex combinations.

有限凸组合封闭性是对点数的归纳。一个点在集合内；若前 k−1 点的归一化平均 y 在集合内，则与第 k 点再次做两点混合。最后权重为 1 时只剩末点，不进行除法。第 36 节将把同一结构用于函数值。Finite-combination closure is induction on point count. One point belongs to the set. Mix the normalized average of the first k−1 points with the final point. If the final weight is 1, only that point remains and no division is used. Unit 36 applies this structure to function values.

掌握Mastery

有限组合由两点定义归纳：末项权重 t<1 时，将其余权重除以 1−t，先混合成一点，再以权重 t 加末点；t=1 时只有末点。Induct on the number of points. For last weight t<1, normalize the others by 1−t, mix them first, then mix with the last point. If t=1 only that point remains.

速通Quick

半空间、范数球与椭球均凸；欧氏距离比较可化为半空间。Halfspaces, norm balls and ellipsoids are convex. Euclidean distance comparison gives a halfspace.

aᵀx=b 的法向为非零 a，半空间 aᵀx≤b 取其中一侧。用测试点判断方向：2x₁+x₂≤4 含原点。A hyperplane aᵀx=b has nonzero normal a; a halfspace aᵀx≤b takes one side. Test a point to identify the side: 2x₁+x₂≤4 contains zero.

范数球 {x:‖x−c‖≤r} 在 r≥0 时凸，因混合点到 c 的距离≤两距离的加权平均。椭球是欧氏球的仿射像；映射退化时可压成低维集合。A norm ball {x:‖x−c‖≤r}, r≥0, is convex because the mixture distance is bounded by the weighted distances. Ellipsoids are affine images of Euclidean balls, possibly lower-dimensional under a singular map.

“离 a 不比离 b 远”平方展开后，xᵀx 消去，变成 2(b−a)ᵀx≤‖b‖²−‖a‖²。例如 a=(0,0)、b=(2,0) 给 x₁≤1。Squaring ‖x−a‖≤‖x−b‖ cancels xᵀx and gives 2(b−a)ᵀx≤‖b‖²−‖a‖². For a=(0,0),b=(2,0), this is x₁≤1.

掌握Mastery

三个集合证明的起手式Starting three set proofs

任取 u、v∈C，θ∈[0,1]，令 w=θu+(1−θ)v。在线性等式集，直接代入：Aw=θAu+(1−θ)Av=θb+(1−θ)b=b，所以 w∈C。A 不必可逆；若解集为空，就不存在需要反驳的两点，凸性按定义成立。Choose arbitrary u,v∈C and θ∈[0,1], and put w=θu+(1−θ)v. For Ax=b, substitute: Aw=θAu+(1−θ)Av=b. Thus w∈C. A need not be invertible. An empty solution set has no pair violating the definition and is convex.

球心为 c∈Rⁿ、半径 r≥0 时，先将混合点减球心。因为两系数和为 1，w−c=θ(u−c)+(1−θ)(v−c)。齐次性与三角不等式依次给：For center c∈Rⁿ and radius r≥0, first subtract the center. Since the coefficients sum to 1, w−c=θ(u−c)+(1−θ)(v−c). Homogeneity and the triangle inequality yield:

例如 a=(−1,1)、b=(2,0)，法向为 (6,−2)，右侧为 2。代入 a 得 −8≤2，代入 b 得 12>2，方向正确。半空间的线性左端在混合后仍≤同一右端，因此凸；a≠b 保证法向非零。For a=(−1,1), b=(2,0), the normal is (6,−2) and the bound 2. Testing a gives −8≤2, while b gives 12>2, confirming the side. Mixing two points preserves the linear bound, proving convexity. The condition a≠b makes the normal nonzero.

31 · 凸函数、严格凸与扩展值31 · Convex functions and extended values

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.4-9 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.1–3.1.2 · HW1 4基础

学完应能：同时检查定义域凸性与函数不等式；解释域外 +∞。Learning goal: explain convex functions and extended values and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸函数的混合值不超过端点加权值；严格凸至多一个最优点。A convex function bounds mixture values by weighted endpoint values. Strict convexity gives at most one optimizer.

了解Understand

凸函数比较两种顺序：先混合输入所得函数值，不超过先求值再混合的结果。对 x²，−1、3 的中点 1 给值 1，小于端点平均 5。定义域也须凸；仿射函数总取等，既凸又凹。A convex function's value at a mixture is no greater than the mixture of values. For x², the midpoint 1 of −1 and 3 has value 1, below the endpoint average 5. The domain must be convex; affine functions attain equality and are both convex and concave.

扩展值把定义域外设为 +∞。集合示性函数 δC 在 C 内为 0、外为 +∞，把约束 x∈C 写入目标 f+δC；它与概率中的 0–1 指示函数含义不同。Extended values set forbidden inputs to +∞. The indicator δC is 0 inside C and +∞ outside, incorporating x∈C into f+δC. It differs from a probability 0–1 indicator.

严格凸和最优点唯一性的条件Strict convexity and uniqueness assumptions

定义域 D 须为凸集。f 严格凸指任意不同 x,y∈D 和任意 0<θ<1，下式严格成立。端点 θ=0、1 本来就取等，不放入严格要求。The domain D must be convex. Strict convexity means the following strict inequality for every distinct x,y∈D and every 0<θ<1. Endpoints θ=0,1 necessarily give equality and are excluded.

在凸可行集 C⊆D 上，严格凸函数至多有一个最优点。如果存在两个不同最优点 x、y，凸性保证中点仍可行；严格凸性又使中点费用小于两个最优费用的平均，矛盾。这里证明的是“至多一个”，还没有证明存在。On a convex feasible set C⊆D, a strictly convex function has at most one optimizer. Two distinct optimizers would have a feasible midpoint by convexity of C, while strict convexity would give it a lower cost, a contradiction. This proves at most one, without proving existence.

条件不能省：x² 在非凸可行集 {−1,1} 上有两个最优点；eˣ 在整个实轴严格凸，却只有下确界 0，没有最小化点。The assumptions matter: x² has two minimizers on the nonconvex feasible set {−1,1}; eˣ is strictly convex on R but has only an unattained infimum 0.

掌握Mastery

在凸可行集上，严格凸函数若有两个不同最优点，中点仍可行，严格凸定义使其中点费用更低，矛盾。仅得到至多一个，不保证存在。On a convex feasible set, two distinct minimizers of a strictly convex function would have a feasible midpoint of smaller cost. This proves at most one, not existence.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=|x| 是严格凸函数吗？Is |x| strictly convex?

思路提示Hint

32 · 一阶条件：切线是全局下界32 · First-order characterization and optimality

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.10-15 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：推导一阶判定的两个方向；解释导数存在的前提。Learning goal: explain first-order characterization and optimality and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

可微凸函数的切平面给全局下界。A differentiable convex function's tangent plane is a global lower bound.

了解Understand

可微凸函数的切平面是全局下界：f(y)≥f(x)+∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)。例如 x² 在 1 的切线为 2y−1，差为 (y−1)²≥0。它把局部梯度变成对所有点的比较。A differentiable convex function has global tangent bound f(y)≥f(x)+∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x). For x² at 1, the tangent is 2y−1 and the gap is (y−1)²≥0. Local gradients thus compare all points.

无约束时 ∇f(x*)=0 即保证全局最优；有凸约束 C 时，应改为 ∇f(x*)ᵀ(y−x*)≥0 对所有 y∈C。例如在 x≥1 上最小化 x²，最优点 1 的导数仍为 2。Without constraints, ∇f(x*)=0 ensures global optimality. On convex C, the condition is ∇f(x*)ᵀ(y−x*)≥0 for all y∈C. Thus minimizing x² on x≥1 gives optimizer 1 despite derivative 2.

约束最优点的梯度为什么可以不为零Why a constrained optimizer can have nonzero gradient

在 C=[1,∞) 上最小化 f(x)=x²。任意 y∈C 都有 y²≥1，所以 x*=1 最优；梯度 f′(1)=2。向左才会降低费用，但向左立即离开 C。对每个可行 y，一阶变化 2(y−1)≥0；这正是约束一阶条件的含义。Minimize x² on C=[1,∞). Every feasible y has y²≥1, so x*=1 is optimal although f′(1)=2. Moving left would decrease cost but immediately leave C. For every feasible y, 2(y−1)≥0; this is the constrained first-order condition.

该条件对凸可行集上、在包含 C 的开放域可微的凸函数既必要又充分。充分性来自切平面下界；必要性来自沿任意可行线段从最优点出发的右导数不能为负。For a convex differentiable function on an open domain containing convex C, the condition is necessary and sufficient. Sufficiency uses the tangent lower bound. Necessity follows because the right derivative along every feasible segment from an optimizer cannot be negative.

掌握Mastery

凸性给 [f(x+t(y−x))−f(x)]/t≤f(y)−f(x)，令 t↓0 得切平面界。反向在混合点对两端用此界，按权重相加，梯度项抵消，即得凸性。Convexity bounds the difference quotient by f(y)−f(x); let t↓0 to obtain the tangent bound. Conversely, apply that bound at a mixture to both endpoints and weight the results; gradient terms cancel, proving convexity.

凸性给 [f(x+t(y−x))−f(x)]/t≤f(y)−f(x)，令 t↓0 得切平面界。反向在混合点对两端用此界，按权重相加，梯度项抵消，即得凸性。Convexity bounds the difference quotient by f(y)−f(x); let t↓0 to obtain the tangent bound. Conversely, apply that bound at a mixture to both endpoints and weight the results; gradient terms cancel, proving convexity.

在 x=3 为零。凸性下界给 f(y)≥f(3)=0，因此它全局最优。It vanishes at three; the convex lower bound gives f(y)≥f(3)=0 for all y.

速通Quick

Jensen 将两点凸性推广到有限凸组合。Jensen extends two-point convexity to finite convex combinations.

了解Understand

Jensen 把两点凸性推广到 θᵢ≥0、Σθᵢ=1 的有限平均。以平方函数、观测 1、3、等权为例，均值平方 4≤平方均值 5。差值来自数据的波动。Jensen extends two-point convexity to finite averages with θᵢ≥0,Σθᵢ=1. For readings 1,3 with equal weights, the squared mean 4 is below the mean square 5; the gap measures variation.

所有输入须在凸定义域中；凹函数的不等号反向。严格凸且权重正时，取等须输入相同。作业 4(c) 可用有限版本，随机变量版本还需期望有意义。All inputs must lie in a convex domain; concavity reverses the inequality. Strict convexity and positive weights require equal inputs for equality. The finite version covers HW1 4(c); random-variable versions also require meaningful expectations.

三个点先分组，再做两次混合Group three points into two successive mixtures

先取三个权重 (1/2,1/3,1/6)。前两项的总权重为 5/6，内部归一化后为 3/5、2/5。令 y=(3/5)x₁+(2/5)x₂，则原平均等于 (5/6)y+(1/6)x₃。因为 D 凸，y∈D，这使下一次使用 f(y) 合法。Take weights (1/2,1/3,1/6). The first two sum to 5/6; their normalized weights are 3/5 and 2/5. Let y=(3/5)x₁+(2/5)x₂. The original average is (5/6)y+(1/6)x₃. Convexity of D gives y∈D, making f(y) legitimate.

第一次不等式对 y、x₃ 使用两点凸性，第二次对 x₁、x₂ 使用。具体取 f=x²、x₁=0、x₂=3、x₃=6：平均输入为 2，左边为 4，右边为 9。数值核对说明这组数据，下面的归纳才证明任意点数。The first inequality uses two-point convexity for y,x₃ and the second for x₁,x₂. For f=x² and inputs 0,3,6, the averaged input is 2 and 4≤9. This checks one data set; induction below proves arbitrary finite mixtures.

Assume the inequality for any k−1 points and normalized nonnegative weights. For k points, t=1 gives equality f(xₖ). Restoring the original weights completes induction. Zero weights may remain. Normalization by 1−t fails only at t=1, already handled separately.

25 · proper cone 与广义不等式25 · Proper cones and generalized inequalities

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.42-46 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.4.1 · HW1 5(a),5(c)

学完应能：逐一检查凸、闭、实心、尖；直接证明锥诱导关系传递。Learning goal: explain s and generalized inequalities and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

闭、凸、尖且内部非空；差落在锥内定义广义序。A proper cone is closed, convex, pointed and solid; cone membership of differences defines order.

了解Understand

选锥 K 表示“非负变化”，定义 x⪯K y 为 y−x∈K。非负正交象限给逐分量序，PSD 锥给矩阵序。两点可能无法比较，如 (1,0)、(0,1)。Choose cone K to represent nonnegative changes and define x⪯K y by y−x∈K. The nonnegative orthant gives componentwise order; the PSD cone gives matrix order. Points such as (1,0),(0,1) can be incomparable.

正常锥须闭、凸、内部非空且尖。尖性 K∩(−K)={0} 保证反对称性；严格序要求差在 int K。 K={(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t} 把 t 看作预算，内部为 ‖x‖₂<t。A proper cone is closed, convex, solid and pointed. Pointedness K∩(−K)={0} ensures antisymmetry; strict order uses int K. The {(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t} models budget t, with strict inequality in its interior.

先看逐分量序：u≤v 只要求每个 uᵢ≤vᵢ，(1,3) 与 (2,2) 不可比较。一般锥序用差向量是否在锥内代替逐项检查；严格锥序使用内部。正常锥的四个条件各有作用，不要将“尖”误读成几何外观。In componentwise order u≤v requires uᵢ≤vᵢ for every i; (1,3) and (2,2) are incomparable. Cone order tests whether the difference is in the cone, with interior for strict order. Each properness condition has a distinct role; is an algebraic condition.

掌握Mastery

逐条证明二阶锥的性质Prove the SOC properties one at a time

记 K={(x,t)∈Rⁿ×R:‖x‖₂≤t}。t 是长度预算，必非负。α≥0 时 ‖αx‖₂=α‖x‖₂≤αt，故它是锥。对锥内 (x,t)、(y,s)，三角不等式给 ‖θx+(1−θ)y‖₂≤θt+(1−θ)s，所以它凸。Let K={(x,t)∈Rⁿ×R:‖x‖₂≤t}. The budget t must be nonnegative. For α≥0, ‖αx‖₂≤αt, proving the cone property. For two members, the triangle inequality gives ‖θx+(1−θ)y‖₂≤θt+(1−θ)s, proving convexity.

闭性要检验极限：取任意锥内收敛序列 (xⱼ,tⱼ)→(x,t)。三角不等式先给 ‖x‖₂≤‖x−xⱼ‖₂+‖xⱼ‖₂≤‖x−xⱼ‖₂+tⱼ。右侧趋于 t，所以 ‖x‖₂≤t，极限仍在 K。For closedness take any convergent sequence (xⱼ,tⱼ)→(x,t) in K. First use ‖x‖₂≤‖x−xⱼ‖₂+‖xⱼ‖₂≤‖x−xⱼ‖₂+tⱼ. The right side tends to t, so the limit satisfies ‖x‖₂≤t and remains in K.

内部非空要给真正的邻域。在环境空间 Rⁿ⁺¹，取以 (0,1) 为中心、半径 1/2 的欧氏开球。球内点满足 √(‖x‖₂²+(t−1)²)<1/2，故 ‖x‖₂<1/2 且 t>1/2，因而 ‖x‖₂For nonempty interior give an actual neighborhood in ambient Rⁿ⁺¹: the open Euclidean ball of radius 1/2 centered at (0,1). Inside it, √(‖x‖₂²+(t−1)²)<1/2 implies ‖x‖₂<1/2

排除双向非零线：若 (x,t) 和 (−x,−t) 同在 K，则 ‖x‖₂≤t 且 ‖x‖₂≤−t。相加得 2‖x‖₂≤0，所以 x=0，再由 0≤t≤0 得 t=0。凸、闭、内部非空、尖四项都已证明，因此 K 是 proper cone（正常锥）。For pointedness suppose both (x,t) and (−x,−t) belong to K. Then ‖x‖₂≤t and ‖x‖₂≤−t. Adding gives x=0, then 0≤t≤0 gives t=0. Convexity, closedness, nonempty interior and pointedness prove that K is a proper cone.

取任意两点和任意混合权重，把集合条件代入；集合相等须两向。Choose arbitrary points and a weight, substitute the membership condition; equality of sets needs both inclusions.

For α≥0, ‖αx‖₂≤αt, proving the cone property. For two members, the triangle inequality gives ‖θx+(1−θ)y‖₂≤θt+(1−θ)s, proving convexity.

展开核对Check the answer

前者差为 (1,1)，在内部；后者差为 (0,1)，在边界，因此只有前者严格。The first difference (1,1) is interior. The second (0,1) is on the boundary, so only the first is strict.

29 · 对偶锥与二阶锥的自对偶29 · Dual cones and self-duality of the second-order cone

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.60-65 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.6.1 · HW1 5(b)

学完应能：做包含关系的双向证明；构造违约向量；用对偶范数解释范数锥。Learning goal: explain dual cones and self-duality of the second-order cone and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

对偶锥收集与原锥全部点内积非负的权重。The dual cone contains weights pairing nonnegatively with every primal-cone point.

了解Understand

对偶锥 K* 收集满足 λᵀx≥0 对所有 x∈K 的权重 λ。若 y−x∈K，则每个这样的评分都判定 λᵀy≥λᵀx，把向量序转成标量不等式。The dual cone K* collects weights λ with λᵀx≥0 for all x∈K. Thus y−x∈K implies λᵀy≥λᵀx for every dual weight, converting vector order to scalar tests.

非负正交象限自对偶：非负权重通过全部测试，若 λᵢ<0，则坐标单位向量 eᵢ 给 λᵀeᵢ<0，检出不合格权重。对偶锥总为闭凸集，因为它是闭半空间的交；K₁⊂K₂ 时 K₂*⊂K₁*。The nonnegative orthant is self-dual: nonnegative weights pass, while a negative entry λᵢ is detected by λᵀeᵢ<0. Dual cones are intersections of closed halfspaces, hence closed and convex. Inclusion reverses: K₁⊂K₂ implies K₂*⊂K₁*.

子空间的对偶锥是正交补，因为 v、−v 的测试迫使内积为零。闭凸锥有 K**=K；一般锥的双对偶为闭凸锥包。A subspace's dual cone is its orthogonal complement, since tests at v and −v force zero. A closed convex cone satisfies K**=K; generally the bidual is the closed convex conic hull.

对偶锥定义中的“所有 x”使构造测试点成为关键：要排除一个候选 y，只需找一个锥内 x 使内积负；要证明候选合格，则须对任意锥内 x 给非负估计。The “every x” in a dual cone makes test vectors crucial. To reject a candidate y, one negative pairing with a cone point suffices. To accept y, prove a nonnegative bound for arbitrary cone points.

掌握Mastery

自对偶：两向包含和测试点的选择Self-duality: two inclusions and test-point construction

使用标准内积 yᵀx+st，K* 要求它对所有 (x,t)∈K 非负。先取 (y,s)∈K，再任取 (x,t)∈K。Cauchy–Schwarz 的下界给 yᵀx≥−‖y‖₂‖x‖₂。因 s,t≥0 且 s≥‖y‖₂、t≥‖x‖₂，所以 st≥‖y‖₂‖x‖₂，内积非负。由任意性，K⊆K*。Under standard pairing yᵀx+st, membership in K* requires nonnegativity for every (x,t)∈K. Take (y,s)∈K and arbitrary (x,t)∈K. Cauchy–Schwarz gives yᵀx≥−‖y‖₂‖x‖₂. Since s,t≥0 and dominate those lengths, st≥‖y‖₂‖x‖₂. The sum is nonnegative, proving K⊆K*.

反向取 (y,s)∈K*。先测试锥内点 (0,1)，得到 s≥0。若 y≠0，想让 yᵀx 尽量负，就令 x 与 y 反向、长度为 1，同时取 t=1，使测试点刚好在锥边界：Conversely take (y,s)∈K*. Test (0,1)∈K to get s≥0. For y≠0, make yᵀx as negative as possible by choosing a unit x opposite y. Set t=1 so the test point lies on the cone boundary:

于是 s≥‖y‖₂；y=0 时这个结论已由 s≥0 给出，无须归一化。故 K*⊆K，两向合并得自对偶。测试 (0,1) 也解释了为何负 s 不可能被漏掉。Thus s≥‖y‖₂. For y=0 this already follows from s≥0 without normalization. Hence K*⊆K and the two inclusions establish self-duality. The first test also rules out every negative s.

思路提示Hint

取任意两点和任意混合权重，把集合条件代入；集合相等须两向。Choose arbitrary points and a weight, substitute the membership condition; equality of sets needs both inclusions.

使用标准内积 yᵀx+st，K* 要求它对所有 (x,t)∈K 非负。先取 (y,s)∈K，再任取 (x,t)∈K。Cauchy–Schwarz 的下界给 yᵀx≥−‖y‖₂‖x‖₂。因 s,t≥0 且 s≥‖y‖₂、t≥‖x‖₂，所以 st≥‖y‖₂‖x‖₂，内积非负。由任意性，K⊆K*。Under standard pairing yᵀx+st, membership in K* requires nonnegativity for every (x,t)∈K. Take (y,s)∈K and arbitrary (x,t)∈K. Cauchy–Schwarz gives yᵀx≥−‖y‖₂‖x‖₂. Since s,t≥0 and dominate those lengths, st≥‖y‖₂‖x‖₂. The sum is nonnegative, proving K⊆K*.

深入In depth

PSD 锥在迹内积下自对偶：半正定矩阵配对非负；负特征方向 v 用 vvᵀ 检出。The PSD cone is self-dual under trace pairing: PSD pairs are nonnegative, and vvᵀ detects a negative eigenvector v.

30 · 偏序的对偶刻画与 Pareto 前沿30 · Dual weights, order tests and Pareto frontiers

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.66-74 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.6.2–2.6.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用正权重标量化理解最小元、极小元及生产前沿。Learning goal: explain dual weights, order tests and pareto frontiers and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

Pareto 极小点未被支配；严格正权重最优给出极小方案。Pareto-minimal points are undominated. Strictly positive weighted minimization yields minimal alternatives.

了解Understand

费用和误差同时最小时，方案可能各有优劣。没有另一方案在全部目标不差且至少一项更好的点，称 Pareto 极小点，构成权衡前沿。选严格正权重做加权和最小化，所得最优点必为 Pareto 极小。When minimizing cost and error, alternatives can trade off. A Pareto-minimal point has no alternative at least as good in every objective and better in one. Minimizing a strictly positively weighted sum yields a Pareto-minimal point.

一般锥序中，最小元素须对全部 λ∈K* 同时最小化 λᵀx；内点对偶权重的最优点必极小。凸集合的极小点有非零对偶权重支撑，但权重未必在内部。For cone order, a minimum minimizes λᵀx for every λ∈K*. Minimization with an interior dual weight gives a minimal point. Minimal points of convex sets admit nonzero dual supporting weights, possibly on the dual boundary.

作业 5(c)：二阶锥序 (x,t)⪯K(y,s) 就是 ‖y−x‖≤s−t，表示空间变化不超过预算增加量。In HW1 5(c), SOC order (x,t)⪯K(y,s) means ‖y−x‖≤s−t: displacement cannot exceed the budget increase.

加权和最优点存在是另一个前提。严格正权重给“若取得，则所得方案极小”；它不能保证每一个 Pareto 点都能由某个严格正权重得到。Existence of a weighted-sum optimizer is separate. Strictly positive weights imply that an attained optimizer is minimal; they do not guarantee recovery of every Pareto point.

掌握Mastery

从差向量写出传递性Derive transitivity from differences

定义 (x,t)⪯K(y,s) 当且仅当 (y−x,s−t)∈K，所以它等价于 ‖y−x‖₂≤s−t。设再有 (y,s)⪯K(z,r)，即 ‖z−y‖₂≤r−s。将第三点和第一点的差拆成两段：By definition (x,t)⪯K(y,s) iff (y−x,s−t)∈K, equivalently ‖y−x‖₂≤s−t. Suppose also (y,s)⪯K(z,r), meaning ‖z−y‖₂≤r−s. Split the overall displacement into two segments:

最后一式正是 (x,t)⪯K(z,r)，因此传递性由三角不等式直接得到。没有要求三个空间向量共线。The last bound is exactly (x,t)⪯K(z,r), directly proving transitivity by the triangle inequality. The three spatial vectors need not be collinear.

独立练习Independent practice

为二阶锥 K 给出显式内部开球，用收敛序列证明闭性，另证凸性和尖性。给锥外点 ((3,4),4) 找锥内负内积测试点。最后合上正文，写自对偶双向证明与三点锥序传递性。Give an explicit interior ball of the SOC, prove closedness via sequences, and prove convexity and pointedness. Find a cone point pairing negatively with exterior point ((3,4),4). Then close the text and write both self-duality inclusions and direct three-point order transitivity.

思路提示Hint

开球用环境空间 Rⁿ⁺¹ 的欧氏距离。测试点把空间方向取反，预算取 1。Use Euclidean distance in ambient Rⁿ⁺¹ for the ball. Reverse the spatial direction for the test point and set budget 1.

关键步骤Key steps

‖(3,4)‖₂=5，所以取 ((−3/5,−4/5),1)。闭性先写 ‖x‖≤‖x−xⱼ‖+tⱼ，之后才取极限。The spatial norm is 5, suggesting ((−3/5,−4/5),1). For closedness first write ‖x‖≤‖x−xⱼ‖+tⱼ, then pass to the limit.

完整核对Full check

球 B((0,1),1/2) 中有 ‖x‖₂<1/2Inside B((0,1),1/2), ‖x‖₂<1/2

测试点长度为 1，故在 K 中，与 ((3,4),4) 配对为 −9/5−16/5+4=−1。自对偶正向用 −‖y‖‖x‖+st≥0；反向先用 (0,1) 得 s≥0，y≠0 再用 (−y/‖y‖,1) 得 s≥‖y‖，y=0 已处理。两向完整才可写 K*=K。The test has spatial norm 1 and is in K. Its pairing is −9/5−16/5+4=−1. Forward self-duality uses −‖y‖‖x‖+st≥0. In reverse first test (0,1) for s≥0, then if y≠0 test (−y/‖y‖,1) for s≥‖y‖; y=0 is already covered. Only after both inclusions conclude K*=K.

若前两段锥序成立，‖z−x‖≤‖z−y‖+‖y−x‖≤(r−s)+(s−t)=r−t，恰是第三段锥序。常见错误：只引用自对偶结论；用内部非空代替尖性；对 y=0 归一化。For two successive order relations, ‖z−x‖≤‖z−y‖+‖y−x‖≤(r−s)+(s−t)=r−t, giving the third. Common errors are merely citing self-duality, confusing interior with pointedness or normalizing y=0.

01 · 把实际问题写成优化模型01 · Turn a decision into an optimization model

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.4-11 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.1 · HW1 背景

学完应能：区分变量、目标、约束、与最优值；用拟合和投资例子建模。Learning goal: explain turn a decision into an optimization model and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

变量、目标、约束确定模型；先查可行性，再比较目标值。Variables, objective and constraints specify a model. Check feasibility before cost.

了解Understand

买两种食品，数量为 x₁、x₂，单价为 3、2，每份蛋白质为 2、1。要以最低费用获得至少 4 单位蛋白质，就最小化 3x₁+2x₂，约束 2x₁+x₂≥4、x₁,x₂≥0。数量是变量，其余是数据；允许小数份时，这是连续模型。Two foods have quantities x₁,x₂, prices 3,2 and protein contents 2,1 per serving. Minimize cost 3x₁+2x₂ subject to 2x₁+x₂≥4 and x₁,x₂≥0. Quantities are variables; the other numbers are data. Allowing fractional servings gives a continuous model.

先判断可行，再比较费用：(2,0) 费用为 6；(1,1) 虽只需 5，却不满足营养要求。记最优点为 x*，为 p*。本例由 3x₁+2x₂≥1.5(2x₁+x₂)≥6，知 (2,0) 最优。Check feasibility before cost: (2,0) costs 6; (1,1) costs 5 but fails the nutrition requirement. Write x* for an optimizer and p* for the . Since 3x₁+2x₂≥1.5(2x₁+x₂)≥6, (2,0) is optimal.

同一模板可描述拟合和投资：误差或风险作为目标，参数范围或收益要求作为约束。模型仍可能无解：可行集为空称不可行；目标可降至 −∞ 称无下界；在 x>0 上最小化 x，值为 0 却没有点取到它。The same template models fitting or investment: minimize error or risk under parameter or return constraints. An empty feasible set is infeasible; arbitrarily negative cost is unbounded below. Minimizing x over x>0 has value 0 but no point attaining it.

本例费用下界第一步用 x₂≥0：两边之差是 x₂/2；第二步用蛋白质约束。x=(2,0) 同时满足所有约束并使两步取等，这才将“下界”确认为“最优值”。The first cost bound uses x₂≥0: its gap is x₂/2. The second uses the protein constraint. Point (2,0) is feasible and attains equality in both steps, identifying the bound as the optimal value.

掌握Mastery

一般问题在可行集 C 上最小化 f₀。证明 x* 最优需要两件事：x*∈C，且所有 x∈C 都满足 f₀(x)≥f₀(x*)。上面的费用下界正好完成第二步。To prove x* minimizes f₀ on C, show x*∈C and f₀(x)≥f₀(x*) for every x∈C. The cost bound above establishes the second requirement.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

把“至少 4 单位蛋白质”改成“恰好 4 单位”，(0,5) 还可行吗？上述最优点会改变吗？Replace at least four protein units by exactly four. Is (0,5) still feasible? Does the optimizer change?

思路提示Hint

先分清变量、可行性和费用；用一个统一界比较所有候选。Separate variables, feasibility and costs; compare all candidates with a uniform bound.

关键步骤Key steps

一般问题在可行集 C 上最小化 f₀。证明 x* 最优需要两件事：x*∈C，且所有 x∈C 都满足 f₀(x)≥f₀(x*)。上面的费用下界正好完成第二步。To prove x* minimizes f₀ on C, show x*∈C and f₀(x)≥f₀(x*) for every x∈C. The cost bound above establishes the second requirement.

展开核对Check the answer

(0,5) 不满足等式。原下界证明仍适用，(2,0) 仍可行并取得 6，因此最优值和最优点不变。The point (0,5) violates the equality. The same lower bound applies, and (2,0) remains feasible and attains six, so the optimal value and optimizer stay the same.

深入In depth

最优值是可行目标值的下确界，即最大下界。存在有限下确界仍可能没有最优点，须另查是否取得。The optimal value is the infimum of feasible costs: their greatest lower bound. A finite infimum need not be attained.
