02 · 最小二乘：怎样选出一个最佳预测02 · Least squares: how to choose one best prediction

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.13-17 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.2.1 · HW1 4(b)

学完应能：解释为什么用残差平方计分，用配方证明最佳常数，并把同一计算翻译成矩阵记号。Learning goal: explain squared-residual scoring, prove the best constant by completing the square, and translate that same calculation into matrix notation.

了解Understand

测量得到 1、2、6，希望用同一个数 x 作为预测。三项残差为 x−1、x−2、x−6，即预测值减观测值。直接相加会让正负误差抵消：x=3 时，残差为 2、1、−3，和为零，实际仍有偏差。Readings are 1,2,6, and we want one common prediction x. Residuals x−1,x−2,x−6 are prediction minus observation. Their signed sum can hide discrepancies: at x=3, residuals 2,1,−3 sum to zero despite nonzero errors.

最小二乘先平方再相加，以 F(x)=(x−1)²+(x−2)²+(x−6)² 比较候选值。平方使两种符号都贡献非负代价，并更重地惩罚大偏差。这里假定三次观测同等重要，x 可取任意实数；换用绝对值会得到另一种模型。Least squares compares candidates by F(x)=(x−1)²+(x−2)²+(x−6)². Squaring makes either sign contribute nonnegative cost and penalizes larger misses more heavily. The readings have equal importance and x may be any real number. Absolute-error scoring defines a different model.

例如 F(2)=17、F(3)=14，但试几个数还不能证明 3 最好。要比较全部实数，可把二次式配成平方：F(x)=3x²−18x+41=3(x−3)²+14。平方项非负，且仅在 x=3 时为零，所以最佳预测唯一为 3，最低平方和为 14。For example, F(2)=17 and F(3)=14, but testing candidates does not prove optimality. Complete the square to compare all real x: F(x)=3x²−18x+41=3(x−3)²+14. The squared term is nonnegative and vanishes only at 3. Thus 3 is the unique best prediction and 14 the minimum squared error.

最低分仍大于零，因为一个预测无法同时等于三个不同读数。“最佳”依据的是选定的计分规则，并不保证恢复未知真值。左图把预测 3 与数据比较，竖线表示残差大小；右图以候选 x 为横轴、F(x) 为纵轴，最低点是 (3,14)。Positive minimum error remains because one prediction cannot equal three different readings. Optimality is relative to the scoring rule and does not guarantee an unknown true value. In the left panel, vertical segments compare prediction 3 with the data. The right panel plots F against candidate x, with minimum (3,14).

观测很多时，可用矩阵收集同一运算。令列向量 b=(1,2,6)ᵀ、A=(1,1,1)ᵀ，则 Ax=(x,x,x)ᵀ，Ax−b 收集全部残差。欧氏范数 ‖r‖₂ 是各分量平方和的平方根，因此 ‖Ax−b‖₂²=F(x)。上标 T 表示转置。For many observations, matrix notation collects the same operations. Let columns b=(1,2,6)ᵀ and A=(1,1,1)ᵀ. Then Ax=(x,x,x)ᵀ and Ax−b contains the residuals. Euclidean norm ‖r‖₂ is the square root of the sum of squared components, so ‖Ax−b‖₂²=F(x). Superscript T denotes transpose.

本节只把矩阵记号当作收集三个相同预测的缩写。多参数求导放在第 33 节；首次自学先能解释残差、评分和配方证明即可。Here matrix notation only collects three identical predictions. Multiple-parameter differentiation is developed in unit 33. For a first reading, explain residuals, the score and the completed-square proof.

掌握Mastery

一般地，对 m≥1 个读数 bᵢ，记均值 b̄=(Σᵢbᵢ)/m，其中 Σᵢ 表示从 i=1 到 m 求和。把 x−bᵢ=(x−b̄)+(b̄−bᵢ) 平方相加，得到 Σᵢ(x−bᵢ)²=m(x−b̄)²+Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)²；交叉项 2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=0，因为 Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=mb̄−Σᵢbᵢ=0。For m≥1 readings bᵢ, let b̄=(Σᵢbᵢ)/m, where Σᵢ sums from 1 to m. Square x−bᵢ=(x−b̄)+(b̄−bᵢ) and sum to obtain Σᵢ(x−bᵢ)²=m(x−b̄)²+Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)². The cross term 2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ) vanishes since Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=mb̄−Σᵢbᵢ=0.

最后一项与 x 无关，第一项只在 x=b̄ 时取零，故最佳常数唯一等于均值。也可求导得 2(mx−Σᵢbᵢ)=0；上述平方分解说明这个驻点确实全局最优。The last term is independent of x; the first vanishes only at x=b̄. Hence the mean is uniquely optimal. Differentiation also gives 2(mx−Σᵢbᵢ)=0; the square decomposition proves that stationary point is globally optimal.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

用同样方法处理观测 0、2、4：先比较候选值 1、2、3，再把平方和配方。写清最佳选择和最低分各是什么。For readings 0,2,4, compare candidate constants 1,2,3, then complete the square. Distinguish the best constant from the minimum score.

思路提示Hint

先分清变量、可行性和费用；用一个统一界比较所有候选。Separate variables, feasibility and costs; compare all candidates with a uniform bound.

关键步骤Key steps

一般地，对 m≥1 个读数 bᵢ，记均值 b̄=(Σᵢbᵢ)/m，其中 Σᵢ 表示从 i=1 到 m 求和。把 x−bᵢ=(x−b̄)+(b̄−bᵢ) 平方相加，得到 Σᵢ(x−bᵢ)²=m(x−b̄)²+Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)²；交叉项 2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=0，因为 Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=mb̄−Σᵢbᵢ=0。For m≥1 readings bᵢ, let b̄=(Σᵢbᵢ)/m, where Σᵢ sums from 1 to m. Square x−bᵢ=(x−b̄)+(b̄−bᵢ) and sum to obtain Σᵢ(x−bᵢ)²=m(x−b̄)²+Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)². The cross term 2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ) vanishes since Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=mb̄−Σᵢbᵢ=0.

展开核对Check the answer

候选值 1、2、3 的平方和分别为 11、8、11。全部候选的分数为 x²+(x−2)²+(x−4)²=3(x−2)²+8，因此最佳常数为 2，最低平方误差总和为 8。比较候选只提供线索，配方给出对所有实数 x 的证明。The candidate scores are eleven, eight and eleven. For every real x, x²+(x−2)²+(x−4)²=3(x−2)²+8. Thus the best constant is two and minimum score eight. Candidate comparisons suggest the result; completion of squares proves it for all real x.

深入In depth

多参数模型用向量 x 给出预测 Ax。学完和矩阵求导后，可得到正规方程 Aᵀ(Ax−b)=0：残差与所有可调预测方向正交。本节它简化为 3x−9=0，仍给出 x=3。非零 h 若满足 Ah=0，x 与 x+h 预测相同，参数便可能不唯一。In a multiple-parameter model, vector x gives predictions Ax. Inner products and matrix differentiation yield Aᵀ(Ax−b)=0: the residual is orthogonal to adjustable prediction directions. Here it reduces to 3x−9=0 and again gives x=3. If a nonzero h satisfies Ah=0, x and x+h predict identically, allowing nonunique parameters.

速通Quick

残差先平方后求和；拟合 1、2、6 的最佳常数为 3，最低平方和 14。Square and sum residuals. The best constant fit to 1,2,6 is 3, with error 14.

03 · 线性规划与等价改写03 · Linear programming and equivalent formulations

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.19-21 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.2.2 · HW1 背景

学完应能：识别线性目标和约束；用辅助变量处理绝对值。Learning goal: explain and equivalent formulations and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

线性规划使用仿射目标与约束；辅助变量可表示和绝对值。LPs use affine objectives and constraints. Auxiliary variables represent maxima and absolute values.

了解Understand

的目标和约束均为仿射式，如 2x+3；“仿射”允许常数项。可行集由半空间、超平面的交组成。二维中把目标的平行等值线向费用降低的一侧移动，可以看出最优位置。Linear programs have affine objectives and constraints, such as 2x+3; affine expressions allow constants. Their feasible sets intersect halfspaces and s. In two dimensions, move parallel objective level lines toward lower cost to locate an optimum.

例如 min max(2x+1,−x+4)，引入 t，改成 min t，约束 t≥2x+1、t≥−x+4。固定 x 时最小可行 t 恰为最大项。两线交于 (1,3)；x<1 时第二项>3，x>1 时第一项>3，故最优值为 3。For min max(2x+1,−x+4), introduce t and minimize t subject to both affine expressions being at most t. For fixed x, the smallest feasible t equals their . The lines meet at (1,3); either side makes one expression exceed 3, proving optimality.

类似地，|u|≤t 等价于 −t≤u≤t，最小化最坏残差时，就约束每个 −t≤(Ax−b)ᵢ≤t，再最小化 t。Likewise, |u|≤t means −t≤u≤t, giving an LP for worst residuals: minimize t subject to −t≤(Ax−b)ᵢ≤t for every i.

“最大项≤t”要求每一项都≤t，故约束应全部保留。若只约束其中一项，新模型就可能给原问题不能达到的费用。A maximum is at most t exactly when every term is at most t, so retain all constraints. Keeping just one may yield a cost unavailable in the original problem.

掌握Mastery

等价改写须验证两向：每个原变量 x 可配 t=maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ)，费用不变；每个新可行 (x,t) 都使原费用≤t。两向比较给出相同最优值。For equivalence, extend each original x with t=maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ) at unchanged cost. Conversely, each new feasible (x,t) has original cost≤t. Both comparisons establish equal optimal values.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

把 minₓ |x−2|+|x+1| 写成线性规划，并找最优值。Write minₓ |x−2|+|x+1| as a linear program and find its value.

先分清变量、可行性和费用；用一个统一界比较所有候选。Separate variables, feasibility and costs; compare all candidates with a uniform bound.

关键步骤Key steps

等价改写须验证两向：每个原变量 x 可配 t=maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ)，费用不变；每个新可行 (x,t) 都使原费用≤t。两向比较给出相同最优值。For equivalence, extend each original x with t=maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ) at unchanged cost. Conversely, each new feasible (x,t) has original cost≤t. Both comparisons establish equal optimal values.

展开核对Check the answer

引入 u、v，最小化 u+v，约束 u≥±(x−2)、v≥±(x+1)。三角不等式给目标≥3；x∈[−1,2] 都达到 3。Introduce u and v, minimize u+v and impose u≥±(x−2), v≥±(x+1). The triangle inequality bounds the objective below by three, attained throughout [−1,2].

资源配置推动了线性规划的发展；Kantorovich 与 Koopmans 因最优资源配置理论获 1975 年经济学奖，来源见文末。Resource allocation motivated linear programming. Kantorovich and Koopmans received the 1975 economics prize for its theory; see Sources.

04 · 凸优化与灯光设计04 · Why convex optimization is useful

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.23-34 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.3 · HW1 背景

学完应能：解释凸性带来的全局性质；逐步检查灯光模型的目标和。Learning goal: explain why convex optimization is useful and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸可行集与凸目标保证局部极小即全局极小。A convex feasible set and convex objective make local minima global.

了解Understand

若可行方案 x、y 按 0≤θ≤1 混合后仍可行，可行集就是凸的；若混合费用≤两费用的加权平均，目标就是凸函数。这使局部最优能够推出全局最优，后面两讲将分别展开定义。A feasible set is convex if mixtures θx+(1−θ)y remain feasible for 0≤θ≤1. An objective is convex if its mixture cost is no greater than the weighted costs. These properties make local optimality imply global optimality; the next lectures develop the definitions.

照明模型中，灯功率 pⱼ≥0，位置 i 的亮度 Iᵢ=ΣⱼAᵢⱼpⱼ，Aᵢⱼ 是已知贡献。目标亮度 Ides>0，令 uᵢ=Iᵢ/Ides。课件最小化 maxᵢ|log uᵢ|；因 |log u|=log max(u,1/u)，可等价最小化 maxᵢmax(uᵢ,1/uᵢ)。Lamp powers pⱼ≥0 give intensity Iᵢ=ΣⱼAᵢⱼpⱼ, with known contributions Aᵢⱼ. For target Ides>0 set uᵢ=Iᵢ/Ides. Since |log u|=log max(u,1/u), minimizing the worst log deviation is equivalent to minimizing maxᵢmax(uᵢ,1/uᵢ).

在 uᵢ>0 上，uᵢ 仿射、1/uᵢ 凸，取最大值仍凸，功率上下界也给凸约束。改写保留最优功率，目标值相差一个对数；改用平方误差则改变了模型。检查凸性时要同时核对定义域、组合规则和不等号方向。On uᵢ>0, uᵢ is affine and 1/uᵢ convex, so their maximum is convex; power bounds are convex constraints. The reformulation preserves optimal powers, with values related by a logarithm. Squared-error scoring changes the model. Check s, composition rules and inequality directions together.

例如一个位置亮度是目标的两倍或一半，|log u| 都为 log 2；所以此评分对过亮与过暗采用比例对称性。u=0 时 log 无定义，必须先限制每个 Iᵢ>0。log 严格递增且 maxᵢlog vᵢ=log maxᵢvᵢ，才保证改写保留最优功率。An intensity twice or half the target gives |log u|=log 2, expressing proportional symmetry. At u=0 the logarithm is undefined, so require every Iᵢ>0. Strictly increasing log and maxᵢlog vᵢ=log maxᵢvᵢ justify preservation of optimal powers.

掌握Mastery

若局部最优 x 有更好的可行 y，则任意小 θ>0 都给可行点 z=(1−θ)x+θy，且 f(z)≤(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y)<f(x)。z 可任意接近 x，矛盾。因此局部最优必全局最优。If local optimum x had a better feasible y, then z=(1−θ)x+θy is feasible and f(z)<f(x) for arbitrarily small θ>0 by convexity. This contradicts local optimality, proving global optimality.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

x²≤1、x²≥1 和 x²=1 分别定义什么集合？哪些是凸的？Which sets do x²≤1, x²≥1 and x²=1 define, and which are convex?

思路提示Hint

先分清变量、可行性和费用；用一个统一界比较所有候选。Separate variables, feasibility and costs; compare all candidates with a uniform bound.

关键步骤Key steps

若局部最优 x 有更好的可行 y，则任意小 θ>0 都给可行点 z=(1−θ)x+θy，且 f(z)≤(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y)<f(x)。z 可任意接近 x，矛盾。因此局部最优必全局最优。If local optimum x had a better feasible y, then z=(1−θ)x+θy is feasible and f(z)<f(x) for arbitrarily small θ>0 by convexity. This contradicts local optimality, proving global optimality.

展开核对Check the answer

分别为 [−1,1]、两条外侧射线、{−1,1}。后两者含 −1、1 却不含中点 0，只有第一个集合凸。They are [−1,1], two outer rays and {−1,1}. The latter two contain −1 and 1 but exclude midpoint zero. Only the first is convex.

深入In depth

凸分析与单纯形法、法的发展让这些结构用于工程。实际速度还取决于规模、稀疏性和数值条件。Convex analysis, and interior-point methods made these structures useful in engineering. Runtime still depends on size, sparsity and conditioning.

05 · 局部、全局与非凸问题中的凸优化05 · Local and global behavior in nonlinear problems

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.36-41 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：区分局部与全局最优；理解松弛、下界和启发式方法的作用。Learning goal: explain local and global behavior in nonlinear problems and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

全局极小比较全部可行点，局部极小只比较附近；驻点未必极小。Global minima compare all s, local minima nearby ones. Stationarity need not imply minimality.

了解Understand

局部极小只与某个邻域内的可行点比较，全局极小则与全部可行点比较。一般非凸目标可能有多处谷底，下降方法到达一处后，远处仍可能更低。A local minimum compares nearby feasible points; a global minimum compares every feasible point. A nonconvex objective may have several valleys, so descent into one need not find the deepest.

例如 f(x)=(x²−1)²≥0，在 ±1 取零，故两点均全局最优。导数 4x(x²−1) 在 0 也为零，但 f(0)=1，向两侧稍移都会下降。导数为零称驻点，仍需判断它是否极小。For f(x)=(x²−1)²≥0, ±1 attain zero and are global minima. Its derivative 4x(x²−1) also vanishes at 0, but f(0)=1 and small moves either way lower it. A stationary point has zero derivative and need not be a minimum.

凸松弛扩大可行集，因此给最小化问题一个下界；松弛解是否满足原约束，还要检查。Convex relaxation enlarges the feasible set, giving a lower bound for minimization. Its solution still needs checking against the original constraints.

若原可行集 C⊆D，且松弛目标 g 在 C 上满足 g≤f，那么 inf_D g≤inf_C g≤inf_C f。前一个比较来自集合包含，后一个来自目标逐点比较；仅扩大可行集时 g=f。松弛最优点须重新检查是否在 C。If C⊆D and relaxed objective g≤f on C, then inf_D g≤inf_C g≤inf_C f. The first comparison uses set inclusion and the second pointwise objective comparison. If only the set is relaxed, g=f. Check whether a relaxed optimizer belongs to C.

掌握Mastery

f″(x)=12x²−4，在 ±1 为正、0 为负，分别判定严格局部极小与局部极大；平方的非负性另证 ±1 全局最优。Here f″(x)=12x²−4 is positive at ±1 and negative at 0, giving strict local minima and a local maximum. Nonnegativity separately proves global optimality at ±1.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x³ 在 x=0 的导数为零。它是吗？The derivative of f(x)=x³ vanishes at zero. Is zero a local minimum?

思路提示Hint

先分清变量、可行性和费用；用一个统一界比较所有候选。Separate variables, feasibility and costs; compare all candidates with a uniform bound.

关键步骤Key steps

f″(x)=12x²−4，在 ±1 为正、0 为负，分别判定严格局部极小与局部极大；平方的非负性另证 ±1 全局最优。Here f″(x)=12x²−4 is positive at ±1 and negative at 0, giving strict local minima and a local maximum. Nonnegativity separately proves global optimality at ±1.

展开核对Check the answer

任意小的负 x 都有 x³<0，因此 0 不是局部极小点。Arbitrarily small negative x satisfy x³<0, so zero is not a local minimum.

特殊非凸问题也可能易解；凸性本身则不保证最优点存在或计算稳定。Special nonconvex problems can be easy. Convexity alone guarantees neither attainment nor numerical stability.

17 · 奇异值分解与伪逆17 · Singular values and the pseudoinverse

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.53-54,56 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.5.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：理解奇异值、谱范数与解；联系矩阵核范数。Learning goal: explain singular values and the and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

SVD 给正交方向与缩放；伪逆反转非零奇异值，选最短最小二乘解。SVD supplies orthogonal directions and scales. The pseudoinverse inverts nonzero scales and selects the shortest least-squares solution.

了解Understand

一般矩阵可写 SVD：A=UΣVᵀ。V、U 分别给输入、输出的正交坐标，Σ 沿轴按非负奇异值缩放，因此最大奇异值就是谱范数。An SVD writes A=UΣVᵀ, with orthogonal input/output coordinates V,U and nonnegative directional scales in Σ. The largest singular value is the spectral norm.

伪逆 A†=VΣ†Uᵀ 把矩形对角阵 Σ 转置后，对非零奇异值取倒数，零仍为零。A=diag(2,0)、b=(4,3) 时，全部最小二乘解为 (2,t)；A†b=(2,0) 选出其中欧氏长度最小者，残差 (0,−3) 无法消除。The pseudoinverse A†=VΣ†Uᵀ transposes the rectangular diagonal Σ, inverts nonzero singular values and leaves zeros zero. For A=diag(2,0), b=(4,3), all least-squares solutions are (2,t). A†b=(2,0) selects the shortest; residual (0,−3) is unavoidable.

使用完整 SVD 时 U 为 m×m、V 为 n×n，Σ 为 m×n，Σ† 为 n×m，所以 A† 为 n×m。薄 SVD 可以只保留非零奇异方向，但重建输入的零空间时要另补相应方向。For a full SVD, U is m×m, V is n×n, Σ is m×n and Σ† is n×m, so A† is n×m. A thin SVD may retain only nonzero directions; reconstructing the input nullspace requires the omitted directions separately.

掌握Mastery

令 y=Vᵀx、c=Uᵀb，正交变换使目标变为 Σᵢ(σᵢyᵢ−cᵢ)² 加常数。σᵢ>0 取 yᵢ=cᵢ/σᵢ；零方向不影响拟合，最小长度取零，得到 A†b。In coordinates y=Vᵀx,c=Uᵀb, the objective is Σᵢ(σᵢyᵢ−cᵢ)² plus constants. For σᵢ>0 choose yᵢ=cᵢ/σᵢ; unused zero directions take zero for minimum length, giving A†b.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

A=diag(3,1,0)，求 A† 和谱范数。For A=diag(3,1,0), find A† and the spectral norm.

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

令 y=Vᵀx、c=Uᵀb，正交变换使目标变为 Σᵢ(σᵢyᵢ−cᵢ)² 加常数。σᵢ>0 取 yᵢ=cᵢ/σᵢ；零方向不影响拟合，最小长度取零，得到 A†b。In coordinates y=Vᵀx,c=Uᵀb, the objective is Σᵢ(σᵢyᵢ−cᵢ)² plus constants. For σᵢ>0 choose yᵢ=cᵢ/σᵢ; unused zero directions take zero for minimum length, giving A†b.

展开核对Check the answer

A†=diag(1/3,1,0)，谱范数为 3。The pseudoinverse is diag(1/3,1,0), and the spectral norm is three.

深入In depth

小奇异值会放大误差；截断 SVD 或正则化以拟合偏差换取稳定性。Small singular values amplify errors. Truncated SVD or regularization trades fitting bias for stability.

18 · Schur 补与块矩阵18 · The Schur complement

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.57 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.5.5；C.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：通过配方或块消元读半正定条件；说明可逆块的前提。Learning goal: explain the schur complement and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

正定块可配方消元；整体半正定等价于 半正定。Complete the square around a positive definite block; block PSD is equivalent to PSD of its Schur complement.

了解Understand

对称分块矩阵 M=[[A,B],[Bᵀ,C]] 中，设 A 为 k×k 正定、B 为 k×l、C 为 l×l。配方消去耦合项后，剩下的 S=C−BᵀA⁻¹B 称 Schur 补；M⪰0 等价于 S⪰0。For symmetric M=[[A,B],[Bᵀ,C]], let A be k×k positive definite, B k×l and C l×l. Completing the square leaves Schur complement S=C−BᵀA⁻¹B; M⪰0 iff S⪰0.

例如 [[2,1],[1,c]] 半正定恰在 c≥1/2。后面可把 xᵀY⁻¹x≤t 改成 [[Y,x],[xᵀ,t]]⪰0，因为补为 t−xᵀY⁻¹x；块元素均仿射，便于建模；仍须保留 Y≻0。Thus [[2,1],[1,c]] is PSD iff c≥1/2. Later xᵀY⁻¹x≤t becomes [[Y,x],[xᵀ,t]]⪰0, since its complement is t−xᵀY⁻¹x. Its entries are affine. The domain Y≻0 remains required.

在 [[2,1],[1,c]] 中，二次型 2u²+2uv+cv²=2(u+v/2)²+(c−1/2)v²。c<1/2 时取 u=−v/2、v≠0 就得到负值；c≥1/2 时两个平方项都非负。这给出了具体数值的双向检查。For [[2,1],[1,c]], complete the square: 2u²+2uv+cv²=2(u+v/2)²+(c−1/2)v². If c<1/2, use u=−v/2 and nonzero v for a negative value. If c≥1/2, both terms are nonnegative. This checks both directions numerically.

掌握Mastery

二次型等于 (u+A⁻¹Bv)ᵀA(u+A⁻¹Bv)+vᵀSv。S⪰0 保证非负；反向令 u=−A⁻¹Bv，便得所有 v 均满足 vᵀSv≥0。The quadratic form equals (u+A⁻¹Bv)ᵀA(u+A⁻¹Bv)+vᵀSv. PSD S makes it nonnegative. Conversely choose u=−A⁻¹Bv to force vᵀSv≥0 for every v.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

[[4,2],[2,t]] 半正定的最小 t 是多少？What is the smallest t making [[4,2],[2,t]] PSD?

思路提示Hint

先写维数与定义，再决定用上界、取等、二次型还是求导。Write dimensions and definitions, then choose a bound, attainment, quadratic form or differentiation.

关键步骤Key steps

二次型等于 (u+A⁻¹Bv)ᵀA(u+A⁻¹Bv)+vᵀSv。S⪰0 保证非负；反向令 u=−A⁻¹Bv，便得所有 v 均满足 vᵀSv≥0。The quadratic form equals (u+A⁻¹Bv)ᵀA(u+A⁻¹Bv)+vᵀSv. PSD S makes it nonnegative. Conversely choose u=−A⁻¹Bv to force vᵀSv≥0 for every v.

展开核对Check the answer

Schur 补为 t−2²/4=t−1，所以最小 t=1。The complement is t−2²/4=t−1, so the smallest t is one.

深入In depth

A 仅半正定时须用 A†，并加值域条件 (I−AA†)B=0。For singular PSD A, use A† together with range condition (I−AA†)B=0.

奇异 Schur 补完整条件：M⪰0 当且仅当 A⪰0、(I−AA†)B=0、C−BᵀA†B⪰0。例 A=diag(1,0)、B=(1,0)ᵀ、C=2，补为 1，整体 PSD；若 B=(0,1)ᵀ，值域条件失败，即使形式上的补非负也不能判 PSD。依据：教材 A.5.5。For singular A, M⪰0 iff A⪰0, (I−AA†)B=0 and C−BᵀA†B⪰0. For A=diag(1,0), B=(1,0)ᵀ, C=2, the complement is 1 and the block is PSD. With B=(0,1)ᵀ range compatibility fails, so a nonnegative formal complement is insufficient. See A.5.5.

22 · 多面体、单纯形与半正定锥22 · Polyhedra, simplices and the PSD cone

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.21-26 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.2.4–2.2.5 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：读懂线性不等式交与矩阵锥；给出例子及反例。Learning goal: explain polyhedra, simplices and the psd cone and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

是有限仿射约束的交；PSD 锥由半正定对称矩阵组成。Polyhedra intersect finitely many affine constraints. The PSD cone contains positive semidefinite symmetric matrices.

了解Understand

多面体是有限个半空间与超平面的交，可以无界。概率 θ≥0、Σθᵢ=1 表示混合权重；三项权重在 R³ 中构成二维三角形。A is a finite intersection of halfspaces and hyperplanes and may be unbounded. The probability simplex θ≥0,Σθᵢ=1 represents mixing weights; three weights form a two-dimensional triangle in R³.

PSD 锥由对称组成，比较的是所有二次型。[[a,b],[b,c]]⪰0 等价于 a,c≥0 且 ac≥b²，可由二阶主子式判据得到。对角元素非负并不足够：[[1,2],[2,1]] 有负特征值 −1。The PSD cone consists of symmetric matrices with nonnegative quadratic forms. For [[a,b],[b,c]], PSD is equivalent to a,c≥0 and ac≥b² by the principal-minor criterion. Nonnegative diagonal entries alone fail: [[1,2],[2,1]] has eigenvalue −1.

三项概率权重 θ∈R³ 满足 θᵢ≥0、θ₁+θ₂+θ₃=1，是三维平面内的三角形，内部在 R³ 中为空。若用 (θ₁,θ₂) 画二维参数图，第三项须恢复为 θ₃=1−θ₁−θ₂，故图中还要求 θ₁+θ₂≤1。Three probability weights lie on a triangular plane in R³: θᵢ≥0 and θ₁+θ₂+θ₃=1. Its ordinary interior in R³ is empty. In a two-dimensional parameter plot recover θ₃=1−θ₁−θ₂, requiring θ₁+θ₂≤1.

掌握Mastery

线性不等式在混合下保持，故多面体凸。若 X,Y⪰0、α,β≥0，则 vᵀ(αX+βY)v≥0，故 PSD 集是凸锥；传极限也保持此式，故闭。Linear inequalities are preserved under mixing, proving polyhedral convexity. For PSD X,Y and α,β≥0, vᵀ(αX+βY)v≥0. This proves a convex cone, closed by passage to limits.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

[[1,b],[b,1]] 半正定时 b 可以取哪些值？For which b is [[1,b],[b,1]] PSD?

思路提示Hint

取任意两点和任意混合权重，把集合条件代入；集合相等须两向。Choose arbitrary points and a weight, substitute the membership condition; equality of sets needs both inclusions.

关键步骤Key steps

线性不等式在混合下保持，故多面体凸。若 X,Y⪰0、α,β≥0，则 vᵀ(αX+βY)v≥0，故 PSD 集是凸锥；传极限也保持此式，故闭。Linear inequalities are preserved under mixing, proving polyhedral convexity. For PSD X,Y and α,β≥0, vᵀ(αX+βY)v≥0. This proves a convex cone, closed by passage to limits.

展开核对Check the answer

要求 1−b²≥0，所以 −1≤b≤1。The condition 1−b²≥0 gives −1≤b≤1.

深入In depth

无限个半空间的交仍凸，但可能不是多面体，例如二维圆盘。Infinite halfspace intersections remain convex but need not be polyhedra, as a disk shows.

23 · 交、仿射像与仿射原像23 · Operations that preserve convexity

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.28-35 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.3.1–2.3.2 · HW1 3辅助

学完应能：用保凸运算拆复杂集合；区分像与。Learning goal: explain operations that preserve convexity and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

任意交、仿射像与仿射原像保持凸性；并集一般不保持。Intersections, affine images and affine s preserve convexity. Unions generally do not.

了解Understand

交集要求同时满足约束：两点在每个凸集中，线段也在每个集中，故任意交仍凸。并集没有此保证，两个分离圆盘就是反例。Intersections impose all constraints. A segment between two points lies in every member convex set, hence in their intersection. Unions need not be convex; two separated disks give a counterexample.

仿射像把 C 中点送成 Ax+b；仿射原像收集 Ax+b∈D 的输入，不要求 A 可逆。因此 {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1} 是凸球的仿射原像，必凸。An affine image maps points of C to Ax+b; a preimage collects inputs satisfying Ax+b∈D and needs no inverse matrix. Thus {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1} is a convex ball's affine preimage.

课件系数约束 |Σₖxₖcos(kt)|≤1 对所有 |t|≤π/3 成立。固定 t 后它是两条半空间，全部取交仍凸；t 只编号约束，优化变量是 x。For |Σₖxₖcos(kt)|≤1 at all |t|≤π/3, each fixed t gives two halfspaces. Their intersection is convex. Here t indexes constraints; x is the variable.

像取“存在一个输入”：A(C)={Ax:x∈C}；原像取“所有满足输出条件的输入”：A⁻¹(D)={x:Ax∈D}，这里 A⁻¹ 是集合原像记号，不要求矩阵可逆。例如 A=[1,0]，单位圆盘的像是 [−1,1]；该区间的原像是无限长竖条 |x₁|≤1。An image asks for an originating input: A(C)={Ax:x∈C}. A preimage is {x:Ax∈D}; the notation A⁻¹ here does not require invertibility. For A=[1,0], the disk image is [−1,1], while the interval’s preimage is the infinite strip |x₁|≤1.

掌握Mastery

仿射映射保留混合：A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b=θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b)。将 C 或 D 的凸性代入，即得像或原像的结论。Affine maps preserve mixtures: A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b=θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b). Apply convexity of C or D to prove image or preimage convexity.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

集合 {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1, x≥0} 为何凸？Why is {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1, x≥0} convex?

思路提示Hint

取任意两点和任意混合权重，把集合条件代入；集合相等须两向。Choose arbitrary points and a weight, substitute the membership condition; equality of sets needs both inclusions.

关键步骤Key steps

仿射映射保留混合：A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b=θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b)。将 C 或 D 的凸性代入，即得像或原像的结论。Affine maps preserve mixtures: A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b=θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b). Apply convexity of C or D to prove image or preimage convexity.

展开核对Check the answer

第一约束是球的仿射原像，第二约束是非负正交象限，交集保持凸性。The first is an affine preimage of a ball, the second an orthant, and intersections preserve convexity.

深入In depth

Minkowski 和 C+D={x+y} 是 C×D 的仿射像，C、D 凸时也凸。The Minkowski sum C+D={x+y} is an affine image of C×D and is convex when both sets are convex.

24 · 透视映射与线性分式映射24 · Perspective and linear-fractional maps

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.36-40 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.3.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：追踪正分母条件与线段参数变化。Learning goal: explain perspective and linear-fractional maps and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

透视及正分母线性分式映射保凸，但会改变混合权重。Perspective and positive-denominator fractional maps preserve convexity while changing mixture weights.

了解Understand

透视 P(z,t)=z/t，t>0，把高度 t 的点沿射线投到高度 1。它不保留混合权重：(0,1)、(2,2) 的输出为 0、1，输入中点却输出 2/3。仍可证明凸集的透视像凸。Perspective P(z,t)=z/t, t>0, projects along rays to height 1. It changes mixture weights: (0,1),(2,2) map to 0,1, but their midpoint maps to 2/3. Nevertheless it preserves convexity of images.

线性分式 (Ax+b)/(cᵀx+d) 先仿射变换再透视。在正分母域上，有效混合权重非负；跨过零分母就不能沿用此规则。A linear-fractional map (Ax+b)/(cᵀx+d) is an affine map followed by perspective. A positive denominator keeps the effective weights nonnegative; crossing zero invalidates the rule.

对输入 (z,t)=(0,1)、(2,2)，集合透视输出为 0、1；输入中点 (1,3/2) 输出 2/3，并非输出中点 1/2。它仍在输出线段上，但权重改为与原高度成比例。必须全程 t>0，才能保证新权重非负且和为 1。Set perspective sends (0,1),(2,2) to 0,1, while their midpoint maps to 2/3 rather than 1/2. It stays in the output segment but changes weights in proportion to heights. Positive heights ensure the new weights are nonnegative and sum to 1.

掌握Mastery

要实现输出权重 θ，取输入权重 α=(θ/t₁)/(θ/t₁+(1−θ)/t₂)。代入后 αt₁/(αt₁+(1−α)t₂)=θ，因此每个输出线段点都有凸组合输入。For desired output weight θ, choose input weight α=(θ/t₁)/(θ/t₁+(1−θ)/t₂). Then αt₁/(αt₁+(1−α)t₂)=θ, supplying an input for each output segment point.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

在上面的例子中，输出中点 1/2 对应的输入权重 α 是多少？In the example, which input weight α produces output one half?

思路提示Hint

取任意两点和任意混合权重，把集合条件代入；集合相等须两向。Choose arbitrary points and a weight, substitute the membership condition; equality of sets needs both inclusions.

关键步骤Key steps

要实现输出权重 θ，取输入权重 α=(θ/t₁)/(θ/t₁+(1−θ)/t₂)。代入后 αt₁/(αt₁+(1−α)t₂)=θ，因此每个输出线段点都有凸组合输入。For desired output weight θ, choose input weight α=(θ/t₁)/(θ/t₁+(1−θ)/t₂). Then αt₁/(αt₁+(1−α)t₂)=θ, supplying an input for each output segment point.

展开核对Check the answer

α=(1/2)/(1/2+1/4)=2/3；输入为 (2/3,4/3)，相除得到 1/2。α=(1/2)/(1/2+1/4)=2/3. The input is (2/3,4/3), whose ratio is one half.

深入In depth

正分母还允许不等式交叉相乘，用于证明线性分式的凸原像规则。A positive denominator also permits cross-multiplication, proving convex-preimage preservation for linear-fractional maps.

26 · 最小元与极小元26 · Minimum elements and minimal elements

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.47-48 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.4.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用二维偏序图解释两者差别，理解可比较性的限制。Learning goal: explain s and minimal elements and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

不大于所有点；极小元素没有不同的更优点。A minimum is below all points; a has no distinct point below it.

了解Understand

最小元素不大于集合内每一点。要求：不存在不同的 y∈S 使 y⪯Kx。例 S={(0,1),(1,0)} 两点都极小，却无最小元素。A minimum is below every member. A minimal x has no distinct y∈S with y⪯Kx. Both points of {(0,1),(1,0)} are minimal but there is no minimum.

多个目标相互牵制时，极小方案往往有多个，仍需偏好来选择。Conflicting objectives often yield several minimal alternatives; preferences are needed to choose among them.

“至少一项更好”与“每项都更好”Better in at least one coordinate versus every coordinate

逐分量序下，极小表示不存在另一点所有指标都不更差，且至少一个更好。S={(1,1),(1,2)} 中，(1,1) 支配 (1,2)，所以后者不极小，尽管差向量 (0,1) 不在正象限的内部。In componentwise order, a minimal point has no alternative no worse in every coordinate and better in at least one. In S={(1,1),(1,2)}, the first dominates the second, so (1,2) is not minimal, although their difference (0,1) is outside the interior of the orthant.

严格锥序 y≺Kx 用 x−y∈int K；非零支配用 x−y∈K\{0}。弱 Pareto 极小只排除每项都更好的点，因此本例 (1,2) 仍是弱极小。最小元素还要求不大于集合内所有点，比极小更强。Strict cone order y≺Kx uses x−y∈int K. Nonzero domination uses x−y∈K\{0}. Weak Pareto minimality only excludes improvement in every coordinate, so (1,2) is still weakly minimal here. A minimum must be below every set member, a stronger requirement.

掌握Mastery

正常锥序具有反对称性。若 x、y 都最小，则 x⪯K y、y⪯K x，故 x=y。最小元素必极小，反向由两点例子否定。Antisymmetry makes a minimum unique: two minima satisfy both orders and hence coincide. Every minimum is minimal; the two-point example disproves the converse.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

S={(1,1),(1,2),(2,0)} 的逐分量极小元素有哪些？Find the componentwise minimal elements of S={(1,1),(1,2),(2,0)}.

思路提示Hint

取任意两点和任意混合权重，把集合条件代入；集合相等须两向。Choose arbitrary points and a weight, substitute the membership condition; equality of sets needs both inclusions.

关键步骤Key steps

正常锥序具有反对称性。若 x、y 都最小，则 x⪯K y、y⪯K x，故 x=y。最小元素必极小，反向由两点例子否定。Antisymmetry makes a minimum unique: two minima satisfy both orders and hence coincide. Every minimum is minimal; the two-point example disproves the converse.

展开核对Check the answer

为 (1,1)、(2,0)；(1,2) 被 (1,1) 支配，没有最小元素。They are (1,1) and (2,0). The point (1,2) is dominated by (1,1); there is no minimum.

深入In depth

(0,∞)² 没有极小元素：任一点把坐标减半都会更好。The set (0,∞)² has no minimal element: halving both coordinates improves any point.

27 · 分离超平面27 · Separating hyperplanes

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.50-55 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.5.1 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：辨析分离与严格分离的假设；检查开集和距离条件。Learning goal: explain s and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

不交非空凸集可弱分离；严格间隙需要额外条件。Nonempty disjoint convex sets admit weak separation; positive gaps require more conditions.

了解Understand

给出线性证书，把两个非空不相交凸集放在两侧。圆心 (±2,0)、半径 1 的圆盘可由 x₁=0 严格分开；一般弱分离允许取等，不能保证正间隙。A separating hyperplane certifies two nonempty disjoint convex sets lie on opposite sides. Disks centered at (±2,0) with radius 1 are strictly separated by x₁=0. General weak separation allows equality and need not give a positive gap.

非空闭凸集 C 外的点 z，可用最近点 p 构造法向 z−p。在这个构造中，连接 p、z 的线段垂直于过 p 的。弱分离则可能允许两个集合共享超平面上的点。For z outside a nonempty closed convex C, a nearest point p provides normal z−p. In this construction the segment joining p,z is perpendicular to the through p. Weak separation can allow the sets to share points on the hyperplane.

区分三句话：弱分离允许等号；逐点严格分离要求每个左侧点都严格小于分隔高度、每个右侧点都严格大于它；正间隙还要求两个集合在线性评分上的上确界与下确界有正差。端点不断逼近超平面时，逐点严格仍可能没有正间隙。Distinguish weak separation, which permits equality; pointwise strict separation, which puts each point strictly on its side; and a positive gap between the supremum score on one set and infimum on the other. Pointwise strictness need not give a positive gap if scores approach the hyperplane.

掌握Mastery

令 v=z−p≠0。沿 C 中线段 p+t(x−p) 的距离平方在 t=0 最小，右导数 −2vᵀ(x−p)≥0，故 vᵀx≤vᵀp，而 vᵀz=vᵀp+‖v‖²。因此 C 与 z 严格分离。Let v=z−p≠0. The squared distance along p+t(x−p) has nonnegative right derivative at zero, giving −2vᵀ(x−p)≥0 and hence vᵀx≤vᵀp. Since vᵀz=vᵀp+‖v‖², the point is strictly separated from C.

取任意两点和任意混合权重，把集合条件代入；集合相等须两向。Choose arbitrary points and a weight, substitute the membership condition; equality of sets needs both inclusions.

令 v=z−p≠0。沿 C 中线段 p+t(x−p) 的距离平方在 t=0 最小，右导数 −2vᵀ(x−p)≥0，故 vᵀx≤vᵀp，而 vᵀz=vᵀp+‖v‖²。因此 C 与 z 严格分离。Let v=z−p≠0. The squared distance along p+t(x−p) has nonnegative right derivative at zero, giving −2vᵀ(x−p)≥0 and hence vᵀx≤vᵀp. Since vᵀz=vᵀp+‖v‖², the point is strictly separated from C.

非空不交凸集中，一个紧、另一个闭，可保证正距离和严格间隙；仅都闭不足够。For disjoint nonempty convex sets, compactness of one and closedness of the other ensure positive distance. Closedness alone is insufficient.

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.56-58 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.5.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：理解边界点的支撑方向及凸性假设。Learning goal: explain supporting hyperplanes and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

支撑超平面经过边界点，并把集合留在一侧。A supporting hyperplane passes through a boundary point and leaves the set on one side.

了解Understand

支撑超平面经过集合的边界点，将整个集合留在一侧。圆盘在 (1,0) 的支撑线是 x₁=1；正方形可有整条边接触支撑线。凸集每个属于集合的边界点均有支撑面，角点的法向可能不唯一。A supporting hyperplane passes through a boundary point and leaves the set on one side. A disk at (1,0) has support x₁=1; a square can touch along an edge. Every boundary point belonging to a convex set has a support, possibly with several normals at a corner.

支撑法向必须非零，否则不定义超平面。对椭球边界点 x₀，P≻0 保证 Px₀≠0；Cauchy–Schwarz 在变换坐标 P½x 中给 (Px₀)ᵀx≤1，所以该法向确实支撑整个椭球。A supporting normal must be nonzero. For an ellipsoid boundary point, P≻0 ensures Px₀≠0. Cauchy–Schwarz in coordinates P½x gives (Px₀)ᵀx≤1, verifying support of the entire ellipsoid.

掌握Mastery

单位圆盘边界点 x₀ 有 ‖x₀‖₂=1。对球内 x，x₀ᵀx≤‖x‖₂≤1=x₀ᵀx₀，故法向为 x₀。椭球 xᵀPx≤1 的边界法向为 Px₀。At a unit-disk boundary point x₀, Cauchy–Schwarz gives x₀ᵀx≤‖x‖₂≤1=x₀ᵀx₀ for all disk points. Thus x₀ is a normal; an ellipsoid xᵀPx≤1 has boundary normal Px₀.

34 · 下水平集与上图34 · Sublevel sets and epigraphs

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.25-27 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.6–3.1.7 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：画图理解 epigraph；区别下水平集凸与函数凸。Learning goal: explain s and epigraphs and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

上图集凸等价于函数凸；全凸只保证拟凸。A convex epigraph characterizes convexity; convex sublevel sets characterize ity.

了解Understand

次水平集 Cα={x:f(x)≤α} 固定费用门槛；x² 在 α=4 时给 [−2,2]，α<0 时为空。上图集 epi f={(x,t):f(x)≤t} 则包含图像及其上方区域。A sublevel set Cα={x:f(x)≤α} fixes a cost threshold. For x², α=4 gives [−2,2], while α<0 gives the empty set. The epigraph epi f={(x,t):f(x)≤t} includes the graph and everything above it.

函数凸当且仅当上图集凸。于是 min f(x) 可写为 min t、f(x)≤t。所有次水平集凸却只表示，如递增的 x³，其次水平集均为左半轴，函数仍不凸。A function is convex iff its epigraph is convex, so min f(x) becomes min t subject to f(x)≤t. Convex sublevel sets alone mean quasiconvexity: increasing x³ has half-line sublevels but is not convex.

下水平集在原来的 x 空间；上图集在多一维的 (x,t) 空间。图像只有 t=f(x) 的边界，通常本身不凸；不要把蓝色曲线与其上方区域混为一物。Sublevel sets live in the original x-space, while epigraphs live in one higher-dimensional (x,t)-space. The graph only contains t=f(x) and is generally not itself convex; distinguish the curve from the region above it.

掌握Mastery

混合两个上图集点时，凸性给 f(混合 x)≤混合 f 值≤混合高度。反向取两点高度恰为函数值即得凸性。次水平集则令两端费用≤α，混合后仍≤α。For two epigraph points, convexity bounds the mixture value by mixed function values, then by mixed heights. Conversely, use heights equal to endpoint function values. Setting both costs≤α proves convexity of each sublevel set.

混合两个上图集点时，凸性给 f(混合 x)≤混合 f 值≤混合高度。反向取两点高度恰为函数值即得凸性。次水平集则令两端费用≤α，混合后仍≤α。For two epigraph points, convexity bounds the mixture value by mixed function values, then by mixed heights. Conversely, use heights equal to endpoint function values. Setting both costs≤α proves convexity of each sublevel set.

35 · 矩阵分式函数与上图应用35 · Matrix-fractional functions and LMIs

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.28-32 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.5；3.1.7；A.5.5 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用 Schur 补把矩阵分式函数上图写为半正定约束。Learning goal: explain matrix-fractional functions and lmis and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

正定域上的矩阵分式联合凸，上图集可写成 PSD 块约束。The matrix fraction is jointly convex on its positive definite domain; its epigraph is a PSD block constraint.

了解Understand

矩阵分式 f(x,Y)=xᵀY⁻¹x 的域为 Y≻0。需要判断 x、Y 同时变化的联合凸性，不能仅固定 Y 看二次函数。标量情形为 x²/y，y>0。The matrix-fractional function f(x,Y)=xᵀY⁻¹x requires Y≻0. Joint convexity concerns changes in both variables, beyond fixing Y to get a quadratic. Its scalar version is x²/y for y>0.

由 Schur 补，f≤t 等价于上述 PSD 分块约束。块元素对 (x,Y,t) 仿射，PSD 锥和正定域均凸，故上图集凸。例 (1,1)、(3,1) 中点值 4，小于端点平均 5。Schur complementation turns f≤t into the displayed PSD block constraint. Its entries are affine, and the PSD cone and positive definite domain are convex, proving epigraph convexity. For (1,1),(3,1), the midpoint value 4 is below endpoint average 5.

标量 x²/y 中的 x 是实数、y 是正数。一般 x 为 n 维列向量，Y 为 n×n 对称正定矩阵，上图集分块矩阵为 (n+1)×(n+1)。正定域应与 PSD 约束同时保留。In x²/y, x is scalar and y positive. Generally x is an n-dimensional column and Y an n×n symmetric , making the epigraph block (n+1)×(n+1). Retain Y≻0 alongside the PSD constraint.

掌握Mastery

取任意两个上图集点，其分块矩阵混合后仍半正定，混合 Y 仍正定，再用 Schur 补反向还原，得到函数的凸性不等式。Mix two epigraph points. Their block matrix stays PSD and their Y stays positive definite. Applying the Schur complement in reverse yields the function's convexity inequality.

写出 x²/y≤4、y>0 的 2×2 矩阵约束。Write x²/y≤4, y>0 as a 2×2 matrix constraint.

取任意两个上图集点，其分块矩阵混合后仍半正定，混合 Y 仍正定，再用 Schur 补反向还原，得到函数的凸性不等式。Mix two epigraph points. Their block matrix stays PSD and their Y stays positive definite. Applying the Schur complement in reverse yields the function's convexity inequality.

37 · 非负加权和与仿射复合37 · Nonnegative sums and affine composition

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.36-38 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.1–3.2.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：逐条检查权重符号与复合的维数、定义域。Learning goal: explain nonnegative sums and affine composition and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

非负加权和与仿射复合保持凸性。Nonnegative weighted sums and affine composition preserve convexity.

了解Understand

非负加权和保持凸性：αᵢ≥0、fᵢ 凸，则 Σαᵢfᵢ 凸，域取共同定义域。最小二乘加 λ‖x‖₁（λ≥0）因此仍凸，λ 用于调节拟合与参数大小。Nonnegative weighted sums preserve convexity on the common domain. Thus plus λ‖x‖₁ remains convex for λ≥0, trading fit against parameter size.

仿射复合 f(Ax+b) 也保持凸性。负系数通常使方向翻转，例如 −x² 凹；仿射项则允许任意系数。Affine composition f(Ax+b) preserves convexity. Negative weights generally reverse curvature, as −x² shows; affine terms permit either sign.

例如 f=(2x−1)²+3|x|，两部分都在 R 定义。仿射内层自动把输入混合变成输出混合，不需要单调性；非线性内层则不能跳过第 39 节的单调检查。For (2x−1)²+3|x| both terms have domain R. An affine inner map preserves mixtures exactly and requires no monotonicity check. Nonlinear inner maps need the checks in unit 39.

掌握Mastery

分别将凸性不等式乘 αᵢ≥0 再相加即可。仿射复合利用 A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b=θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b)。Multiply each convexity inequality by αᵢ≥0 and sum. Affine composition follows because affine maps preserve mixtures.

38 · 逐点最大、上确界与支撑函数38 · Pointwise maxima, suprema and support functions

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.39-44 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：读 max 与 sup；解释最大特征值凸性和仿射下界表示。Learning goal: explain pointwise maxima, suprema and s and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

逐点最大值或上确界保持凸性；逐点最小值一般不保持。Pointwise maxima and suprema preserve convexity; minima generally do not.

了解Understand

本节的函数族及用于定义的集合 C 均取非空；允许上确界为 +∞，并单独讨论有效域。The function family and support set C here are nonempty. Suprema may be +∞, with the effective domain checked separately.

固定 x 后对一族凸函数取最大值或上确界，仍凸。例如 max(x²,(x−2)²) 在 x=1 切换主导项，可不可微而仍凸。逐点最小则不保证：min((x−1)²,(x+1)²) 两端为零，中点为 1。The pointwise maximum or supremum of convex functions is convex. For max(x²,(x−2)²), the active term switches at 1 without destroying convexity. Pointwise minima fail: min((x−1)²,(x+1)²) is zero at ±1 but 1 at their midpoint.

支撑函数 hC(z)=supₓ∈C zᵀx 是关于 z 的仿射函数上确界，故即使 C 不凸也凸。类似地 λmax(X)=sup‖v‖=1 vᵀXv 对对称 X 凸。The support function hC(z)=supₓ∈C zᵀx is a supremum of affine functions of z, hence convex even if C is not. Likewise λmax(X)=sup‖v‖=1 vᵀXv is convex for symmetric X.

取上确界后可能为 +∞，有效域是函数值有限的输入集合。例如 h_R(z)=supₓ∈R zx，仅 z=0 时有限。上确界保持凸性并不保证有限性或上确界取得。A supremum may be +∞. Its effective domain contains inputs with finite values. For example, h_R(z)=supₓ∈R zx is finite only at z=0. Preservation of convexity guarantees neither finiteness nor attainment.

掌握Mastery

每项 fα 在混合点≤θfα(x)+(1−θ)fα(y)≤θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y)。右侧与 α 无关，取上确界即证；也可用 epi g=∩α epi fα。Each fα at the mixture is bounded by θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y). Taking the supremum over α proves convexity. Equivalently, epi g=∩α epi fα.

39 · 标量与向量复合规则39 · Composition rules and their domain conditions

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.45-55 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：同时检查外函数凸性、单调性和扩展值定义域。Learning goal: explain composition rules and their domain conditions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

外层凸且非减配内层凸；外层凸且非增配内层凹。Use convex inner maps with nondecreasing convex outer functions, concave inner maps with nonincreasing convex ones.

了解Understand

复合 h(g(x)) 的常用规则是：外层 h 凸且非减、内层 g 凸，则复合凸。非减保证内层的不等式方向通过外层后保留。若 h 非增，就需 g 凹。A standard rule makes h∘g convex when h is convex and nondecreasing and g convex. Monotonicity preserves the inner inequality. For nonincreasing h, use concave g instead.

因此 exp(‖x‖) 凸，正凹 g 的 −log g 和 1/g 凸。平方仅在非负区间非减，所以 ‖x‖² 可以用此规则，(x²−1)² 却无法仅凭“凸函数复合”判断。Thus exp(‖x‖) is convex; for positive concave g, −log g and 1/g are convex. Squaring is nondecreasing only on nonnegative inputs, so the rule handles ‖x‖² but does not justify (x²−1)².

多输入外层按坐标检查：非减坐标配凸内层，非增坐标配凹内层，仿射内层两者皆可。须检查域，教材用扩展值版本保证中间比较合法。非负凸 g 的 gᵖ（p≥1）及分量的 ℓp 组合也凸。For multivariate outer functions, pair nondecreasing coordinates with convex inner functions, nonincreasing ones with concave inner functions; affine inner functions allow either. Check domains using extended-value monotonicity. Powers p≥1 and ℓp combinations of nonnegative convex components are convex.

先认外层，再检查它如何传递不等式Identify the outer function and how it transfers inequalities

以 exp(x²) 为例，内层 g=x² 凸，外层 h=exp 凸且非减。混合输入先用 g 的凸性得到 g(w)≤θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y)。经过非减 h 后方向保持，再对 h 用凸性。两步承担不同工作：For exp(x²), inner g=x² is convex and outer h=exp is convex and nondecreasing. Convexity first gives g(w)≤θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y). Nondecreasing h preserves this order; then outer convexity compares the mixed arguments. These are two separate steps:

若 h 非增，内层就需凹：先得 g(w)≥混合 g，再由 h 翻转为所需的≤。例如正凹 g 上的 −log g。定义域必须允许 g(w) 和中间平均值；若只知道外层在某个区间凸，就逐一确认这些量都在该区间。For nonincreasing h use concave g: g(w)≥the mixed g-values, then h reverses the inequality to ≤. An example is −log g for positive concave g. The domain must contain g(w) and the intermediate average. If outer convexity is only known on an interval, check both quantities lie there.

多输入如 h(u₁,u₂)=exp(u₁)+exp(u₂)，逐坐标非减；每个内层凸就可逐坐标比较。若某坐标非增，该坐标配凹内层。不能只说“两个凸函数复合仍凸”：h(u)=u² 在负半轴非增，g=x²−1 穿过负值，(x²−1)² 在 0 的二阶导为 −4，确实不凸。For multivariate h(u₁,u₂)=exp(u₁)+exp(u₂), coordinatewise nondecreasing behavior permits convex inner functions in each coordinate. A nonincreasing coordinate needs a concave inner function. Convexity alone does not justify composition: h(u)=u² decreases on the negative half-line, g=x²−1 takes negative values, and (x²−1)² has second derivative −4 at 0.

40 · 部分最小化与函数透视40 · Partial minimization and function perspective

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.56-63 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.5–3.2.6 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：区分联合凸与分别凸；追踪 t>0；解释距离函数与二次透视。Learning goal: explain and function perspective and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

联合凸的保凸；透视 t f(x/t) 在 t>0 上保凸。Partial minimization of joint convexity preserves convexity, as does perspective t f(x/t) for t>0.

了解Understand

部分最小化先优化隐藏变量 y，留下 g(x)=infᵧ∈C f(x,y)。当 f 联合凸、C 凸时 g 凸。例如 (x−y)²+y² 在 y=x/2 最小，代回得 x²/2。分别对 x、y 凸不足以应用规则。Partial minimization g(x)=infᵧ∈C f(x,y) removes hidden variables. Jointly convex f and convex C give convex g. For (x−y)²+y², minimizing at y=x/2 gives x²/2. Separate convexity is insufficient.

函数透视为 t f(x/t)，t>0。平方的透视是 x²/t，−log 的透视是 −t log(x/t)：x/t 是单位规模状态，乘 t 得总费用。The perspective is t f(x/t), t>0. Squaring gives x²/t; −log gives −t log(x/t). The ratio represents a per-unit state and t scales its cost.

到非空凸集的距离 infᵧ∈C‖x−y‖ 是联合凸函数的部分最小化，故凸；最远距离 supᵧ∈C‖x−y‖ 由上确界规则凸，无须 C 凸，值可为 +∞。分式 ‖Ax+b‖²/(cᵀx+d) 在正分母域上也是透视的仿射复合。Distance to a nonempty convex set is partial minimization of jointly convex ‖x−y‖. Farthest distance supᵧ∈C‖x−y‖ is convex by the supremum rule, without convex C, and may be +∞. The fraction ‖Ax+b‖²/(cᵀx+d) is an affine composition of a perspective on its positive-denominator domain.

把 (x−y)²+y² 配方为 2(y−x/2)²+x²/2，可直接看出 y*=x/2 和消元结果 x²/2；这个例子还没有用到一般下确界证明。Completing the square as 2(y−x/2)²+x²/2 directly gives y*=x/2 and eliminated value x²/2. This example can be understood before the general infimum proof.

先处理 g(x₁)、g(x₂) 都有限的情形，固定 ε>0。由下确界定义，可选 yᵢ∈C 使 f(xᵢ,yᵢ)≤g(xᵢ)+ε。C 凸，故 yθ=θy₁+(1−θ)y₂∈C。联合凸性同时混合 x 和 y：First assume both g(x₁),g(x₂) are finite. For ε>0 choose yᵢ∈C with f(xᵢ,yᵢ)≤g(xᵢ)+ε, using the definition of infimum. Convex C contains yθ=θy₁+(1−θ)y₂. Joint convexity mixes x and y together:

让 ε↓0 得结论，完全不要求 y 的最优点存在。若一端为 +∞，0<θ<1 时右侧为 +∞，不等式自动成立；端点权重单独按恒等式处理。若 g 可取 −∞，本节普通凸函数的表述不直接适用，应另讨论扩展值约定，不能计算 ∞−∞。Let ε↓0. No minimizing y is required. If an endpoint value is +∞, for 0<θ<1 the upper bound is automatically true; endpoint weights are handled by identities. If g may take −∞, the ordinary convex-function statement here needs a separate extended-value treatment; never calculate ∞−∞.

分别凸的反例为 f(x,y)=xy：固定任一变量时仿射，联合却不凸。两点 (1,−1)、(−1,1) 的费用都为 −1，中点 (0,0) 的费用为 0，违反凸性。Separate convexity is insufficient: f(x,y)=xy is affine in either variable when the other is fixed. Yet (1,−1) and (−1,1) both cost −1 while their midpoint costs 0, violating joint convexity.

透视把总量和单位量联系起来Perspective connects total and per-unit quantities

凸定义域保证这个平均合法。对 f 用凸性后乘正数 T，得到 F 的凸性不等式。t=0 不在当前定义域，不能直接把它代入分母。The convex domain makes this average admissible. Apply convexity of f and multiply by positive T to get convexity of F. The boundary t=0 is outside this definition and cannot be substituted into the denominator.

41 · 共轭函数的定义与几何41 · Conjugate functions: describe a curve by slopes

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.4-5 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：把共轭看成最紧仿射下界的截距；解释上确界和有效域。Learning goal: explain s: describe a curve by slopes and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

共轭在固定斜率下求线性收益减函数代价的上确界。The conjugate maximizes linear reward minus function cost at a fixed slope.

了解Understand

固定斜率 y，寻找不超过 f 的最高仿射下界 yᵀx−c。必须使 c≥yᵀx−f(x) 对所有 x 成立，故最小可行 c 为共轭 f*(y)=supₓ(yᵀx−f(x))。它用斜率描述函数。For fixed slope y, seek the highest affine lower bound yᵀx−c. Requiring c≥yᵀx−f(x) for every x gives the conjugate f*(y)=supₓ(yᵀx−f(x)), a slope-based description.

对 f(x)=x²/2，yx−x²/2=−(x−y)²/2+y²/2，故 f*(y)=y²/2。例如 y=2 给支撑线 2x−2，在 x=2 接触。共轭作为仿射函数上确界必凸，但可取 +∞。For f(x)=x²/2, completing the square gives f*(y)=y²/2, attained at x=y. Slope 2 gives support 2x−2 touching at x=2. A conjugate is always convex as an affine supremum, but may be +∞.

注意这里 y 固定、x 被优化；换一个 y 就重新做一次最大化。f*(y)=+∞ 表示没有有限截距能让该斜率的直线处处低于 f；不表示原函数在所有点都是无穷。Here y is fixed and x is optimized; each new y defines a new maximization. A value f*(y)=+∞ means no finite intercept can put that slope below f everywhere, not that f is infinite everywhere.

掌握Mastery

定义给 f(x)≥yᵀx−f*(y)。可微凸 f 若 ∇f(x*)=y，其切平面界保证 x* 最大化共轭目标，可代回求值。The definition gives f(x)≥yᵀx−f*(y). If differentiable convex f satisfies ∇f(x*)=y, its tangent bound proves x* maximizes the conjugate objective.

定义给 f(x)≥yᵀx−f*(y)。可微凸 f 若 ∇f(x*)=y，其切平面界保证 x* 最大化共轭目标，可代回求值。The definition gives f(x)≥yᵀx−f*(y). If differentiable convex f satisfies ∇f(x*)=y, its tangent bound proves x* maximizes the conjugate objective.

42 · 共轭函数的典型计算42 · Compute conjugates, including boundary cases

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.6-11 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3.1 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：算仿射、负对数、指数、负熵、倒数、严格凸二次函数、负 log-det、示性/支撑函数与范数及范数平方的共轭；每例先检查定义域。Learning goal: explain compute conjugates, including boundary cases and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

计算共轭要核对定义域、无界方向、端点和取等。Conjugate calculations require domains, unbounded directions, endpoints and attainment.

了解Understand

二次函数：用配方确定全局最大Quadratic: complete the square for a global maximum

原函数 f=x²/2 定义在 R，固定实数 y 后最大化 yx−x²/2。配方为 y²/2−(x−y)²/2≤y²/2，且 x=y 取等。故有效域为全部 R，共轭为 y²/2，每个 y 都取得最大值。这个配方同时给候选点和全局上界。For f=x²/2 on R, fix y∈R and maximize yx−x²/2. Completing the square gives y²/2−(x−y)²/2≤y²/2, with equality at x=y. The conjugate is y²/2, finite and attained for every real y. The square gives both the candidate and its global bound.

指数：按斜率正、零、负分别检查Exponential: positive, zero and negative slopes

原函数 f=eˣ 在 R。固定 y，目标 q(x)=yx−eˣ，导数 q′=y−eˣ，二阶导 q″=−eˣ<0。y>0 时唯一候选 x=log y；严格凹性使它为全局最大点，代回得 y log y−y。For f=eˣ on R, fix y and define q(x)=yx−eˣ. Then q′=y−eˣ and q″=−eˣ<0. For y>0 the unique candidate is x=log y; strict concavity makes it the global maximizer, giving y log y−y.

y=0 时目标为 −eˣ<0，令 x→−∞ 可逼近 0，却没有有限 x 达到。y<0 时仍令 x→−∞，yx→+∞、eˣ→0，目标无界。于是有效域为 [0,∞)，但只有 y>0 取得：For y=0 the objective −eˣ<0 approaches 0 as x→−∞ without attaining it. For y<0 the same limit makes yx→+∞ while eˣ→0, so the objective is unbounded. The effective domain is [0,∞), with attainment only for y>0:

负对数：先保住正定义域Negative logarithm: keep the positive domain

原函数 f=−log x，域 x>0。固定 y 后目标 q=yx+log x，q′=y+1/x，q″=−1/x²<0。y<0 时 x*=−1/y>0，是全局最大点，值为 −1−log(−y)。y=0 时 x→∞ 使 log x 无界；y>0 时线性项也趋于 +∞。因此有效域为 (−∞,0)，其中处处取得：For f=−log x on x>0, the objective is q=yx+log x, with q′=y+1/x and q″=−1/x²<0. If y<0, x*=−1/y>0 is the global maximizer, giving −1−log(−y). If y=0, log x is unbounded as x→∞; if y>0 the linear term also diverges. The effective domain is (−∞,0), attained throughout:

给每次共轭的对象标上名字Name the function being conjugated each time

对非空闭凸集 C，示性函数 δC 在 C 内为 0、外为 +∞。从定义 δC*(y)=supₓ∈C yᵀx=hC(y)。反过来 hC*=δC；所以 δC**=δC，而 hC**=hC。共轭一次交换这两个对象，共轭两次各回到自己。For a nonempty closed convex C, δC is 0 inside and +∞ outside. Its definition gives δC*(y)=supₓ∈C yᵀx=hC(y). Conversely hC*=δC. Therefore δC**=δC and hC**=hC. One conjugation exchanges the objects; two return each to itself.

用 C=[−1,1] 核对：hC(y)=|y|。再求 supᵧ(xy−|y|)：|x|≤1 时由 xy≤|y| 得上界 0，y=0 达到；|x|>1 时取 y 与 x 同号并放大，目标无界。因此 |·|*=δ[−1,1]，再共轭才回到 |·|。For C=[−1,1], hC(y)=|y|. In supᵧ(xy−|y|), |x|≤1 gives upper bound 0 via xy≤|y|, attained at y=0. If |x|>1, scale y with the sign of x to get unbounded reward. Thus |·|*=δ[−1,1]; another conjugation returns |·|.

范数给另一类共轭：‖x‖ 的共轭是对偶单位球 {y:‖y‖*≤1} 的示性函数，½‖x‖² 的共轭是 ½‖y‖*²。正定二次型 ½xᵀPx 的共轭是 ½yᵀP⁻¹y。前提分别是有限维范数与对称正定 P；完整上界及取等证明放在掌握层。A norm conjugates to the indicator of {y:‖y‖*≤1}; half its square conjugates to ½‖y‖*². A positive quadratic ½xᵀPx conjugates to ½yᵀP⁻¹y. These require a finite-dimensional norm and symmetric positive definite P respectively. Mastery supplies the bound and attainment proof.

掌握Mastery

令 d=‖y‖*、r=‖x‖，有 yᵀx−½‖x‖²≤dr−r²/2≤d²/2。取对偶取等单位方向 u，再令 x=du 即达到；y=0 取 x=0。对范数本身，d≤1 时 x=0 取零，d>1 时沿 u 放大使目标无界。With d=‖y‖*,r=‖x‖, bound the objective by dr−r²/2≤d²/2. A maximizing unit direction u and x=du attain it; use x=0 when y=0. For the norm itself, d≤1 gives value 0 at zero, while d>1 allows unbounded scaling along u.

yx−e²ˣ=(y/2)u−eᵘ。−log(3x)=−log x−log 3，共轭目标多出 log 3。The exponential objective becomes (y/2)u−exp(u). The logarithm objective gains constant log 3.

完整核对Full check

指数共轭在 y>0 为 (y/2)log(y/2)−y/2，由 x=½log(y/2) 取得；y=0 值 0 不取得；y<0 为 +∞。负对数共轭在 y<0 为 −1−log(−y)+log 3，x=−1/y 取得；y≥0 无界。hC(y)=2|y|，其共轭在 |x|≤2 为 0，外部为 +∞；区间内 y=0 取等，外部沿同号 y 放大。The exponential conjugate is (y/2)log(y/2)−y/2 for y>0, attained at x=½log(y/2); at 0 it is an unattained 0; for y<0 it is +∞. The logarithm conjugate is −1−log(−y)+log 3 for y<0 at x=−1/y, and unbounded for y≥0. Support is 2|y|, whose conjugate is 0 for |x|≤2 and +∞ outside. Inside choose y=0; outside scale a same-sign y.

若卡住，回读 本节方法，再合上答案重写。If stuck, revisit the method, then close the answer and rewrite it.

保留 ½ 系数的矩阵配方Matrix completion of squares with the factor ½

P∈Sⁿ 且 P≻0，定义域为 Rⁿ，固定 y∈Rⁿ。下面的平方项非负，所以给所有 x 的统一上界；取 x=P⁻¹y 时消掉平方项，因此每个 y 都取得有限共轭。For P∈Sⁿ, P≻0 and domain Rⁿ, fix y∈Rⁿ. The nonnegative square below gives a bound for every x. Choosing x=P⁻¹y eliminates it, so every y has a finite attained conjugate.

深入In depth

回查表：在推导之后记住域和边界Reference after derivation: keep domains and boundaries

仿射 ax+b 的共轭仅在 y=a 为 −b，其余 +∞。负熵 x log x（x≥0，0log0=0）的共轭为 exp(y−1)，在 x=exp(y−1)>0 取得。1/x（x>0）的共轭在 y<0 为 −2√(−y)，取 x=1/√(−y)；y=0 值为 0 但不取得；y>0 值为 +∞。这些结论均可按本节“固定 y—候选—全局与边界”的顺序复算。For ax+b the conjugate is −b at y=a and +∞ elsewhere. Negative entropy x log x on x≥0, with 0log0=0, gives exp(y−1), attained at x=exp(y−1). For 1/x on x>0, y<0 gives −2√(−y) at x=1/√(−y); y=0 gives an unattained 0, and y>0 gives +∞. Recalculate each using fixed y, candidates, global bounds and boundaries.

矩阵拓展采用迹内积 tr(YᵀX)。在对称空间上，−logdet X（X≻0）的共轭仅在 Y≺0 有限，为 −n−logdet(−Y)，取 X=−Y⁻¹。若 Y 有正特征值，沿该方向将 X 特征值送至无穷，线性项胜过 log；若最大特征值为零，同一路径的 log 项仍使目标无界。负定时严格凹性保证候选全局最大。依据：Boyd–Vandenberghe §3.3。For the matrix extension use trace pairing tr(YᵀX) on symmetric matrices. The conjugate of −logdet X on X≻0 is finite only for Y≺0: −n−logdet(−Y), attained at X=−Y⁻¹. A positive eigenvalue of Y allows linear reward to dominate logarithmic growth along that direction. A zero top eigenvalue still allows the logarithm to diverge. For negative definite Y strict concavity proves global maximality. See Boyd–Vandenberghe §3.3.

43 · Fenchel 不等式与变换规则43 · Fenchel’s inequality and conjugate transformations

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.12-14 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：由定义推 ；解释可微取等和变换的前提。Learning goal: explain fenchel’s inequality and conjugate transformations and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

Fenchel 不等式来自共轭定义；真闭凸函数等于双共轭。Fenchel's inequality follows from the definition; proper closed convex functions equal their biconjugates.

了解Understand

共轭定义立即给 Fenchel 不等式 f(x)+f*(y)≥yᵀx。等号表示 x 最大化共轭目标；可微凸时等价于 y=∇f(x)，一般凸时用 y∈∂f(x)。The conjugate definition gives Fenchel's inequality f(x)+f*(y)≥yᵀx. Equality means x maximizes the conjugate objective; for differentiable convex f this is y=∇f(x), or generally y∈∂f(x).

双共轭把仿射下界取上确界，真闭凸函数满足 f**=f。真指不取 −∞ 且不恒为 +∞，闭指上图集闭。一般只有 f**≤f。The biconjugate takes the supremum of affine lower bounds. Proper closed convex f satisfies f**=f. Proper excludes −∞ and identically +∞; closed means a closed epigraph. Generally only f**≤f holds.

独立变量的和可分别取共轭；同一变量上的和不能直接拆开。若 A 可逆，g(x)=f(Ax+b) 给 g*(y)=f*(A⁻ᵀy)−yᵀA⁻¹b。Sums on independent variables conjugate separately; sums on the same variable generally do not. For invertible A, g(x)=f(Ax+b) gives g*(y)=f*(A⁻ᵀy)−yᵀA⁻¹b.

次梯度的定义用所有域内 z：f(z)≥f(x)+yᵀ(z−x)。它提供支撑斜率。对 |x| 在 0，任何 y∈[−1,1] 都满足 |z|≥yz；若 |y|>1，取同号 z 即违反。A y satisfies f(z)≥f(x)+yᵀ(z−x) for every z in the domain, providing a support slope. For |x| at 0, every y∈[−1,1] satisfies |z|≥yz; |y|>1 fails for a same-sign z.

掌握Mastery

a>0 时，(af)*(y)=a f*(y/a)，由正数提出上确界得到。仿射规则令 u=Ax+b，代入 x=A⁻¹(u−b)，分离常数即可。For a>0, factor a out of the supremum to obtain (af)*(y)=a f*(y/a). For the affine rule substitute x=A⁻¹(u−b) and separate the constant.

44 · 拟凸函数与保拟凸运算44 · Quasiconvexity: convex acceptability regions

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.16-25 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用下水平集判断；辨析一阶必要条件与充分条件的假设。Learning goal: explain quasiconvexity: convex acceptability regions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

拟凸等价于次水平集凸，可用门槛可行性二分求最优值。Quasiconvexity means convex sublevel sets; threshold feasibility enables bisection of the optimal value.

了解Understand

固定高度看输入集合Fix a threshold and examine inputs

拟凸只要求所有下水平集 {x:f(x)≤α} 凸。例如 x³ 的 α 下水平集是 (−∞,∛α]，所以拟凸；但 f″=6x 在负半轴为负，因此不凸。0 处导数为零，而每个负数都有更小值，故驻点也不足以最优。Quasiconvexity requires convex sublevel sets {x:f(x)≤α} for every α. For x³ these are half-lines (−∞,∛α], so it is quasiconvex. Yet f″=6x is negative for x<0, so it is not convex. The derivative vanishes at 0 while every negative input has a lower value, so stationarity is insufficient.

一次完整的门槛二分A complete threshold-bisection step

在 [0,2] 上最小化 f(x)=(x+1)/(x+2)。正分母允许把 f≤α 改成 (1−α)x≤2α−1，这是一个线性可行性问题。已知下界 l=0、可行上界 u=f(0)=1/2。取门槛 α=(l+u)/2=1/4，得到 (3/4)x≤−1/2，与 x≥0 矛盾，故最优值>1/4，将 l 更新为 1/4，u 保持 1/2。Minimize f(x)=(x+1)/(x+2) on [0,2]. Positive denominators turn f≤α into (1−α)x≤2α−1, a linear feasibility test. Start with lower bound l=0 and feasible upper bound u=f(0)=1/2. At α=1/4 the constraint becomes (3/4)x≤−1/2, impossible for x≥0. Thus the optimum exceeds 1/4; update l to 1/4 and keep u=1/2.

每步若门槛可行，将 u 降到 α 并保存可行点；不可行就把 l 提到 α。每次区间减半，u−l≤ε 时停止，保存点的目标值与最优值差至多 ε。这里假定可行性判断准确；拟凸本身不自动提供数值求解器。At each step, a feasible threshold lowers u to α and saves a feasible point; an infeasible threshold raises l to α. Each step halves the interval. Stop when u−l≤ε; the saved point is at most ε above the optimum. This assumes accurate feasibility tests; quasiconvexity alone does not provide a numerical solver.

掌握Mastery

次水平集凸时，取 α=max(f(x),f(y)) 即得定义；反向用两端≤α 即证。上确界的次水平集是各项次水平集的交。非负加法一般不保持拟凸。Convex sublevel sets give the definition by choosing α=max(f(x),f(y)); the converse follows by bounding both endpoints by α. Supremum sublevel sets are intersections. Nonnegative sums generally do not preserve quasiconvexity.

次水平集凸时，取 α=max(f(x),f(y)) 即得定义；反向用两端≤α 即证。上确界的次水平集是各项次水平集的交。非负加法一般不保持拟凸。Convex sublevel sets give the definition by choosing α=max(f(x),f(y)); the converse follows by bounding both endpoints by α. Supremum sublevel sets are intersections. Nonnegative sums generally do not preserve quasiconvexity.

展开核对Check the answer

次水平集是 x≤α^(1/3)，超水平集也是半轴，均凸；但负 x 处二阶导数为负。Sublevels are x≤α^(1/3), and superlevels are opposite halflines, all convex. Negative x has negative second derivative.

沿正文分式例子，从区间 [1/4,1/2] 再二分一次；若 ε=1/16，还需要将初始宽度 1/2 减半几次？Continue the fractional example with interval [1/4,1/2] for one more bisection. For ε=1/16, how many halvings of initial width 1/2 are required?

思路提示Hint

门槛是当前两端平均；检查线性不等式是否有 x∈[0,2] 满足。Average the endpoints; test whether the resulting linear inequality has a solution in [0,2].

关键步骤Key steps

门槛为 3/8，右端 2α−1 为 −1/4。The threshold is 3/8 and 2α−1=−1/4.

完整核对Full check

得到 (5/8)x≤−1/4，与 x≥0 矛盾，故新区间 [3/8,1/2]。从初始宽度 1/2 经过三次减半到 1/16；满足停止条件的上界来自保存的可行点 x=0，目标为 1/2。The constraint (5/8)x≤−1/4 is impossible for x≥0, giving [3/8,1/2]. Three halvings reduce initial width 1/2 to 1/16. The feasible upper bound is retained at x=0 with value 1/2.

若卡住，回读 本节方法，再合上答案重写。If stuck, revisit the method, then close the answer and rewrite it.

深入In depth

拟凸的平坦区可产生非全局局部极小点，不能直接套用凸优化的最优性结论。Flat regions can give nonglobal local minima of quasiconvex functions, so convex optimality conclusions do not all transfer.

导数判据的范围Scope of derivative criteria

开放凸域上，可微 f 拟凸等价于对所有 x,y，f(y)≤f(x)⇒∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)≤0。C² 拟凸的二阶必要条件是 v⊥∇f(x) 时 vᵀH(x)v≥0；它单独不是充分条件。处处在每个非零正交方向严格为正则足以拟凸。这些是整体域上的条件，不能只测一个点。依据：教材 §3.4。On an open convex domain, differentiable f is quasiconvex iff for all x,y, f(y)≤f(x) implies ∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)≤0. For C² quasiconvex f, v⊥∇f(x) necessarily gives vᵀH(x)v≥0; this is not sufficient alone. Strict positivity at every point for every nonzero orthogonal v is sufficient. These are domain-wide tests, not tests at one point. See §3.4.

保拟凸运算可从下水平集复核：上确界对应各下水平集的交；非减标量复合通过门槛的原像；仿射原像保持凸；正分母线性分式固定门槛后是半空间条件。联合拟凸 f(x,y) 在凸约束中对 y 取下确界也拟凸，可用 ε-近似点和最大值型混合不等式证明。非负加法一般不保持拟凸，不能仿照凸函数的加和规则。Quasiconvex preservation follows from sublevel sets: a supremum gives intersections; nondecreasing composition transfers thresholds; affine preimages retain convexity; positive-denominator linear fractions give halfspace thresholds. Partial minimization of jointly quasiconvex f over a convex set is also quasiconvex, using ε-approximate points and the maximum-type mixture bound. Nonnegative sums generally fail to preserve quasiconvexity.

速通Quick

/凹指 log f 凸/凹；前者蕴含凸，后者蕴含拟凹。Log-convexity or concavity concerns log f. They imply convexity or quasiconcavity, respectively.

了解Understand

正函数 f 对数凸/凹，指 log f 凸/凹。例如 exp(−x²/2) ，却不在全实轴凹；对数凹蕴含拟凹。对数凸则蕴含凸，由加权几何平均≤算术平均得到。A positive function is log-convex or when its logarithm is convex or concave. Thus exp(−x²/2) is log-concave but not globally concave. Log-concavity implies quasiconcavity; log-convexity implies convexity by the arithmetic–geometric mean bound.

乘积变成对数之和，故分别保持对数凸、对数凹。非负加权和保持对数凸；对数凹的和一般不保持，两个分离高斯峰可形成双峰。xᵃ 在 x>0 上按 a≤0 对数凸、a≥0 对数凹。Products preserve either property by addition of logarithms. Nonnegative sums preserve log-convexity but generally not log-concavity: separated Gaussian peaks can create two modes. On x>0, xᵃ is log-convex for a≤0 and log-concave for a≥0.

先检查正性，再对数化Check positivity before taking logarithms

在凸域 D 上先要求 f>0。若 log f 凸，称对数凸；若 log f 凹，称对数凹。eˣ² 对数凸，因为其对数为 x²；e⁻ˣ²ᐟ² 对数凹，因为其对数为 −x²/2。后者的二阶导为 (x²−1)e⁻ˣ²ᐟ²，在 |x|>1 为正，所以原函数并不在整个实轴凹。First require f>0 on convex D. It is log-convex when log f is convex and log-concave when log f is concave. The functions exp(x²) and exp(−x²/2) illustrate each. The latter has second derivative (x²−1)exp(−x²/2)>0 for |x|>1, so it is not globally concave.

为什么对数凸一定凸？对数凸先给乘法形式的上界，再用正数的加权算术—几何平均不等式（它也可由 log 的凹性推出）：Why does log-convexity imply convexity? It first gives a multiplicative bound, followed by the weighted arithmetic–geometric mean inequality for positive numbers, which also follows from concavity of log:

This advanced statement is not a tool needed for HW1.

f K-凸等价于每个 λ∈K* 的标量函数 λᵀf 凸，反向用 K**=K。故一阶条件为 f(y)⪰K f(x)+Df(x)(y−x)；二阶条件为 D²f(x)[v,v]∈K。K-convexity is equivalent to convexity of λᵀf for all λ∈K*, using K**=K for the converse. Its first-order condition is f(y)⪰K f(x)+Df(x)(y−x); the second-order condition is D²f(x)[v,v]∈K.

复合例中 X,B 为 m×n、A 为 m×m、C 为 n×n。内层混合差为 θ(1−θ)(X−Y)ᵀA(X−Y)⪰0；外层沿 PSD 增量 H 的导数 tr((−Y)⁻¹H)≥0，给出所需单调性。In the example X,B are m×n, A m×m and C n×n. The inner gap is θ(1−θ)(X−Y)ᵀA(X−Y)⪰0. The outer derivative along PSD H is tr((−Y)⁻¹H)≥0, proving monotonicity.

本节广义一阶判据要求开放凸定义域及可微性，二阶判据要求 C²；K 为正常锥。每个方向 v 的 D²f(x)[v,v] 是输出向量，须属于 K。Generalized first-order tests here require an open convex domain and differentiability; second-order tests require C². K is proper. Each D²f(x)[v,v] is an output vector and must belong to K.

复合拓展：X、B 为 m×n，A 为 m×m 对称半正定，C 为 n×n 对称矩阵。g(X)=XᵀAX+BᵀX+XᵀB+C 是 PSD 序凸函数，其混合差为 θ(1−θ)(X−Y)ᵀA(X−Y)⪰0。外层 h(Y)=−logdet(−Y) 在 Y≺0 凸且 PSD 序非减，因此 h(g(X)) 在 g(X)≺0 的凸域上凸。Extension: X,B are m×n, A is m×m symmetric PSD and C is n×n symmetric. The map g(X)=XᵀAX+BᵀX+XᵀB+C is PSD-order convex, with gap θ(1−θ)(X−Y)ᵀA(X−Y)⪰0. The outer h(Y)=−logdet(−Y) is convex and PSD-order nondecreasing on Y≺0; hence h(g(X)) is convex on its convex domain g(X)≺0.

47 · 广义单调性47 · Generalized monotonicity and the course connections

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.37 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.6.1 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：说明输入、输出锥与定义域；与广义凸性建立联系。Learning goal: explain and the course connections and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

保持输入、输出锥序；导数需把输入锥映入输出锥。Generalized monotonicity preserves cone orders; derivatives must map the input cone into the output cone.

了解Understand

多变量单调性须指定输入锥 K、输出锥 L：y−x∈K 时要求 f(y)−f(x)∈L。逐分量序下，f(x₁,x₂)=x₁+2x₂ 非减，x₁−x₂ 则沿 (0,1) 下降。Multivariate monotonicity requires input cone K and output cone L: y−x∈K must imply f(y)−f(x)∈L. In componentwise order, x₁+2x₂ is nondecreasing, while x₁−x₂ decreases along (0,1).

在开放凸域上可微时检查 Df(x)K⊂L，即每个允许的输入方向都映成非负输出方向。矩阵序也须按整体锥判断，逐元素导数符号通常不够。For differentiable f on an open convex domain, test Df(x)K⊂L: every allowed input direction must map to a nonnegative output direction. Matrix orders require whole-cone tests, not merely entrywise signs.

导数 Df(x) 是把输入小步映成输出一阶变化的线性映射。逐分量序、标量输出时，所有偏导非负即可；矩阵输出时应测试方向导数是否 PSD，不能只看条目的正负。The derivative Df(x) maps input steps to first-order output changes. For scalar output and componentwise order, nonnegative partial derivatives suffice. Matrix output requires PSD directional derivatives rather than signs of entries.

掌握Mastery

导数判据需要开放凸域与闭凸输出锥The derivative criterion needs an open convex domain and closed convex output cone

设 D⊂Rⁿ 开放且凸，f:D→Rᵐ 连续可微，输入锥 K，输出锥 L 闭且凸。若 Df(x)K⊆L 处处成立，对 y−x=v∈K，整个线段都在 D 内，微积分基本定理给：Let D⊂Rⁿ be open and convex, f:D→Rᵐ continuously differentiable, K an input cone and L a closed convex output cone. If Df(x)K⊆L everywhere and v=y−x∈K, the full segment lies in D, and the fundamental theorem of calculus gives:

被积向量都在 L；积分可由非负加权的有限和逼近，凸锥性保留各和，闭性保留极限。反向若 f 保序，固定 x、v∈K，开放性保证小步 x+hv∈D；正差商在 L，令 h↓0 并用 L 闭得到 Df(x)v∈L。Every integrand lies in L. Riemann sums are nonnegative combinations retained by its convex-cone property; closedness retains their limit. Conversely, if f preserves order, openness permits small steps x+hv for v∈K. Positive difference quotients lie in L; closedness retains the derivative as h↓0.

A 每个元素都非负。充分性由非负向量相乘得到；必要性取输入方向为每个坐标单位向量，要求 A 的每一列都非负。Every entry of A must be nonnegative. Sufficiency follows by multiplication; necessity follows by testing each coordinate unit vector and hence every column.

1(a)正文Method · 示范Worked · 训练Practice可逆平方根换元；上界与取等；z=0 单列。Invertible square-root substitution; bound and attainment; separate z=0.

五种证明组织方式Five proof-writing patterns

范数公式：任意对象的统一上界 → 构造可行取等对象 → 核对约束与评分 → 单列零情形。Norm formula: uniform bound for arbitrary inputs → construct an attaining feasible input → check budget and reward → handle zero cases.

集合凸性：任意两点与权重 → 混合点 → 验证成员条件 → 用任意性收尾。Set convexity: arbitrary points and weight → mixture → verify membership → conclude by arbitrariness.

半正定：任意方向 v → 二次型 → 非负平方和 → 对所有 v 成立；取零方向继续分析每项等号。PSD: arbitrary v → quadratic form → nonnegative squares → conclude for all v; analyze every equality for null directions.

集合相等：分别证明两个包含；反向可以选测试对象排除不合格候选。Set equality: prove each inclusion; in reverse choose test objects to exclude invalid candidates.

归纳法：基础情形 → 明确归纳假设 → 单列端点 → 归一化分组 → 使用定义与假设 → 恢复原式。Induction: base case → precise induction hypothesis → endpoints → normalized grouping → definition and hypothesis → restore the expression.

中文Chinese英文English符号Symbol解释Meaning位置Context
norm‖x‖范数把一个向量变成一个非负数，用这个数表示它的长度。它要求：只有零向量的长度为零；向量乘以 t 后，长度乘以 |t|；两段路接起来的长度不超过各段长度之和。选用不同范数，相当于采用不同的长度规则。A norm assigns a nonnegative length to each vector. Only the zero vector has length zero; multiplying a vector by t multiplies its length by |t|; and the length of a sum is at most the sum of the lengths. Different norms use different rules for measuring length.前往讲解Read
unit ballB所有长度不超过 1 的向量；本章使用闭单位球。The set of vectors whose norm is at most one; the closed unit ball is used here.前往讲解Read
inner productzᵀx这里用标准内积：对应分量乘积之和。Here the standard inner product is the sum of componentwise products.前往讲解Read
supremumsupsup 是 supremum 的缩写。上确界是能够挡住所有可能数值的最小上界；它可以存在而没有任何点实际达到它。例如 x∈(0,1) 时，x 的上确界是 1，但没有最大值。The abbreviation sup stands for supremum. A supremum is the least upper bound on all possible values, and it may exist without being attained. For x∈(0,1), the supremum of x is one, but there is no maximum.前往讲解Read
maximummaxmax 是 maximum 的缩写。说一个数是最大值，需要找到一个可行点实际取得这个数，还需要说明其他可行点都不超过它。本章的有限维闭单位球上，线性目标可以取得最大值。The abbreviation max stands for maximum. A maximum is both attained by a feasible point and at least as large as every other feasible value. The linear objective in this chapter attains a maximum on the finite-dimensional closed unit ball.前往讲解Read
dual norm‖z‖*先选定一个原范数，再固定向量 z。让 x 在原范数的单位球中移动，计算每个可行 x 的 zᵀx。所有这些内积的最大值，就是 z 的对偶范数。它的数值取决于原范数使用的长度规则。Choose a primal norm and fix a vector z. Let x vary over the primal unit ball and evaluate zᵀx at every feasible x. The largest value is the dual norm of z. Its value depends on the length rule used by the primal norm.前往讲解Read
support functionh_B(z)给定集合 B 和方向 z，取 sup{x∈B} zᵀx。For a set B and direction z, the supremum of zᵀx over B.前往讲解Read
Hölder inequality1/p+1/q=1共轭指数对应的内积界：|zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q。An inner-product bound for conjugate exponents: |zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q.前往讲解Read
Cauchy–Schwarz inequality|uᵀv|≤‖u‖₂‖v‖₂这个不等式给欧氏内积一个长度上界。两个非零向量同向时，uᵀv 等于长度的乘积；方向偏离时，内积会变小。本章用它先找上界，再沿正确方向构造达到上界的向量。This inequality bounds a Euclidean inner product by the product of the vector lengths. For nonzero vectors pointing in the same direction, uᵀv equals that product; changing their relative direction reduces the inner product. We use it to find a bound and then construct an attaining vector.前往讲解Read
positive definite matrixP≻0 / PDPD = Positive Definite，正定。这里 P 必须是实对称矩阵；对每个非零向量 x，都有 xᵀPx>0。这个条件让每一个非零方向都有正的长度代价，并保证 P 可以求逆。PD = Positive Definite（正定）. Here P is real and symmetric, and xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero vector x. Every nonzero direction therefore has a positive length cost, and P is invertible.前往讲解Read
positive semidefinite matrixP⪰0 / PSDPSD = Positive Semidefinite，半正定。对实对称矩阵 P，要求所有 x 满足 xᵀPx≥0；允许某个非零向量的二次型为零。因此 P 可能不可逆，√(xᵀPx) 也可能不满足范数“非零向量长度为正”的要求。PSD = Positive Semidefinite（半正定）. For a real symmetric P, xᵀPx≥0 for every x, but the quadratic form can vanish at a nonzero vector. P may be singular, and √(xᵀPx) may fail the definiteness requirement of a norm.前往讲解Read
quadratic norm‖x‖P由正定矩阵 P 定义的 √(xᵀPx)。The norm √(xᵀPx) defined by a positive definite matrix P.前往讲解Read
matrix square rootP½对正定 P，P½ 表示一个正定矩阵 S，使得 S²=P。它通常不能通过对每个矩阵元素分别开平方得到。利用正交特征分解，把正特征值逐个开平方，可以构造这个 S。For positive definite P, P½ denotes a positive definite matrix S satisfying S²=P. It is generally not obtained by taking square roots of individual matrix entries. An orthogonal eigenvalue decomposition constructs S by taking square roots of the positive eigenvalues.前往讲解Read
maximizerx* / argmax最大化点是一个可行向量：把它代入目标后，目标实际达到最大值。本章 x* 上的星号标记我们选出的最大化点。x* 是向量，最大值是一个数；这两种对象需要分清。A maximizer is a feasible vector at which the objective attains its maximum. The star on x* marks such a chosen vector. A maximizer is a vector, while the maximum value is a number; they are different kinds of objects.前往讲解Read
ellipsoidxᵀPx≤1正定二次型的单位球；在二维是椭圆及内部。The unit ball of a positive definite quadratic form; an ellipse with its interior in two dimensions.前往讲解Read
polar setB°B°={z: zᵀx≤1 对所有 x∈B}；对偶单位球等于原单位球的极集。B°={z: zᵀx≤1 for all x∈B}; the dual unit ball is the polar of the primal ball.前往讲解Read

Singular Value DecompositionSVDSVD = Singular Value Decomposition，奇异值分解；矩阵写成 UΣVᵀ。SVD = Singular Value Decomposition（奇异值分解）; a matrix is written UΣVᵀ.前往讲解Read
second-order coneSOCSOC = Second-Order Cone，二阶锥；{(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}。SOC = Second-Order Cone（二阶锥）; the set {(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}.前往讲解Read
sign functionsgnsgn 是 sign 的惯用缩写。符号函数对正数返回 1，对负数返回 −1，对零返回 0。取 xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) 可以让乘积 zᵢxᵢ=|zᵢ|。The notation sgn is a conventional abbreviation of sign. The sign function returns one for a positive number, minus one for a negative number and zero at zero. Choosing xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) makes zᵢxᵢ=|zᵢ|.前往讲解Read

gradient∇f标量函数一阶偏导组成的列向量，配对方向给一阶变化。The column of first partial derivatives, pairing with a direction to give first-order change.前往讲解Read

log-sum-expLSE先对输入取指数求和，再取对数的平滑凸函数。A smooth convex function taking the logarithm of a sum of exponentials.前往讲解Read
Hessian matrix∇²f标量函数二阶偏导矩阵，其二次型给方向曲率。The matrix of second partial derivatives, whose quadratic form gives directional curvature.前往讲解Read
covarianceΣ用均值中心化后，计算向量外积的加权平均，记录方向波动。A weighted average of outer products after mean centering, recording directional variation.前往讲解Read
rangeR(A)矩阵作用于所有输入时可到达的输出集合。The set of outputs reachable by applying a matrix to all inputs.前往讲解Read
nullspaceN(A)被矩阵映为零的全部输入构成的子空间。The subspace of inputs mapped to zero.前往讲解Read
eigenvalueλ满足 Av=λv 的方向缩放系数，其中 v 非零。A directional scale factor satisfying Av=λv for a nonzero vector v.前往讲解Read
pseudoinverseA†通过 SVD 反转非零奇异值并保留零方向为零的矩阵。The matrix obtained from SVD by inverting nonzero singular values and retaining zeros.前往讲解Read
Schur complementC−BᵀA⁻¹B正定块消元或配方后留下的对称块。The symmetric block remaining after eliminating a positive definite block.前往讲解Read
affine setaff C包含任意两点所在整条直线的集合。A set containing the whole line through every pair of its points.前往讲解Read
convex setC包含任意两点间线段的集合。A set containing the segment between every pair of its points.前往讲解Read
convex hullconv C包含原集合的最小凸集，由所有有限凸组合构成。The smallest convex set containing the original set, consisting of all finite convex combinations.前往讲解Read
hyperplaneaᵀx=b非零法向给出的一个仿射等式集合。An affine equality set defined by a nonzero normal.前往讲解Read
halfspaceaᵀx≤b超平面的一侧，闭半空间包括边界。One side of a hyperplane; a closed halfspace includes its boundary.前往讲解Read
polyhedronGx≤h有限个半空间与超平面的交，可以无界。An intersection of finitely many halfspaces and hyperplanes, possibly unbounded.前往讲解Read
simplexΔ仿射独立顶点的凸包，标准形式记录非负且和为 1 的权重。The hull of affinely independent vertices; the standard form represents nonnegative weights summing to one.前往讲解Read
preimagef⁻¹(C)输出落入指定集合的全部输入，不要求映射可逆。All inputs whose outputs belong to a specified set, without requiring invertibility.前往讲解Read
perspective mapz/t在正高度 t 上把水平坐标除以 t 的映射。The map dividing horizontal coordinates by positive height t.前往讲解Read
proper coneK闭、凸、尖且内部非空的锥，可定义偏序。A closed convex pointed cone with nonempty interior, suitable for defining a partial order.前往讲解Read
pointednessK∩(−K)={0}锥不包含任何经过原点的非零双向直线。The absence of any nonzero two-sided line through the origin in a cone.前往讲解Read
minimum elementmin按选定偏序不大于集合全部元素的点。A point below every element under the chosen order.前往讲解Read
minimal elementPareto没有另一个不同元素按偏序不大于它的点。A point with no distinct element below it under the order.前往讲解Read
separating hyperplaneaᵀx=b将两个集合置于相反两侧的超平面，弱分离允许边界取等。A hyperplane placing two sets on opposite sides, with boundary equality allowed in weak separation.前往讲解Read
supporting hyperplaneaᵀx≤aᵀx₀通过边界点并将整个集合留在同一侧的超平面。A hyperplane through a boundary point with the entire set on one side.前往讲解Read
dual coneK*与原锥所有点内积非负的向量组成的锥。The cone of vectors pairing nonnegatively with every primal-cone point.前往讲解Read
Pareto frontierf(x)多目标比较下未被其他方案支配的目标点集合。The set of objective points undominated by other plans.前往讲解Read
convex functionf在凸定义域上，混合输入的函数值不超过输出的加权平均。A function on a convex domain whose mixture value is at most the weighted average of endpoint values.前往讲解Read
convex indicator functionδC在集合内取 0，在集合外取 +∞，用来编码约束。A function equal to zero inside a set and +∞ outside, encoding a constraint.前往讲解Read
subgradient∂f给出全局仿射下界的斜率，适用于不可微凸函数。A slope defining a global affine lower bound, including at nondifferentiable convex points.前往讲解Read
epigraphepi f包含函数图像及上方所有点的集合。The set consisting of the graph and all points above it.前往讲解Read
sublevel setf≤α函数值不超过固定门槛的输入集合。The inputs whose function values are no greater than a fixed threshold.前往讲解Read
Linear Matrix InequalityLMI变量以仿射方式出现在对称矩阵中，并要求该矩阵半正定。A PSD constraint on a symmetric matrix depending affinely on the variables.前往讲解Read
Jensen inequalityf(E X)≤E f(X)凸函数在平均输入处的值不超过输出的平均。Evaluation of a convex function at an average is no greater than averaging its values.前往讲解Read
partial minimizationinf_y对部分变量取下确界，所得值可以不被任何点取得。Taking an infimum over some variables; the value need not be attained.前往讲解Read
Fenchel inequalityf+f*≥〈x,y〉由共轭定义得到的内积上界，取等表示共轭最大化。The inner-product bound from conjugacy, with equality at a conjugate maximizer.前往讲解Read
quasiconvexf(mix)≤max所有次水平集凸，混合点不超过两端较大值。Having convex sublevel sets, or mixture values no greater than the larger endpoint value.前往讲解Read
log-convexlog f convex正函数的对数为凸函数。A positive function with convex logarithm.前往讲解Read
log-concavelog f concave正函数的对数为凹函数。A positive function with concave logarithm.前往讲解Read
K-convexity⪯K用锥序代替标量不等式的向量值函数凸性。Convexity of a vector-valued function using cone order in place of scalar order.前往讲解Read
generalized monotonicityDf K⊂L输入按指定锥序增加时，输出也按其锥序增加。Preservation of specified input and output cone orders.前往讲解Read
